threads.title_en: Binance hit by large-scale hack, losses covered by company reserves
threads.summary_zh: 据报道，在币安发生 63 亿美元黑客事件后，包括美联储和 OCC 在内的美国监管机构正联系银行，排查中断和异常活动，同时银行也在审查自身网络安全准备情况。
threads.summary_en: US regulators including the Federal Reserve and OCC are reportedly contacting banks to probe for disruptions and unusual activity following a $6.3 billion Binance hack, while banks review their own cybersecurity readiness.
threads.latest_update_zh: 币安向 ArbitrumDAO 治理论坛提交提案，申请将 Arbitrum 安全委员会在币安热钱包被盗后冻结的 8,425.997 枚 ETH 和 74,559,805.2 枚 ARB 返还至币安指定的恢复地址；提案尚处论坛讨论阶段，后续需经过 Snapshot 意向投票和链上治理，预计全程约 49 天，且不申请新增 DAO 金库拨款。
threads.latest_update_en: Binance submitted a proposal to the ArbitrumDAO governance forum seeking the return of 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after the Binance hot-wallet hack to a Binance-designated recovery address; the proposal is still in forum discussion and would require a Snapshot sentiment vote and on-chain governance, with an expected total process of about 49 days, and it does not request new DAO treasury funding.
threads.background_zh: 冷存储将私钥置于离线环境，交易则通过联网设备构建并广播；分片密钥设计将密钥材料拆分，使任何单一主体或系统都不掌握完整密钥。币安联合创始人赵长鹏公开回应了该事件，称“没有100%的安全”。Coinbase长期提供客户币种的冷存储服务，作为自行托管的替代方案。
threads.background_en: Cold storage keeps private keys offline, while transactions are prepared and broadcast from connected devices; split-key designs divide key material so no single party or system holds a complete key. Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao publicly addressed the incident, saying there is "no 100% security." Coinbase has long offered cold storage of customer coins as an alternative to self-custody.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Binance submitted an Arbitrum governance proposal seeking the return of roughly 8,426 ETH and 74.56 million ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after a Binance hot-wallet hack, pledging the recovered assets will offset user losses already covered by SAFU and corporate treasury reserves.
threads.latest_summary_en: Binance submitted an Arbitrum governance proposal seeking the return of roughly 8,426 ETH and 74.56 million ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after a Binance hot-wallet hack, pledging the recovered assets will offset user losses already covered by SAFU and corporate treasury reserves.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于托管与交易对手风险：大额持有者重新权衡资产存放地点，可能改变各平台间的现货流动性、BTC与稳定币流向，并提升对储备证明披露的关注度。与交易所相关的代币及提供托管服务的平台是受影响最直接的板块。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is custody and counterparty risk: large holders re-weighing where balances sit can shift spot liquidity, BTC and stablecoin flows between venues, and attention to proof-of-reserves disclosures. Exchange-linked tokens and custodial venues are the segments most directly in focus.

timeline.text_zh: 币安向 ArbitrumDAO 治理论坛提交提案，申请将 Arbitrum 安全委员会在币安热钱包被盗后冻结的 8,425.997 枚 ETH 和 74,559,805.2 枚 ARB 返还至币安指定的恢复地址；提案尚处论坛讨论阶段，后续需经过 Snapshot 意向投票和链上治理，预计全程约 49 天，且不申请新增 DAO 金库拨款。
timeline.text_en: Binance submitted a proposal to the ArbitrumDAO governance forum seeking the return of 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after the Binance hot-wallet hack to a Binance-designated recovery address; the proposal is still in forum discussion and would require a Snapshot sentiment vote and on-chain governance, with an expected total process of about 49 days, and it does not request new DAO treasury funding.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，在币安发生 63 亿美元黑客事件后，包括美联储和 OCC 在内的美国监管机构正联系银行，排查中断和异常活动，同时银行也在审查自身网络安全准备情况。
timeline.text_en: US regulators including the Federal Reserve and OCC are reportedly contacting banks to probe for disruptions and unusual activity following a $6.3 billion Binance hack, while banks review their own cybersecurity readiness.

timeline.text_zh:
在币安据报遭遇64亿美元黑客攻击后，Coinbase强调其分片密钥（split-key）冷存储架构，并表示99%的客户资产存放于冷存储之中。该表态被置于行业重新审视托管安全与密钥管理的背景下。

这一表态把焦点引向交易所如何设计密钥管理架构，而这一点正是客户与交易对手评估大型平台托管风险的核心。

各方报道对事件规模表述不一，有63亿美元与64亿美元两种说法。币安自身的初步调查称，10月29日事件影响约63.4亿美元数字资产，截至10月31日已有98%的受影响代币得到补充，并可在其储备证明页面核验。
timeline.text_en:
In the wake of a reported $6.4 billion hack at Binance, Coinbase pointed to its split-key cold storage design and stated that 99% of customer assets are held in cold storage. The disclosure was framed as the industry re-examines custody security and key management.

The remarks shift attention to how exchanges architect key management, which is central to how customers and counterparties gauge custodial risk at a major venue.

Reports on the incident differ on magnitude, describing a $6.3 billion or $6.4 billion breach. Binance's own initial findings said about $6.34 billion of digital assets were affected in the Oct. 29 incident and that 98% of the impacted tokens had been replenished as of Oct. 31, verifiable on its proof-of-reserves page.

timeline.text_zh:
区块链分析公司 Elliptic 在周一发布的报告中称，币安 64.3 亿美元被盗案的实施者在不到四天内将资金分散到 11 条区块链上的约 1.2 万个钱包，交易超过 4 万笔——大约每 25 秒就启用一个新钱包。Elliptic 表示，在 Tether 与 Circle 出手冻结被盗稳定币后，约 28.5 亿美元（占 44%）已被冻结或查扣。

据 Elliptic 数据，本次 44% 的冻结或查扣比例远高于 2025 年 2 月朝鲜盗取 Bybit 15 亿美元后约 3% 的水平，该公司将此归因于稳定币发行方在数分钟内采取了行动。

Elliptic 发现，Tether 在被盗 USDT 到达攻击者钱包后 37 分钟即于以太坊上完成冻结，Circle 则在全部 8.23 亿美元被盗 USDC 被兑换前予以冻结；但仍有约 7.86 亿美元稳定币流出。该公司表示，这一洗钱过程明显是自动化的，但没有证据显示由 AI 做决策，理由是时间间隔固定、金额设定统一、盲目重试，以及类似人类工作时间的停顿。
timeline.text_en:
Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic said in an analysis published Monday that in under four days the attacker behind the $6.43 billion Binance theft spread the funds across roughly 12,000 wallets on 11 blockchains in more than 40,000 transactions — about one new wallet every 25 seconds. Elliptic reported that about $2.85 billion, or 44% of the haul, has already been frozen or seized after Tether and Circle moved to lock up stolen stablecoins.

The 44% freeze-or-seizure rate compares with roughly 3% after North Korea's $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025, according to Elliptic, which attributes the difference to stablecoin issuers acting within minutes.

Elliptic found Tether froze stolen USDT on Ethereum 37 minutes after it reached the attacker's wallet, and Circle froze all $823 million in stolen USDC before any could be swapped; about $786 million in stablecoins nonetheless escaped. The firm said the laundering is clearly automated but shows no AI decision-making, citing fixed timing, set amounts, blind retries and pauses resembling human working hours.

timeline.text_zh: Elliptic 追踪显示，币安黑客在不到4天内通过11条链上约1.2万个钱包、超过4万笔交易进行自动化洗钱；被盗64.3亿美元中约28.5亿美元已被冻结或查扣，约32.4亿美元仍留在相关地址，以ETH和BTC为主。自11月1日起ETH、SOL、NEAR和XRP开始移动，2.33亿枚XRP于11月2日转入6个新地址；约28枚BTC（约220万美元）首次进入CoinJoin混币，另有约1600万美元转入同样存有9月Bitget被盗资金的地址。
timeline.text_en: Elliptic tracing shows the Binance hacker automated laundering through roughly 12,000 wallets across 11 chains and over 40,000 transactions in under four days; of the $6.43 billion haul, about $2.85 billion has been frozen or seized and about $3.24 billion remains in related addresses, mainly ETH and BTC. Since November 1, ETH, SOL, NEAR and XRP began moving, with 233 million XRP moved entirely to six new addresses on November 2; about 28 BTC (~$2.2 million) entered CoinJoin mixing for the first time, and about $16 million was sent to addresses that also hold September Bitget stolen funds.

timeline.text_zh: FBI正式将币安约60亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜TraderTraitor组织，并公布数百个关联地址；币安在分阶段恢复提现后重新开放包括美元在内的法币提现；美国特勤局称已与行业伙伴冻结相当一部分被盗资产。
timeline.text_en: The FBI formally attributed the roughly $6 billion Binance hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group and published hundreds of associated addresses; Binance reopened fiat withdrawals including USD after restoring crypto withdrawals in phases; the U.S. Secret Service said it froze a significant portion of stolen assets with industry partners.

timeline.text_zh: QCP 报告称，比特币在跌至 76,141 美元后第四次守住 76,000 至 76,600 美元支撑区间；币安在遭攻击后重新开放 15 条网络的提现，净流出 36.4 亿美元（约占资产的 2.1%）；美国现货比特币 ETF 周五录得 6.432 亿美元流出。
timeline.text_en: QCP reported Bitcoin holding the $76,000–$76,600 support zone for a fourth time after dipping to $76,141, while Binance reopened withdrawals across 15 networks post-exploit with $3.64B in net outflows (~2.1% of assets) and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $643.2M in Friday outflows.

timeline.text_zh: 币安在6.3亿美元黑客攻击后分阶段恢复提现期间，净流出从约58亿美元扩大至超过70亿美元；币安称已补充约95%受影响资产（高于周六的90%），并发布了新的储备快照，预计周一更新储备证明报告。OKX以4.45亿美元24小时净流入领先交易所。
timeline.text_en: As Binance restored withdrawals in phases after its $6.3 billion hack, net outflows widened from about $5.8 billion to more than $7 billion; Binance said it had replenished approximately 95% of affected assets, up from 90% on Saturday, published a new reserves snapshot and expected an updated proof-of-reserves report Monday. OKX led exchanges with $445 million in 24-hour net inflows.

timeline.text_zh: 一份加密新闻摘要报道称，朝鲜黑客洗白了从币安窃取的 2.42 亿美元，币安联合创始人何一否认了涉及一名工程师和一名朝鲜特工的传闻，包括英伟达在内的 50 家公司反对 OKXICE 将其股份代币化，同时还有一条关于比特币 RSI 的看涨消息。
timeline.text_en: A crypto news digest reported that North Korean hackers laundered $242 million stolen from Binance, Binance's Yi He denied a rumor involving an engineer and a North Korean agent, and 50 companies including Nvidia opposed OKXICE tokenizing their shares, alongside a bullish Bitcoin RSI note.

timeline.text_zh: 链上分析师称，币安攻击发生约两天后，攻击者通过 Tron 相关路径转移约2.42亿美元；在 Tether 冻结约3.787亿 USDT 后，资金经 Relay、THORChain、Chainflip、Symbiosis 等渠道转移，另有约4170万美元流经 Bitget Wallet，Tron 上剩余约750万美元，其他链上超过30亿美元被盗资产基本未动。
timeline.text_en: An on-chain analyst said that about two days after the Binance attack, the attacker moved roughly $242 million through Tron-related paths; after Tether froze about 378.7 million USDT, funds were routed via Relay, THORChain, Chainflip, Symbiosis and other channels, with about $41.7 million flowing through Bitget Wallet, about $7.5 million remaining on Tron, and more than $3 billion in stolen assets on other chains largely unmoved.

threads.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
threads.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
threads.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，常规提现界面已于 10 月 26 日截止；桥上仍有约 4041 万美元资产，用户需通过直接与以太坊桥接合约交互手动提现；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
threads.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and the standard withdrawal interface deadline passed on Oct 26; about $40.41 million remains in the bridge, and users must withdraw manually by interacting directly with Ethereum bridge contracts. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
threads.latest_update_zh:
Blast 在 X 平台发推宣布，其 L2 网络已正式关停。仍在 L2 钱包、待处理提现或 Blast Mobile 中持有 ETH 或 USD 的用户，可通过 Blast 官网取回资产；该取回网站将运行 12 个月，最终支持日期为 2027 年 11 月 4 日。

资产取回网站设有明确期限，2027 年 11 月 4 日为最后支持日期。此前的报道称，Blast 的标准提现界面已于 10 月 26 日关闭，此后用户需直接与以太坊桥合约交互才能转移资产。
threads.latest_update_en:
Blast announced on X that its L2 network has formally shut down. Users still holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, in pending withdrawals, or in Blast Mobile can reclaim their assets through the Blast official website, which will remain available for 12 months with a final support date of November 4, 2027.

The asset-recovery site is time-limited, with November 4, 2027 set as the last supported date. Earlier reporting indicated that Blast's standard withdrawal interface closed on October 26, after which users must interact directly with Ethereum bridge contracts to move assets.
threads.background_zh: Blast 是由 Paradigm 支持的以太坊 Layer 2，巅峰时期网络锁仓价值约 23 亿美元。据 Decrypt 报道，团队表示运营该网络的成本高于其收入，且没有可信的可持续路径，因此决定逐步关停。
threads.background_en: Blast was a Paradigm-backed Ethereum layer-2 that at its peak held roughly $2.3 billion in value. According to Decrypt, the team said running the network cost more than it earned and that it had no credible path to sustainability, which led to the wind-down.

资产取回网站设有明确期限，2027 年 11 月 4 日为最后支持日期。此前的报道称，Blast 的标准提现界面已于 10 月 26 日关闭，此后用户需直接与以太坊桥合约交互才能转移资产。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Blast announced on X that its L2 network has formally shut down. Users still holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, in pending withdrawals, or in Blast Mobile can reclaim their assets through the Blast official website, which will remain available for 12 months with a final support date of November 4, 2027.

The asset-recovery site is time-limited, with November 4, 2027 set as the last supported date. Earlier reporting indicated that Blast's standard withdrawal interface closed on October 26, after which users must interact directly with Ethereum bridge contracts to move assets.
threads.market_impact_zh: 关停将把 Blast L2 中残留的 ETH 与稳定币流动性转移回以太坊主网或其他竞争性 L2，资产在取回过程中需经由桥合约流转。由于 Blast 团队自认其经济模型不可持续，此事也会加剧市场对 L2 代币与激励模式的重新评估。
threads.market_impact_en: The closure shifts any residual ETH and stablecoin liquidity out of Blast's L2 and back toward Ethereum mainnet or competing L2s, with assets routed through the bridge contracts during recovery. It also feeds the broader reassessment of L2 token and incentive models, since Blast's economics were judged unsustainable by its own team.

timeline.text_en:
Blast announced on X that its L2 network has formally shut down. Users still holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, in pending withdrawals, or in Blast Mobile can reclaim their assets through the Blast official website, which will remain available for 12 months with a final support date of November 4, 2027.

The asset-recovery site is time-limited, with November 4, 2027 set as the last supported date. Earlier reporting indicated that Blast's standard withdrawal interface closed on October 26, after which users must interact directly with Ethereum bridge contracts to move assets.

timeline.text_zh: 10月26日常规提现界面截止日期已过，Blast以太坊桥中仍有约4041万美元资产待提取，较10月2日约6350万美元下降约36%；用户需直接与桥接合约交互进行提现，不再依赖常规网站界面。
timeline.text_en: The standard withdrawal interface deadline passed on Oct 26, with about $40.41 million still in Blast's Ethereum bridge, down about 36% from ~$63.5 million on Oct 2; users must now withdraw by interacting directly with bridge contracts rather than the regular website interface.

timeline.text_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
timeline.text_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.

timeline.text_zh: Upbit 宣布将下架 Blast（BLAST），并在相关网络转换期间暂停提现。
timeline.text_en: Upbit announced it will delist Blast (BLAST) from its platform and halt withdrawals during the associated network conversion.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日发布状态更新，确认 Blast 网络正在被项目团队关停，并要求用户必须在 2026 年 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出 Coinbase，否则网络关停后将无法访问这些资产；媒体报道称 Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase posted a status update on Oct 7 confirming the Blast network is being shut down by the project team and requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase before Oct 26, 2026, or lose access after shutdown; media reports say Coinbase will suspend BLAST trading on Oct 20.

timeline.text_zh:
由 NFT 交易市场 Blur 团队推出的以太坊 Layer 2 网络 Blast 宣布关停。其总锁仓量（TVL）已从巅峰约 22 亿美元跌至约 3200 万美元。

此次关停意味着 2024 年最受追捧的 Layer 2 项目之一正式落幕，用户需在截止期限前将剩余资金撤出该网络。

团队表示，该网络的运营成本高于其收入，且看不到弥合这一缺口的现实路径。有报道称用户须在 10 月 26 日前完成提款，而相关资金存放于由三名密钥持有者控制的合约中。
timeline.text_en: Blast has announced it is shutting down, with its total value locked collapsing from a peak of about $2.2 billion to roughly $32 million.

timeline.text_zh: 在 Blast 停运公告后，Upbit 与 Bithumb 将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；BLAST 24 小时跌超 27%。
timeline.text_en: After the Blast shutdown announcement, Upbit and Bithumb added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; BLAST fell over 27% in 24 hours.

timeline.text_zh: 在 Blast 基金会宣布计划终止主网运营后，Bithumb 将 BLAST 列入交易警示名单并暂停充值，预计将在 10 月第三周决定是否下架。
timeline.text_en: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.

timeline.text_zh: Blast 宣布将关闭其 L2，原因是维护成本超过收入，并告知用户在 2026 年 10 月 26 日之前通过常规界面将资产提取至以太坊主网，此后提款需直接与 L1 桥合约交互。
timeline.text_en: Blast announced it is shutting down its L2 because maintenance costs exceed revenue, telling users to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the normal interface before October 26, 2026, after which withdrawals require direct interaction with the L1 bridge contract.

threads.title_zh: 三星钱包面向美国Galaxy用户上线USDC稳定币账户
threads.title_en: Samsung Wallet launches USDC stablecoin accounts for U.S. Galaxy users
threads.summary_zh: Samsung Wallet 已面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户上线稳定币账户，支持在 Solana 上使用 USDC，覆盖约8200万台兼容设备；该服务由 Bastion 和 Coinbase 提供托管与基础设施，支持向兼容钱包转账以及60多个国家的银行账户提现，并计划未来探索稳定币支付和更多市场。
threads.summary_en: Samsung Wallet has launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices; the service uses Bastion and Coinbase for custody/infrastructure, supports transfers to compatible wallets and bank payouts in 60+ countries, and Samsung plans to explore stablecoin payments and additional markets.
threads.latest_update_zh: Samsung Wallet 的稳定币账户已在美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户中上线，支持在 Solana 上买卖、持有、发送和接收 USDC；此前状态仍为10月宣布的待上线计划。新报道还补充了信用卡充值4%手续费、纽约州不可用、Android 13及以上、25美元USDC新手奖励等实施细节。
threads.latest_update_en: Samsung Wallet stablecoin accounts went live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting buy, hold, send, and receive of USDC on Solana; the prior state was an announced plan expected in late October. The report also adds implementation details: 4% credit-card top-up fee, unavailable in New York, Android 13+, and a $25 USDC new-user bonus.
threads.background_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在相对于某一参考资产（最常见的是美元等法定货币）保持价值稳定的加密货币，依靠储备资产或算法机制实现，但顾名思义，稳定币并不总能维持锚定。Samsung Wallet 是三星在 Galaxy 设备上的移动钱包，此前主要用于支付卡、票券与数字钥匙，而非加密资产转账。随着交易规模上升，稳定币的发行与使用在全球各地日益受到监管关注。
threads.background_en: A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly a fiat currency such as the US dollar, using reserve assets or algorithmic mechanisms; despite the name, stablecoins have not always held their peg. Samsung Wallet is Samsung's mobile wallet on Galaxy devices, which has primarily handled payment cards, passes and keys rather than crypto transfers. Stablecoin issuance and usage have increasingly drawn regulatory attention across jurisdictions as transaction volumes have grown.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Samsung Wallet launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, enabling fee-free buy, hold, send and receive of USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices via custodian Bastion and Coinbase, with bank payouts in over 60 countries.
threads.latest_summary_en: Samsung Wallet launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, enabling fee-free buy, hold, send and receive of USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices via custodian Bastion and Coinbase, with bank payouts in over 60 countries.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是消费者分发与托管：在一款大众市场的手机厂商钱包中嵌入美元稳定币转账，可能拓宽美元稳定币的零售入口，并使部分点对点支付流量从加密原生应用分流，实际影响规模取决于最终支持的代币、费用与覆盖地区。受影响最直接的板块包括美元稳定币发行方、争夺同一 Galaxy 用户群的移动钱包与支付服务商，以及三星自身的设备服务生态。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is consumer distribution and custody: embedding dollar stablecoin transfers in a mass-market OEM wallet could widen the retail on-ramp for dollar stablecoins and shift some peer-to-peer payment flows away from crypto-native apps, with the scale of any effect depending on which tokens, fees and geographies are ultimately supported. Segments most directly exposed are dollar stablecoin issuers, mobile wallet and payments providers competing for the same Galaxy user base, and Samsung's own device-services ecosystem.

timeline.text_zh: Samsung Wallet 的稳定币账户已在美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户中上线，支持在 Solana 上买卖、持有、发送和接收 USDC；此前状态仍为10月宣布的待上线计划。新报道还补充了信用卡充值4%手续费、纽约州不可用、Android 13及以上、25美元USDC新手奖励等实施细节。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Wallet stablecoin accounts went live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting buy, hold, send, and receive of USDC on Solana; the prior state was an announced plan expected in late October. The report also adds implementation details: 4% credit-card top-up fee, unavailable in New York, Android 13+, and a $25 USDC new-user bonus.

timeline.text_zh:
三星宣布，Samsung Wallet 将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问，把美元支持的加密资产带给主流智能手机用户群体。相关报道将该功能描述为支持 USDC，使美国 Galaxy 用户可以将资金转入银行账户和加密钱包，并计划未来扩展到更多国家。

此举通过一家全球大型设备厂商，把美元支持的稳定币直接呈现在大众智能手机用户面前，形成了一条与加密原生应用和交易所不同的消费者触达渠道。

该消息停留在标题层面的承诺；有关此次整合的报道指出，稳定币发行方、完整支持代币清单等多项实施细节尚未披露。搜索摘录还提到，该功能初期仅面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户，未来将扩展至更多国家。
timeline.text_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充：USDC 转账功能将允许美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户向兼容钱包发送 USDC，并通过 Bastion 基础设施在 60 多个国家提现至银行账户；覆盖美国 8200 万台兼容 Galaxy 设备，用户需完成身份验证；Solana 和 Sui 被列为技术合作伙伴；向外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费因目的地和金额而异；Borderless.xyz 负责 60 多国的支付；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。
timeline.text_en: New report adds: USDC transfers will let eligible US Galaxy users send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui named as technical partners; no fee for USDC transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees varying by destination and amount; Borderless.xyz handles payouts in 60+ countries; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase宣布，自2026年10月最后一周起，USDC将成为三星Wallet美国用户默认的美元稳定币，并通过Coinbase Prime进行合规托管（符合NYDFS要求），Bastion提供支持。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase announced that from the last week of October 2026, USDC will become the default dollar stablecoin for US users of Samsung Wallet, with custody via Coinbase Prime under NYDFS-compliant qualified custody, supported by Bastion.

timeline.text_zh: Samsung Wallet 将具体在10月底添加 Sui 上的 USDC，由 Bastion 和 Coinbase 提供托管，并在60多个国家支持银行账户转账（单独收费）。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Wallet will specifically add USDC on Sui in late October, with Bastion and Coinbase providing custody and bank-account transfers in more than 60 countries (separate fees).

timeline.text_zh: 三星与Solana达成合作，将基于Solana的USDC稳定币支付引入其美国三星钱包用户，覆盖8200万台Galaxy设备，从10月最后一周起支持跨境汇款。
timeline.text_en: Samsung has partnered with Solana to bring Solana-based USDC stablecoin payments to its US Samsung Wallet users across 82 million Galaxy devices, enabling cross-border remittances starting in the final week of October.

timeline.text_zh: 三星宣布，三星钱包将为美国符合条件的Galaxy用户提供稳定币访问，将稳定币支付与持有扩展至主流消费硬件用户群体。
timeline.text_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin payments/holding to a mainstream consumer hardware audience.

threads.title_zh: Zcash NU7治理获批并确定主网激活高度
threads.title_en: Zcash NU7 governance approved and mainnet activation height set
threads.summary_zh: NU7主网升级处于激活前最后阶段：计划在区块3,543,405（美东周四晚约9:30）激活，届时禁用版本4交易、冻结Sprout池约12,226枚ZEC（约1600万美元）并将目标出块时间缩短至25秒；实际激活时间可能推迟至周五亚洲时段。
threads.summary_en: Zcash NU7 mainnet upgrade is in its final pre-activation stage: planned to activate at block 3,543,405 around 9:30 p.m. ET Thursday, disabling version-4 transactions, freezing about 12,226 ZEC (~$16M) in the Sprout pool, and cutting the target block time to 25 seconds; actual activation may slip into Friday Asia hours.
threads.latest_update_zh: 截至11月5日，Sprout隐私池仍有约12,226枚ZEC（约1600万美元）待NU7激活后永久冻结；升级预计于美东周四晚约9:30在区块3,543,405激活，实际时间可能因出块速度推迟。
threads.latest_update_en: As of Nov. 5, about 12,226 ZEC (~$16M) remained in the Sprout shielded pool and would be permanently frozen after NU7 activation; the upgrade was expected to activate around 9:30 p.m. ET Thursday at block 3,543,405, with timing potentially slipping based on block production.
threads.background_zh: NU7 是 Zcash 的第七次网络升级。若如其预期包含重大共识变更，zcashd 将不支持该升级，运营方需要迁移至 Zcash 基金会开发的 Zebra 共识节点。Sprout 是 Zcash 最早的隐私支付系统，而「网络可持续性机制」针对的是 Zcash 在 2100 万枚供应上限下依赖区块奖励维持网络安全这一问题。
threads.background_en: NU7 is Zcash's seventh network upgrade. If it includes major consensus changes as expected, it will not be supported by zcashd, so operators need to upgrade to the Zebra consensus node developed by the Zcash Foundation. Sprout is Zcash's oldest private-payment system, and the Network Sustainability Mechanism is aimed at the fact that Zcash's network security is funded by block rewards under a 21 million coin supply cap.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Zcash's NU7 upgrade will stop accepting version-4 transactions, permanently freezing the ~12,226 ZEC (~$16M) remaining in the legacy Sprout shielded pool and shortening block times from 75 to 25 seconds.
threads.latest_summary_en: Zcash's NU7 upgrade will stop accepting version-4 transactions, permanently freezing the ~12,226 ZEC (~$16M) remaining in the legacy Sprout shielded pool and shortening block times from 75 to 25 seconds.
threads.market_impact_zh: ZEC 是直接受影响的资产，传导路径主要通过交易平台入账与钱包基础设施——目标出块间隔缩短会改变上币与结算平台的确认等待时间。Sprout 池停用以及 60% 手续费转入储备，也会影响流通供应与矿工收入结构；仍运行 zcashd 相关软件的运营方需要兼容节点才能跟随升级后的链。
threads.market_impact_en: ZEC is the directly exposed asset, with transmission running through exchange deposit-crediting and wallet infrastructure, since a shorter target block interval changes confirmation waits for venues that list and settle the coin. The Sprout cut-off and the redirection of 60% of transaction fees into a reserve also alter circulating-supply and miner-revenue mechanics, and operators running zcashd-based software would need compatible nodes to follow the upgraded chain.

reference_links.title: Network Upgrade 7 - Z.Cash
Zcash News: NU7 Upgrade Targets 25-Second Blocks for ZEC
ZIP 234: Network Sustainability Mechanism: Issuance Smoothing

timeline.text_zh: 截至11月5日，Sprout隐私池仍有约12,226枚ZEC（约1600万美元）待NU7激活后永久冻结；升级预计于美东周四晚约9:30在区块3,543,405激活，实际时间可能因出块速度推迟。
timeline.text_en: As of Nov. 5, about 12,226 ZEC (~$16M) remained in the Sprout shielded pool and would be permanently frozen after NU7 activation; the upgrade was expected to activate around 9:30 p.m. ET Thursday at block 3,543,405, with timing potentially slipping based on block production.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 开发者将 NU7 主网激活高度定为区块 3,543,405，目标时间约为 11 月 5 日，ZEC 同期上涨约 12%。
timeline.text_en: Zcash developers set the NU7 mainnet activation height at block 3,543,405, targeted for around Nov. 5, as ZEC rallied about 12%.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 开发者选定区块 3,543,405 作为 NU7 的激活点，时间约在 11 月 5 日，届时将引入 25 秒出块时间、暂时扣留 60% 的交易手续费，并永久关闭 Sprout 隐私池。
timeline.text_en: Zcash developers selected block 3,543,405 for NU7 activation around November 5, introducing 25-second block times, temporarily withholding 60% of transaction fees, and permanently shutting down the Sprout privacy pool.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 开发者 Sean Bowe 于 10 月 20 日提交 NU7 主网激活提案，将激活区块高度定为 3,543,405（预计 11 月 5 日左右），该提案已在 ZIP 编辑会议上获同意并取得两项批准，但尚未合并至部署规范，激活高度还需加入节点软件后方可生效。
timeline.text_en: Zcash developer Sean Bowe submitted the NU7 mainnet activation proposal on Oct. 20, setting the activation block height at 3,543,405 (~Nov. 5); the proposal was agreed at the ZIP editors meeting and has received two approvals, but has not yet been merged into the deployment spec, and the activation height still needs to be added to node software before taking effect.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 的 NU7 升级已在公共测试网上激活，区块目标时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，比原计划提前；60% 的交易手续费被转入未来挖矿奖励储备；旧版 Sprout 隐私系统被禁用。主网计划于 11 月 5 日启动，开发者将于 10 月 20 日审查测试结果后决定激活。
timeline.text_en: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on public testnet, cutting target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds ahead of schedule; 60% of transaction fees redirected to a future mining reward reserve; legacy Sprout privacy system disabled. Mainnet planned for Nov. 5, with developers to review test results and decide on activation Oct. 20.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash 已在测试网区块高度 4,465,026 激活 NU7 升级（该高度于 10 月 4 日 18:21:45 UTC 完成出块），比原计划的 10 月 6 日测试网上线提前落地，实测 25 秒目标出块间隔、禁用版本 4 交易并引入手续费重定向的网络可持续性机制。
timeline.text_en: Zcash activated NU7 on testnet at block height 4,465,026 (mined Oct. 4 at 18:21:45 UTC), landing ahead of the previously scheduled Oct. 6 testnet launch, with live testing of the 25-second target block interval, version 4 transaction disablement, and the fee-redirecting Network Sustainability Mechanism.

timeline.text_zh: NU7 升级将依据 ZIP-2003 禁用版本 4 交易，导致遗留 Sprout 屏蔽池中的 ZEC 在升级后无法花费；社区成员和 Zcash 联合创始人 Zooko Wilcox 警告持币者尽快迁移资金，但提案并未销毁这些资金，未来仍有可能恢复访问。
timeline.text_en: NU7 will disable version 4 transactions under ZIP-2003, making ZEC in the legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable after the upgrade; community members and Zcash co-founder Zooko Wilcox warned holders to move funds, though the proposal does not burn the funds and leaves open the possibility of restoring access later.

timeline.text_zh: 开发者透露 NU7 测试网将于 10 月 6 日上线，主网激活高度将于 10 月 20 日确定，规范于 9 月 30 日前发布；ZIP 218 将每块奖励除以约三倍以保持每日发行量不变；98.9% 的持币者投票支持保留减半机制；网络可持续机制将从 2026 年开始将约 60% 的交易费用存入，并于 2031 年 2 月开始作为补充挖矿奖励发放。
timeline.text_en: Developers revealed NU7 testnet on Oct. 6, mainnet activation height set on Oct. 20, specs due by Sept. 30; ZIP 218 divides per-block reward by ~3 to keep daily issuance unchanged; 98.9% of coinholders voted to keep halvings; Network Sustainability Mechanism will bank ~60% of transaction fees starting 2026, flowing back as supplemental mining rewards in Feb. 2031.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash开发者已一致同意将NU7主网升级的目标日期定在11月5日，该升级将把出块时间缩短至25秒，禁用版本4交易，并整合网络可持续性机制，同时保留减半时间表。
timeline.text_en: Zcash developers have reached unanimous agreement to target November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade, which will cut block times to 25 seconds, disable version 4 transactions, and integrate the Network Sustainability Mechanism while preserving the halving schedule.

timeline.text_zh: Zcash持有者以压倒性多数批准了NU7治理措施，包括25秒出块时间、保留比特币式减半时间表、将网络可持续机制费用重新发行推迟至2031年，以及禁用过时的Sprout交易。
timeline.text_en: Zcash holders approved NU7 governance measures with overwhelming majorities, including 25-second block times, preserving the bitcoin-style halving schedule, delaying Network Sustainability Mechanism fee reissuance until 2031, and disabling obsolete Sprout transactions.

threads.title_zh: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%
threads.title_en: 英伟达暴跌7.3%，纳指狂泄超千点，美股恐慌指数VIX波动率日内涨40%
threads.summary_zh: 11月5日美股广泛抛售持续并加深，标普500跌幅扩大至4%，纳指跌超5%，纳斯达克100指数跌超6%，道指跌超3%，半导体指数跌超10%。
threads.summary_en: The broad November 5 US equity selloff continued and deepened, with the S&P 500 down 4%, the Nasdaq down more than 5%, the Nasdaq 100 down over 6%, the Dow down more than 3%, and the semiconductor index down more than 10%.
threads.latest_update_zh: 11月5日美股抛售进一步加深，标普500跌幅扩大至4%，纳指跌超5%，纳斯达克100指数跌超6%，道指跌超3%，半导体指数跌超10%。
threads.latest_update_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened further: the S&P 500 fell 4%, the Nasdaq dropped more than 5%, the Nasdaq 100 fell over 6%, the Dow lost more than 3%, and the semiconductor index fell more than 10%.
threads.latest_summary_zh: US stocks sold off sharply, with the S&P 500 down 4%, the Nasdaq down more than 5%, the Dow down over 3%, and the semiconductor index plunging more than 10%.
threads.latest_summary_en: US stocks sold off sharply, with the S&P 500 down 4%, the Nasdaq down more than 5%, the Dow down over 3%, and the semiconductor index plunging more than 10%.

timeline.text_zh: 11月5日美股抛售进一步加深，标普500跌幅扩大至4%，纳指跌超5%，纳斯达克100指数跌超6%，道指跌超3%，半导体指数跌超10%。
timeline.text_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened further: the S&P 500 fell 4%, the Nasdaq dropped more than 5%, the Nasdaq 100 fell over 6%, the Dow lost more than 3%, and the semiconductor index fell more than 10%.

timeline.text_zh: 美股广泛抛售中，开盘一小时内总市值蒸发约2.3万亿美元；标普500盘中最低约7394点、跌约3.83%，较既有报道的3.57%进一步扩大。
timeline.text_en: In the broad US equity selloff, about $2.3 trillion in market value was erased within the first hour; the S&P 500 hit an intraday low of about 7,394, down about 3.83%, deeper than the previously reported 3.57%.

timeline.text_zh: 费城半导体指数最新下跌11.48%，报道称或将创2020年3月以来最大单日跌幅；希捷、西部数据、美光、英特尔等半导体与存储股亦出现两位数或接近两位数下跌。
timeline.text_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was latest down 11.48%, with the report saying it may mark its biggest one-day drop since March 2020; Seagate, Western Digital, Micron, Intel and other chip and storage stocks also fell sharply.

timeline.text_zh: 11月5日美股抛售进一步加深，VIX大涨62.73%至27.03点，盘中最高触及27.03点；纳指跌5.35%，标普500跌3.57%，道指跌2.38%。
timeline.text_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened further: the VIX surged 62.73% to 27.03, hitting an intraday high of 27.03; the Nasdaq fell 5.35%, the S&P 500 lost 3.57%, and the Dow dropped 2.38%.

timeline.text_zh: 11月5日抛售进一步扩大：标普500跌幅扩大至3%，道指跌2%，纳指跌超4.8%，费城半导体指数跌超10%；英伟达跌超8%，AMD跌15.6%，闪迪跌19.4%。
timeline.text_en: The November 5 selloff widened further: the S&P 500 fell 3%, the Dow lost 2%, the Nasdaq dropped over 4.8%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell more than 10%; Nvidia lost over 8%, AMD fell 15.6%, and SanDisk fell 19.4%.

timeline.text_zh: 11月5日美股抛售加深：纳指100跌幅扩大至5.1%，标普500下跌2.8%；两大指数跌至7月下旬以来最低，并势将创五个月来最大单日跌幅。
timeline.text_en: The November 5 US equity selloff deepened: Nasdaq 100 fell 5.1% and the S&P 500 lost 2.8%; both indices reached their lowest levels since late July and were on track for their biggest single-day losses in five months.

timeline.text_zh: 11 月 5 日美股大幅下跌，英伟达跌 7.3%，纳斯达克跌超 3.9%，VIX 盘中飙升 40%，市场出现广泛避险抛售。
timeline.text_en: US stocks fell sharply on November 5, with Nvidia dropping 7.3%, the Nasdaq losing over 3.9%, and the VIX surging 40% intraday amid a broad risk-off selloff.

threads.title_zh: Liquid Network 遭约3.2亿美元比特币提取后暂停并恢复出块
threads.title_en: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin
threads.summary_zh: Liquid 比特币储备已全部恢复，LBTC 恢复 1:1 BTC 全额支撑，用户可通过参与互换的服务商按 1:1 进行 BTC↔Liquid 转移；公告未明确说明联盟直接 peg-out 或 PAK 密钥持有者兑出是否已完全恢复正常。
threads.summary_en: Liquid's bitcoin reserves are fully restored and LBTC is again fully backed 1:1 by BTC; users can move BTC↔Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers. The announcement did not explicitly confirm whether direct federation peg-outs or normal PAK key holder redemption access are fully restored.
threads.latest_update_zh: Liquid Federation 于 11 月 3 日宣布网络比特币储备已全部恢复，所有流通 LBTC 重新获得 1:1 BTC 支撑；用户可通过参与互换的服务商按 1:1 在比特币与 Liquid 之间转移。
threads.latest_update_en: On November 3, the Liquid Federation announced that the network's bitcoin reserves were fully restored, re-establishing 1:1 BTC backing for all circulating LBTC; users can again move between bitcoin and Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers.
threads.background_zh: Liquid 是基于 Elements 构建的联邦式比特币侧链与二层网络，通过 1:1 双向锚定与比特币连接：主链上每锁定一枚比特币，Liquid 上便铸造等量 LBTC，赎回时 LBTC 被销毁。该网络由 Liquid Federation 治理，成员包括交易所、基础设施公司与资产管理机构等分布在全球的比特币生态参与者。
threads.background_en: Liquid is a federated Bitcoin sidechain and layer-2 built on Elements, connected to Bitcoin through a 1:1 two-way peg: for every bitcoin locked on the main chain an equivalent amount of LBTC is minted on Liquid, and LBTC is destroyed on peg-out. The network is governed by the Liquid Federation, a globally distributed group of bitcoin-focused members including exchanges, infrastructure firms and asset managers.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
11 月 3 日，Liquid Federation 宣布网络比特币储备已全部恢复，为全部 LBTC 重新确立 1:1 的 BTC 支撑。用户已可通过参与互换的服务商，按 1:1 比例在比特币与 Liquid 之间转移。

此次公告重新确立了此前因储备缺口而受影响的 1:1 锚定关系，使流通中的 LBTC 恢复全额支撑，并重新开放用户按 1:1 进行 BTC 与 Liquid 之间的转移。

据援引 Liquid Federation 的报道，储备可通过节点校验和公共数据面板公开验证。公告未披露缺口规模及补救过程。
threads.latest_summary_en:
On November 3, the Liquid Federation announced that the network's Bitcoin reserves have been fully restored, re-establishing 1:1 BTC backing for all LBTC. Users can again move between bitcoin and Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers.

The announcement re-establishes the 1:1 peg that had been disrupted by a reserve shortfall, restoring full backing for LBTC in circulation and reopening 1:1 BTC↔Liquid transfers for users.

According to reports citing the Federation, the reserves can be publicly verified through node checks and a public dashboard. The announcement did not disclose the size of the shortfall or the remediation process.
threads.market_impact_zh: LBTC 是 Liquid 上用于资产发行与交易的比特币计价资产，因此储备全额恢复主要影响赎回风险，以及持有者、互换服务商和以 BTC 计价 LBTC 的平台的定价。该公告解决的是支撑与兑付信心问题，而非引入新的流动性或功能。
threads.market_impact_en: LBTC is used as the bitcoin-denominated asset on Liquid for issuance and trading venues, so full restoration of reserves mainly affects peg-out risk and pricing for holders, swap providers and platforms that quote LBTC against BTC. The announcement addresses backing and redemption confidence rather than introducing new liquidity or capability.

timeline.text_zh: Liquid Federation 于 11 月 3 日宣布网络比特币储备已全部恢复，所有流通 LBTC 重新获得 1:1 BTC 支撑；用户可通过参与互换的服务商按 1:1 在比特币与 Liquid 之间转移。
timeline.text_en: On November 3, the Liquid Federation announced that the network's bitcoin reserves were fully restored, re-establishing 1:1 BTC backing for all circulating LBTC; users can again move between bitcoin and Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers.

timeline.text_zh: Liquid Network 宣布进入恢复最后阶段：已完成管理比特币储备的联盟节点软件升级，并正与兑换服务商协调重新开放半自动化 BTC/LBTC 兑换，且不设协议层面额度限制；但联盟直接 peg-out 仍受限，需待 1:1 比特币储备重建并为 PAK 密钥持有者恢复兑出功能。
timeline.text_en: Liquid Network announced it entered the final recovery stage: it upgraded federation node software managing bitcoin reserves and is coordinating with swap providers to reopen semi-automated BTC/LBTC conversions without protocol-level limits; however, direct federation peg-outs remain restricted until 1:1 bitcoin backing is rebuilt and PAK key holders regain normal peg-out access.

timeline.text_zh: 储备覆盖率更新为85.8%，缺口约603 BTC；Liquid 表示锚定退出需完全背书并完成安全审查后方可重启。
timeline.text_en: Reserve coverage updated to 85.8%, shortfall ~603 BTC; Liquid says peg-outs require full backing and completed security reviews before restart.

timeline.text_zh: SideSwap 在 Liquid 恢复区块生产后重新开放了 L-BTC 市场，但联邦锚定退出仍暂停；9月10日数据显示储备仅覆盖约85.15%的L-BTC供应，缺口约627 BTC。
timeline.text_en: SideSwap reopened L-BTC markets after Liquid resumed block production, but federation peg-outs remain suspended; Sept. 10 data shows reserves cover only ~85.15% of L-BTC supply, a ~627 BTC shortfall.

timeline.text_zh:
Liquid Network 在部署紧急软件更新后于周四恢复出块，但作为预防措施，交易与锚定（peg）操作仍然暂停，网络正在被持续监控以确认完全稳定。此次重启源于 9 月 6 日的事件：约 4,000 枚 BTC（价值约 3.2 亿美元）通过 Elements 软件中的一个漏洞从该网络的联合钱包中被提取。

Liquid 是规模最大、运行时间最长的比特币侧链之一，这次提取掏空了其联合钱包约 95% 的余额，暴露出联邦式跨链桥设计中高度集中的信任如何转化为系统性风险。事件直接波及 L-BTC 持有者、在 Liquid 上发行代币化资产与稳定币的机构，以及依赖其进行结算的交易所和做市商。

攻击者利用了 Elements 范围证明（range proof）验证缓存中的漏洞，铸造出约 4,000 枚无真实背书的 L-BTC，随后通过 SideSwap 的授权退出锚定路径兑换为真实 BTC。紧急补丁 Elements v23.3.4 加固了范围证明所使用的缓存键；在受影响桥节点完成修补后，3,400 枚 BTC（约 2.7 亿美元）被归还，截至 9 月 7 日仍有约 598 枚 BTC（约 4,600 万美元）未追回。
timeline.text_en: The Liquid Network resumed block production after deploying emergency software updates following a $320 million Bitcoin withdrawal exploit, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended during recovery.

timeline.text_zh: 确认了攻击者广播的归还交易已在区块965950中于16:09:25 UTC得到确认，实际返还3,400 BTC至联邦钱包，黑客保留598.5 BTC（约合4700万美元），并在链上留言询问是否可接受。Blockstream状态页面仍显示活动事件和公共桥接节点中断，完整的L-BTC支持和赎回通道尚未恢复。
timeline.text_en: Confirmed that the attacker's broadcast return transaction was confirmed in block 965950 at 16:09:25 UTC, actually returning 3,400 BTC to the federation wallet, while the hacker retained approximately 598.5 BTC (~$47 million), with an on-chain message asking 'is that ok.' Blockstream's status page still lists an active incident and major outage affecting public bridge nodes; full L-BTC backing and redemption access are not yet restored.

timeline.text_zh: 攻击者广播了一笔交易，将3,400 BTC返还给Liquid联邦钱包，同时保留598.50 BTC；该交易尚未确认且标记为可替换，双方均未公开关于此次分拆的说明。
timeline.text_en: The attacker broadcast a transaction returning 3,400 BTC to the Liquid federation wallet while keeping 598.50 BTC; the transaction is unconfirmed and flagged as replaceable, and neither side has published anything about the split.

timeline.text_zh: 研究人员怀疑Liquid侧链中的验证缓存缺陷允许无支持的L-BTC兑换为真实BTC，提供了更具体的攻击机制解释，包括缓存键碰撞让无效交易绕过range-proof检查，并报告了节点分裂的可能原因。
timeline.text_en: Researchers suspect a validation cache flaw in the Liquid sidechain allowed unbacked L-BTC to be redeemed for real Bitcoin, providing a more specific explanation of the attack mechanism, including a cache-key collision that let invalid transactions bypass range-proof checks, and reporting a possible node split.

timeline.text_zh: 详细披露了攻击手法：攻击者利用Elements软件中的校验漏洞，通过SideSwap的PAK授权从联邦钱包中提取了约4000 BTC，绕过了紧急备用密钥路径，所有输入均使用11/15签名成功完成交易。
timeline.text_en: Detailed the attack method: the attacker exploited a validation flaw in the Elements software, using SideSwap's PAK authorization to withdraw ~4,000 BTC from the federation wallet, bypassing the emergency backup key path, with all inputs spending 11 of the 15 required signatures.

timeline.text_zh: 白帽黑客通过链上消息与 Blockstream 进行联系，并承诺在漏洞修复及节点更新后归还大部分比特币，但目前资金尚未归还。同时披露了更多谈判细节。
timeline.text_en: White-hat hackers contacted Blockstream via on-chain messages, promising to return most of the Bitcoin after the vulnerability is patched and nodes updated; funds have not yet been returned. Additional negotiation details were disclosed.

threads.title_zh: ZetaChain 持有人批准逐步关停 L1、将 ZETA 迁移至 Solana 的计划
threads.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
threads.summary_zh: ZetaChain 的72小时治理投票正在进行并将于11月7日结束；若通过，Layer 1 主网将在12月9日左右永久停止出块，ZETA 按1:1迁移为 Solana SPL 代币，同时推出隐私AI应用 ZetaLabs，并在2027年分批销毁约5500万枚原验证者奖励ZETA。
threads.summary_en: ZetaChain's 72-hour governance vote is ongoing and concludes on November 7; if passed, Layer 1 block production will permanently halt around December 9, ZETA will migrate 1:1 to a Solana SPL token, ZetaLabs will launch, and about 55 million ZETA originally allocated for validator rewards will be burned in batches throughout 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新披露该治理提案还计划在2027年分批销毁约5500万枚原用于验证者奖励的ZETA，并明确投票于11月7日结束。
threads.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed that the governance proposal also plans to burn approximately 55 million ZETA originally allocated for validator rewards in batches throughout 2027, and specifies voting concludes on November 7.
threads.background_zh: ZetaChain 基于 Cosmos SDK 和 Tendermint 共识构建，并包含一个兼容以太坊虚拟机的执行层 zEVM，定位为支持全链（omnichain）智能合约和跨链消息传递的基础层。Anuma 是同一团队的私密 AI 聊天产品，它会为用户对话建立加密记忆，数据保存在用户设备上并可跨不同 AI 模型使用。Solana 是一条高吞吐量的 Layer 1，SPL 是其原生代币标准，因此 ZETA 迁移意味着在 Solana 上发行该资产并在原链上将其退出。
threads.background_en: ZetaChain was built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint consensus and included an Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible execution layer called zEVM, positioning itself as a base layer for omnichain smart contracts and cross-chain messaging between otherwise separate networks. Anuma is the same team's private AI chat product, which builds an encrypted memory of a user's conversations that stays on the user's device and travels across different AI models. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1, and SPL is its native token standard, so migrating ZETA means issuing the asset on Solana and retiring it on its original chain.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ZetaChain opened an onchain governance vote to permanently stop Layer 1 block production on December 9 and migrate native ZETA 1:1 to Solana as an SPL token, alongside launching a privacy-focused AI app (ZetaLabs) and burning roughly 55 million ZETA earmarked for validator rewards throughout 2027.
threads.latest_summary_en: ZetaChain opened an onchain governance vote to permanently stop Layer 1 block production on December 9 and migrate native ZETA 1:1 to Solana as an SPL token, alongside launching a privacy-focused AI app (ZetaLabs) and burning roughly 55 million ZETA earmarked for validator rewards throughout 2027.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。
threads.market_impact_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.

timeline.text_en: Newly disclosed that the governance proposal also plans to burn approximately 55 million ZETA originally allocated for validator rewards in batches throughout 2027, and specifies voting concludes on November 7.

timeline.text_zh: ZetaChain 已开启为期72小时的治理投票，拟在区块高度 20,755,000（约12月9日）永久停止 Layer 1 主网，并将原生 ZETA 按1:1迁移至 Solana；同时披露迁移快照范围、自托管用户迁移门户（须经 Hacken 审计后开放）、合约/流动性池仓位须在快照前退出，以及计划于12月9日推出 AI 应用 ZetaLabs。
timeline.text_en: ZetaChain opened a 72-hour governance vote to permanently halt its Layer 1 mainnet at block 20,755,000 (around Dec 9) and migrate native ZETA 1:1 to Solana; it also disclosed the migration snapshot scope, a Hacken-audited migration portal for self-custody holders, required pre-snapshot exits for contract/liquidity-pool positions, and a planned Dec 9 launch of AI app ZetaLabs.

timeline.text_zh: 交易所必须确认 ZETA 至 Solana 的置换后，第二次治理投票才会确定快照、代币申领和关停时间表。
timeline.text_en: Exchanges must confirm the ZETA-to-Solana swap before a second governance vote sets the snapshot, token claims, and shutdown schedule.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：治理提案第68号以99.4%支持和58%参与率通过，超过40%法定人数；ZETA将以1:1兑换为Solana SPL代币并保留代码和总供应量；投票不会立即触发关停或迁移，核心贡献者将提交第二份提案说明提款窗口、快照区块高度、关停时间表、代币申领流程和交易所转换期。
timeline.text_en: Added details: governance proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation, exceeding the 40% quorum; ZETA will become a Solana SPL token via 1:1 conversion with same ticker and total supply; the vote does not immediately trigger shutdown or migration, and core contributors will submit a second proposal detailing the withdrawal window, snapshot block height, shutdown timetable, token claim process, and exchange conversion period.

timeline.text_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有者投票决定关闭该项目的 Layer 1 网络，并将 ZETA 资产迁移至 Solana，团队将转向其私有 AI 应用 Anuma，但此次迁移还需再进行一次投票。
timeline.text_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.

threads.title_zh: SpaceX 安排约400亿美元GPU融资，Apollo牵头并签署主租赁协议
threads.title_en: SpaceX arranges ~$40B GPU financing led by Apollo and signs master lease
threads.summary_zh: SpaceX与Apollo安排的约400亿美元GPU/AI芯片融资已进入向投资者推销和银团分销准备阶段：高盛与Apollo开始接触华尔街投资者，部分获邀提前认购最高5亿美元份额，正式银团分销预计很快启动。该结构仍为由Apollo支持实体购买约473亿美元英伟达GPU及相关设备并出租给SpaceX，约400亿美元通过债务融资、约70亿美元由SpaceX预付租赁款；租期约5年，债务含83亿美元优先担保贷款及多档债券，芯片预计2027年上半年交付。
threads.summary_en: The roughly $40 billion SpaceX GPU/AI-chip financing arranged with Apollo has moved into investor marketing and syndication preparation: Goldman and Apollo have begun approaching Wall Street investors, with some invited to subscribe early for up to $500 million ahead of a formal syndication expected soon. The structure remains an Apollo-backed entity buying about $47.3 billion of Nvidia GPUs and related equipment and leasing them to SpaceX, with about $40 billion debt-financed and about $7 billion of SpaceX prepaid lease payments; the lease runs about five years, the debt includes an $8.3 billion senior secured loan and multiple bond tranches, and chips are expected in H1 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: 高盛与Apollo已开始向华尔街投资者推销该约400亿美元SpaceX AI芯片融资，部分投资者获邀提前认购最高5亿美元份额，正式银团分销预计很快启动；报道并披露约473亿美元GPU及相关设备采购、约400亿美元债务融资加约70亿美元SpaceX预付租赁款、约5年租赁期、债务含83亿美元优先担保贷款及多档债券，以及租赁付款无条件且SpaceX不担保芯片残值。
threads.latest_update_en: Goldman and Apollo have begun marketing the roughly $40 billion SpaceX AI-chip financing to Wall Street investors, with some invited to subscribe early for up to $500 million ahead of a formal syndication expected soon; the report also details about $47.3 billion of GPU and related equipment purchases, about $40 billion of debt plus about $7 billion of SpaceX prepaid lease payments, a roughly five-year lease, debt including an $8.3 billion senior secured loan and multiple bond tranches, and unconditional lease payments with no SpaceX residual-value guarantee.
threads.background_zh: 可赎回债务设有固定到期日，发行方须在该日期向持有人偿还本金。随着 AI 算力建设规模扩大，以 GPU 为抵押的贷款以及面向 AI 数据中心的项目级债务已发展为独立的融资渠道，贷款方关注硬件采购承诺、交付时点和交易对手的信用质量。投资级评级通常意味着被评估的违约风险相对较低，从而拓宽此类信贷的可获得性。
threads.background_en: Redeemable debt carries a fixed maturity date on which the issuer must repay the principal to holders. GPU-backed lending and project-level debt for AI data centers have grown into a distinct financing channel as AI compute build-outs scale, with lenders focusing on hardware commitments, delivery timing and counterparty credit quality. An investment-grade rating generally broadens access to such credit by signaling a relatively lower assessed default risk.
threads.latest_summary_zh: 高盛与Apollo已开始向华尔街投资者推销SpaceX约400亿美元的英伟达AI芯片融资方案，并邀请部分投资者提前认购最高5亿美元份额。
threads.latest_summary_en: 高盛与Apollo已开始向华尔街投资者推销SpaceX约400亿美元的英伟达AI芯片融资方案，并邀请部分投资者提前认购最高5亿美元份额。
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道主要经由 AI 算力情绪，而非任何直接的加密场所：若大规模 GPU 采购越来越多地依靠投资级公司债融资，那么有关 AI 资本开支与信贷环境的新闻，就会成为交易者给 AI 相关加密代币和去中心化算力网络定价时更重要的输入变量。该报道未点名任何加密贷款机构、托管方或协议敞口。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through AI-compute sentiment rather than any direct crypto venue: if large GPU purchases are increasingly financed with investment-grade corporate debt, headlines about AI capital expenditure and credit conditions become a bigger input for how traders price AI-adjacent crypto tokens and decentralized compute networks. The report names no crypto lender, custodian or protocol exposure.

timeline.text_en: Goldman and Apollo have begun marketing the roughly $40 billion SpaceX AI-chip financing to Wall Street investors, with some invited to subscribe early for up to $500 million ahead of a formal syndication expected soon; the report also details about $47.3 billion of GPU and related equipment purchases, about $40 billion of debt plus about $7 billion of SpaceX prepaid lease payments, a roughly five-year lease, debt including an $8.3 billion senior secured loan and multiple bond tranches, and unconditional lease payments with no SpaceX residual-value guarantee.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道为同一笔约400亿美元GPU融资补充了关键结构：SpaceX与Apollo管理实体签署约束性承诺函，由该实体购买GPU并租赁给SpaceX；监管文件将其描述为融资租赁，本金约4000亿美元? 不对，约400亿美元，分约五年季度偿还并付固定利率利息，GPU分批到货，租约从2027年上半年开始，主租约预计2026年底前完成。
timeline.text_en: The new report adds key structure to the same roughly $40 billion GPU financing: SpaceX signed a binding commitment letter with an Apollo-managed entity that will buy the GPUs and lease them to SpaceX; the regulatory filing describes it as a finance lease, with about $40 billion principal repaid quarterly over roughly five years plus fixed-rate interest, GPU batches arriving and leases starting in H1 2027, and the master lease expected to close before end-2026.

timeline.text_zh: SpaceX与Apollo签署具有约束力的主融资租赁协议：Apollo将购买GPU集群及相关设备并租赁给SpaceX，租赁本金付款总额预计达400亿美元，安排将在2027年上半年GPU交付时启动；该信息来自SEC文件。
timeline.text_en: SpaceX signed a binding master finance lease with Apollo: Apollo will buy GPU clusters and related equipment and lease them to SpaceX, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion, starting when GPUs are delivered in H1 2027, according to an SEC filing.

timeline.text_zh:
马斯克表示，SpaceX 已完成 400 亿美元的可赎回 GPU 债务融资，资金主要用于购买将于第一季度和第二季度到货的 GPU。据 BlockBeats 报道，马斯克称公司的投资级信用评级，以及来自 Starlink 卫星互联网和发射业务的收入，有助于其维持信贷渠道畅通。

按目前披露的说法，这将是专门用于采购 AI 算力的规模最大的债务融资之一，说明 GPU 采购正通过信贷市场而非仅靠经营现金流来支撑。马斯克表示，由于硬件尚未到货，这笔支出对本季度影响不大。

马斯克将该工具称为可赎回债务，即设有既定偿还日期的借款；但该快讯未披露贷款方、票息、期限等条款，也没有独立消息证实这笔融资。BlockBeats 在快讯中以 SPCX.O 代码指代该借款主体，而 SpaceX 并非上市公司。
timeline.text_en:
Elon Musk said SpaceX has completed $40 billion of redeemable GPU debt financing, with the proceeds mainly earmarked for GPUs scheduled to arrive in the first and second quarters. According to BlockBeats, Musk credited the company's investment-grade credit rating and revenue from its Starlink satellite-internet and launch businesses with keeping its access to credit open.

As described, the package would be among the largest disclosed debt raises aimed specifically at buying AI compute, indicating that GPU purchases are being funded through credit markets rather than only from operating cash flow. Musk said the spending will have little impact on the current quarter because the hardware has not yet arrived.

Musk described the instrument as redeemable debt — borrowing with a defined repayment date — but the flash report did not disclose lenders, coupon, maturity or other terms, and there was no independent confirmation of the financing. BlockBeats listed the borrower under the ticker SPCX.O, although SpaceX is not a publicly listed company.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，SpaceX正安排约400亿美元融资，由Apollo Global Management牵头，其中包括约100亿美元银行贷款和300亿美元投资级债务，用于购买英伟达芯片并扩大其AI算力建设，Pimco也在洽谈的贷款方之列。
timeline.text_en: SpaceX is reportedly arranging roughly $40 billion in financing led by Apollo Global Management — including about $10 billion of bank loans and $30 billion of investment-grade debt — to purchase Nvidia chips and expand its AI compute buildout, with Pimco among the lenders in talks.

threads.title_zh: 《CLARITY Act》推进：加密募资限制条款与执法情报共享试点
threads.title_en: Crypto fundraising limits added to CLARITY Act as vote looms
threads.summary_zh: 参议员Cynthia Lummis表示，CLARITY法案将建立一个试点项目，允许加密公司直接与联邦执法部门共享情报，并指出本周报道的币安攻击者63亿美元盗窃案及快速的跨链洗钱活动，证明行业与执法部门的协调可以冻结被盗资金。
threads.summary_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would establish a pilot program letting crypto companies share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, pointing to this week's reported $6.3 billion Binance attacker theft and rapid cross-chain laundering as evidence that industry–law-enforcement coordination can freeze stolen funds.
threads.latest_update_zh: 参议员Cynthia Lummis表示，CLARITY法案将建立一个试点项目，允许加密公司直接与联邦执法部门共享情报，并指出本周报道的币安攻击者63亿美元盗窃案及快速的跨链洗钱活动，证明行业与执法部门的协调可以冻结被盗资金。
threads.latest_update_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would establish a pilot program letting crypto companies share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, pointing to this week's reported $6.3 billion Binance attacker theft and rapid cross-chain laundering as evidence that industry–law-enforcement coordination can freeze stolen funds.
threads.background_zh: OKXICE TSV是纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与OKX美国控股公司按50比50组建的合资企业，计划通过OKX的XLayer区块链上经许可的Uniswap v4资金池，实现美国股票代币化的7×24小时交易，并以USDC等稳定币作为交易对。其10月4日的初始公告提出上线来自62家公司的63只代币化股票，而包括富国银行和Arm在内的部分后来的反对者并不在最初名单中。SEC于2026年9月17日发布创新豁免，要求交易场所在上线第三方代币化股票版本前至少30天通知相关公司，若公司在期限内书面反对，则该股票不得上线。已获得SEC代币化证券试点批准的纳斯达克表示，将把自家股票排除在该豁免之外。
threads.background_en: OKXICE TSV is a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U.S. holding company, planning 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's XLayer blockchain paired with stablecoins such as USDC. Its original Oct. 4 notice proposed 63 tokenized stocks from 62 companies, and several later objectors, including Wells Fargo and Arm, were not on that initial roster. The SEC issued the innovation exemption on Sept. 17, 2026, requiring a venue to notify a company at least 30 days before offering a third-party tokenized version of its shares, with a written objection within that window barring the listing. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would establish a pilot program letting crypto companies share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, pointing to this week's reported $6.3 billion Binance attacker theft and rapid cross-chain laundering as evidence that industry–law-enforcement coordination can freeze stolen funds.
threads.latest_summary_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would establish a pilot program letting crypto companies share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, pointing to this week's reported $6.3 billion Binance attacker theft and rapid cross-chain laundering as evidence that industry–law-enforcement coordination can freeze stolen funds.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这些反对压缩了OKXICE TSV实际可上线的股票供给，在尚未启动前就为这一规模最大的代币化股票场所之一设下可见上限，也检验了在发行人选择退出时SEC豁免能否规模化。该信号还波及更广泛的代币化股票与RWA（现实世界资产）板块——决定哪些股票能够上链交易的约束正在从场所技术转向发行人同意。
threads.market_impact_en: The objections shrink the supply of equities that OKXICE TSV can actually list, putting a visible ceiling on one of the largest tokenized-equity venues before launch and testing whether the SEC exemption can scale when issuers opt out. The signal extends to the broader tokenized-equity and RWA segment, where issuer consent — rather than venue technology — is emerging as the binding constraint on which stocks can trade onchain.

reference_links.title: JPMorgan, AMD and Coca-Cola Join Objectors to OKX-ICE Stock...
SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading ...

timeline.text_zh: 参议员Cynthia Lummis表示，CLARITY法案将建立一个试点项目，允许加密公司直接与联邦执法部门共享情报，并指出本周报道的币安攻击者63亿美元盗窃案及快速的跨链洗钱活动，证明行业与执法部门的协调可以冻结被盗资金。
timeline.text_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would establish a pilot program letting crypto companies share intelligence directly with federal law enforcement, pointing to this week's reported $6.3 billion Binance attacker theft and rapid cross-chain laundering as evidence that industry–law-enforcement coordination can freeze stolen funds.

timeline.text_zh: 反对 OKXICE TSV 代币化其股票的发行方数量从 38 家增至 50 家，新增包括英伟达、美光、耐克、好市多和 Reddit；原定代币化交易的公司共 62 家。
timeline.text_en: The number of issuers objecting to the tokenization of their shares on OKXICE TSV rose from 38 to 50, with Nvidia, Micron, Nike, Costco and Reddit among the latest additions; 62 companies were originally slated for tokenized trading.

timeline.text_zh: 沃尔玛、礼来、嘉年华邮轮、Arcos Dorados 和信诺加入反对 OKX 与 ICE 代币化股票计划的行列；据 10 月 28 日更新的公开通知，原定上市的 62 家企业中已有 38 家提出异议，占比超过 61%。
timeline.text_en: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Carnival, Arcos Dorados and Cigna joined the opposition to the OKX–ICE tokenized stock plan; according to the Oct. 28 public notice update, 38 of the 62 originally planned issuers have objected, exceeding 61%.

timeline.text_zh: 据加密记者 Eleanor Terrett 10 月 28 日报道，摩根大通、AMD、应用材料、可口可乐、Adobe、戴尔及 Sandisk 反对 OKXICE 代币化其股份，披露的反对公司总数从 26 家升至 33 家。
timeline.text_en: Crypto reporter Eleanor Terrett reported on Oct. 28 that JPMorgan, AMD, Applied Materials, Coca-Cola, Adobe, Dell and Sandisk objected to OKXICE tokenizing their shares, raising the disclosed number of opposing companies from 26 to 33.

timeline.text_zh: Intel、Oracle、IBM 和 IonQ 加入反对其股票在 OKXICE TSV 被代币化交易的发行方名单，使披露的反对总数从 22 家增至 26 家；10 月 26 日公告还指出，自行托管的代币化股票能否获得 SIPC 保护存在不确定性。
timeline.text_en: Intel, Oracle, IBM and IonQ joined the list of issuers objecting to their shares being tokenized and traded on OKXICE TSV, raising the disclosed total from 22 to 26; the Oct. 26 notice also flagged uncertainty over whether self-custodied tokenized shares would receive SIPC protection.

timeline.text_zh: IBM、Oracle、Intel 和 IonQ 反对 OKX 与 ICE 在未经同意的情况下依据 SEC 创新豁免将其股票代币化，使反对企业总数达到 26 家。
timeline.text_en: IBM, Oracle, Intel and IonQ objected to OKX and ICE tokenizing their stocks without consent under the SEC innovation exemption, bringing the total number of opposing companies to 26.

timeline.text_zh: 参议员 Cynthia Lummis 表示，对加密融资的新限制——将 Reg Crypto 年度豁免上限从 7500 万美元降至 5000 万美元，并增加 2 亿美元终身限额——已被纳入 CLARITY Act，而民主党人最终对这些规则投了反对票。
timeline.text_en: Senator Cynthia Lummis said new restrictions on crypto fundraising—lowering the annual Reg Crypto exemption cap from $75M to $50M and adding a $200M lifetime limit—have been incorporated into the CLARITY Act, with Democrats ultimately voting against the rules.

timeline.text_zh: SEC 的代币化创新豁免正引发相互竞争的意见函，争议焦点在于哪些区块链符合公开且无需许可的标准；同时，最初被列入代币化交易名单的公司中，超过三分之一——包括 Wells Fargo、Arm 和 Intuit——已对其股票被代币化表示反对。
timeline.text_en: The SEC's tokenization innovation exemption is drawing competing comment letters over which blockchains qualify as public and permissionless, while more than a third of the companies initially listed for tokenized trading — including Wells Fargo, Arm and Intuit — have objected to their shares being tokenized.

timeline.text_zh: 据路透社看到的一份监管文件，包括富国银行、Arm Holdings和Intuit在内的另外六家公司反对其股票在OKXICE平台被代币化，使已披露的反对发行方总数从16家增至22家；文件未说明这些公司反对的具体原因。
timeline.text_en: A regulatory filing seen by Reuters showed six more companies — including Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit — will not allow their shares to be tokenized on the OKXICE platform, raising the total disclosed objecting issuers from 16 to 22; the filing did not state their specific reasons.

timeline.text_zh: SEC公开披露已有三家公司通知其计划按新创新豁免机制运营代币化证券交易场所，OKXICE为其中之一，并计划使用OKX旗下X Layer网络；SEC同时强调，列入名单不代表相关公司已满足豁免条件。
timeline.text_en: The SEC publicly disclosed that three firms have notified the agency of plans to operate tokenized-securities trading venues under its new innovation exemption, including OKXICE, which plans to use OKX's X Layer network; the SEC cautioned that being listed does not confirm eligibility for the exemption.

threads.title_zh: 巴拉圭总统在Ueno数字银行倒闭后辞职
threads.title_en: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
threads.summary_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno Bank倒闭后辞职并被众议院弹劾。该行被发现资本低于监管最低要求的一半，公共存款约8亿美元，导致约三百万客户无法访问账户。
threads.summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned and was impeached by the lower house after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank — found to hold capital below half the regulatory minimum with about $800 million in public deposits — left roughly three million customers unable to access their accounts.
threads.latest_update_zh: 巴拉圭议员以78票通过弹劾程序，央行公布了Ueno银行储户的首批赔付名单。
threads.latest_update_en: Paraguayan lawmakers approved impeachment proceedings with 78 votes, and the central bank outlined an initial payout group for Ueno Bank depositors.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.
threads.latest_summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.

timeline.text_zh: 巴拉圭议员以78票通过弹劾程序，央行公布了Ueno银行储户的首批赔付名单。
timeline.text_en: Paraguayan lawmakers approved impeachment proceedings with 78 votes, and the central bank outlined an initial payout group for Ueno Bank depositors.

timeline.text_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno银行倒闭后辞职，该事件导致数百万客户无法取回资金，并引发不断加深的政治危机。
timeline.text_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to access their funds and triggered a deepening political crisis.

timeline.text_zh: Ueno关闭后，Bybit在巴拉圭的USDT报价显示13%溢价，央行正准备向储户支付存款担保款项。
timeline.text_en: Bybit USDT quotes in Paraguay showed a 13% premium after Ueno's closure, as the central bank prepared deposit-guarantee payments for savers.

threads.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber 网络安全模型
threads.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber cybersecurity model
threads.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的AI模型，该公司称其在测试中更擅长发现漏洞，越界比例低于1%。
threads.summary_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused AI model that it says is better at finding vulnerabilities while going out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time during testing.
threads.latest_update_zh: OpenAI向一小部分经过审核的客户发布了GPT-6 Cyber，并将其网络安全风险评级从上一代「高」上调至「关键」；同时披露该模型发现81个高严重性Firefox漏洞、协助开发针对948个Linux内核漏洞的可用利用程序，并已向「Daybreak Red」层级特定客户开放。
threads.latest_update_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to a small set of vetted customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating from High to Critical, disclosed findings of 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, and made it available to select customers in the Daybreak Red tier.
threads.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.
threads.latest_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI向一小部分经过审核的客户发布了GPT-6 Cyber，并将其网络安全风险评级从上一代「高」上调至「关键」；同时披露该模型发现81个高严重性Firefox漏洞、协助开发针对948个Linux内核漏洞的可用利用程序，并已向「Daybreak Red」层级特定客户开放。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to a small set of vetted customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating from High to Critical, disclosed findings of 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, and made it available to select customers in the Daybreak Red tier.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的模型，旨在发现可利用漏洞并开发修复方案，同时保持在授权范围内。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.

threads.title_zh: 币安因 SignalPlus 潜在安全问题删除其关联 API 密钥
threads.title_en: Binance revokes SignalPlus-linked API keys over potential security issue
threads.summary_zh: 币安和Deribit已撤销与SignalPlus关联的API密钥；SignalPlus披露此次入侵通过伪造Microsoft Teams邀请实施，损失低于8.2万美元并已开始全额赔付，服务暂时中止，预计完成安全审查和修补后数日内恢复。
threads.summary_en: Binance and Deribit have revoked SignalPlus-linked API keys; SignalPlus disclosed the intrusion was carried out via a fake Microsoft Teams invite, reported losses under $82,000 and has begun full reimbursement, with services temporarily suspended and expected to resume within days after security review and patching.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了SignalPlus安全事件的原因和影响范围：攻击者通过被入侵的Telegram联系人发送伪造Microsoft Teams会议邀请，入侵一名工程师电脑并进入内部网络；SignalPlus称损失低于8.2万美元、已开始全额赔付，并暂停服务以进行安全审查和修补，预计数日内恢复；Deribit客户通过SignalPlus进行的交易、监控和自动化已停止工作。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report adds the cause and scope of the SignalPlus security incident: attackers used a compromised Telegram contact to send a fake Microsoft Teams meeting invite, compromised an engineer’s computer and reached the internal network; SignalPlus said losses were under $82,000, has begun full reimbursement, suspended services for security review and patching, and expects restoration within days; Deribit customers’ trading, monitoring and automation through SignalPlus stopped working.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Binance and Deribit revoked API keys tied to crypto derivatives platform SignalPlus after a fake Microsoft Teams invite attack compromised an engineer's computer, causing under $82,000 in losses that SignalPlus pledged to fully reimburse, while disrupting SignalPlus-based trading and automation for Deribit customers.
threads.latest_summary_en: Binance and Deribit revoked API keys tied to crypto derivatives platform SignalPlus after a fake Microsoft Teams invite attack compromised an engineer's computer, causing under $82,000 in losses that SignalPlus pledged to fully reimburse, while disrupting SignalPlus-based trading and automation for Deribit customers.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了SignalPlus安全事件的原因和影响范围：攻击者通过被入侵的Telegram联系人发送伪造Microsoft Teams会议邀请，入侵一名工程师电脑并进入内部网络；SignalPlus称损失低于8.2万美元、已开始全额赔付，并暂停服务以进行安全审查和修补，预计数日内恢复；Deribit客户通过SignalPlus进行的交易、监控和自动化已停止工作。
timeline.text_en: The new report adds the cause and scope of the SignalPlus security incident: attackers used a compromised Telegram contact to send a fake Microsoft Teams meeting invite, compromised an engineer’s computer and reached the internal network; SignalPlus said losses were under $82,000, has begun full reimbursement, suspended services for security review and patching, and expects restoration within days; Deribit customers’ trading, monitoring and automation through SignalPlus stopped working.

timeline.text_zh: Deribit 也已预防性撤销与 SignalPlus 关联的 API 密钥，并称未发现其系统或数据受到影响；两家交易所均建议用户检查持仓和未成交订单，等待 SignalPlus 确认问题解决后再重新连接。
timeline.text_en: Deribit also proactively revoked SignalPlus-linked API keys, saying it found no indication of impact on its systems or data; both exchanges advised users to review positions and open orders and wait for SignalPlus to confirm remediation before reconnecting.

timeline.text_zh: 在SignalPlus报告潜在安全问题后，币安主动删除了与该第三方期权平台关联的所有API密钥，称自身系统及用户资金未受影响，并建议用户在问题完全解决后再重新绑定密钥，同时启用IP白名单。
timeline.text_en: Binance proactively deleted all API keys associated with third-party options platform SignalPlus after SignalPlus reported a potential security issue, stating its own systems and user funds were unaffected and advising users to re-bind keys only once the problem is fully resolved, with IP whitelisting enabled.

threads.title_zh: OpenSSH 10.6p2 针对未启用 PAM 的 Alpine 的关键变通方案
threads.title_en: OpenSSH 10.6p2 Critical workaround for alpine without PAM
threads.summary_zh: Alpine Linux 已发布 OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过漏洞的安全公告，解释了 musl crypt() 错误返回值导致无密码账户被长密码绕过的技术细节；OpenSSH 10.6p2 的变通方案已发布。
threads.summary_en: Alpine Linux has published a security advisory for the OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass, explaining the technical details of musl crypt() error return allowing long-password bypass of passwordless accounts; the OpenSSH 10.6p2 workaround has been released.
threads.latest_update_zh: Alpine Linux 发布安全公告，详细说明 OpenSSH-server 密码认证绕过漏洞：musl 的 crypt() 在密钥超过 256 字节时返回错误指示符 '*'，该字符与无密码账户的存储哈希字段匹配，导致长密码登录成功。
threads.latest_update_en: Alpine Linux published a security advisory detailing the OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass: musl's crypt() returns the error indicator '*' when the key exceeds 256 bytes, which matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Alpine Linux published a security advisory for an OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass in which musl's crypt() error return value "*" matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.
threads.latest_summary_en: Alpine Linux published a security advisory for an OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass in which musl's crypt() error return value "*" matches the stored hash field of accounts without a password, allowing long-password logins to succeed.

threads.title_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 确认遭网络攻击，此前 ZachXBT 将其与 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案关联
threads.title_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
threads.summary_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 在服务提供商平台遭入侵后已基本恢复运营；客户资金未受影响，但银行自有资金被盗并仍在评估损失。部分与交易所提款相关的资金已被冻结，追回工作仍在进行。
threads.summary_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has largely resumed operations after a service-provider breach; customer funds were unaffected, but the bank's own funds were stolen and the financial impact is still being assessed. Some funds linked to exchange withdrawals have been frozen, with recovery efforts ongoing.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称，攻击者是通过一家服务提供商（而非该行在线银行子公司 Fortuneo）进入系统的，并转走了银行自有资金；该行几乎所有业务已于周三恢复，但仍在评估财务影响。报道还称 Bitquery 追踪到从 Kraken、Crypto.com 和 OKX 账户提走的资金，部分资金已被冻结，后续追回工作正在进行中。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report adds that attackers gained access through a service provider, not the bank's online banking subsidiary Fortuneo, and transferred the bank's own funds; nearly all operations resumed Wednesday while the bank is still assessing the financial impact. It also says Bitquery traced withdrawals from accounts at Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX, some funds were frozen, and further recovery efforts are underway.
threads.background_zh: 据其官网介绍，Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 是一家法国互助银行集团，由 Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne 与 Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest 两大联合会及约 40 家专业子公司组成，拥有约 500 万客户；ZachXBT 则称其是一家资产规模 2350 亿美元的法国银行。今年 5 月，法国财经媒体 L'Agefi 报道称，该集团已根据欧盟加密规则 MiCA 申请牌照，以便向零售客户提供加密服务，并通过其 Arkéa Banking Services 部门提供白标服务。ZachXBT 未说明他是如何识别出该银行的，也未说明攻击者如何进入其交易所账户。
threads.background_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa is a French mutual banking group made up of the Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne and Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest federations plus around 40 specialized subsidiaries, with about 5 million customers, according to its own website; ZachXBT described it as a French bank with $235 billion in assets. In May, French financial newspaper L'Agefi reported that the group had applied for a license under MiCA, the EU's crypto rulebook, to offer crypto services to retail customers and on a white-label basis through its Arkéa Banking Services division. ZachXBT did not say how he identified the bank or how the attacker gained access to its exchange accounts.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa restored nearly all operations after a service-provider breach let attackers steal about $133M of the bank's own funds and push them through crypto exchange withdrawals traced by Bitquery to Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX.
threads.latest_summary_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa restored nearly all operations after a service-provider breach let attackers steal about $133M of the bank's own funds and push them through crypto exchange withdrawals traced by Bitquery to Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX.
threads.market_impact_zh: 疑似赃款以从交易所账户提取的 USDC 和 USDT 形式流出，随后兑换为 ETH、经即时交易平台转移、部分转为门罗币并跨多条链桥接——这一洗钱路径涉及中心化平台的稳定币流动性、跨链桥以及隐私币市场。与此同时，在该集团申请 MiCA 牌照的背景下，此案也使欧盟的事件披露实践与银行系加密托管受到关注，这一渠道会影响机构对欧洲受监管加密准入的情绪。
threads.market_impact_en: The alleged proceeds moved as USDC and USDT withdrawn from exchange accounts, then swapped into ETH, routed through instant exchanges, partly converted to Monero and bridged across multiple chains — a laundering path that touches stablecoin liquidity at centralized venues, cross-chain bridges and privacy-coin markets. The case also puts EU incident-disclosure practices and bank-linked crypto custody in focus as the group pursues a MiCA license, a channel that affects institutional sentiment toward regulated crypto access in Europe.

timeline.text_zh:
法国银行集团 Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 周三向 Decrypt 发表声明，确认其遭遇了一次使欺诈性操作得以进行的网络攻击，称事件已“关闭并处于控制之下”，业务正在逐步恢复。这一确认出现在链上调查员 ZachXBT 公开指认该行为超过 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案疑似受害方的次日。

该行表示在发现攻击后立即通报了相关监管机构，并作为预防措施暂停了部分交易。ZachXBT 则指责该机构未进行“适当的事件披露”，称这导致执法部门无法冻结约 3000 万美元被盗资金。

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 未提及加密货币，也未说明被盗金额，称受影响金额仍在评估中，但“无论如何都不足以动摇集团的稳健性与财务健康”；该行称客户资产未受影响，只是部分转账执行被延迟。ZachXBT 最初指出 11 月 1 日有逾 1.06 亿美元从交易所账户被提走，随后追加 2700 万美元，并公布了四个以太坊地址，还表示可以“高度确信”攻击者并非 Lazarus 组织。
timeline.text_en:
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed in a statement to Decrypt on Wednesday that it was hit by a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent operations, saying the incident is "closed and now under control" and that operations are resuming gradually. The confirmation came one day after onchain investigator ZachXBT publicly named the bank as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million.

The bank said it alerted the relevant supervisory authorities as soon as it detected the attack and temporarily suspended some transactions as a precaution. ZachXBT accused the institution of failing to make a "proper incident disclosure," which he said prevented law enforcement from freezing some $30 million in stolen funds.

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not mention crypto or state how much was taken, saying the affected amounts are still being assessed but are "in any event not of a nature to call into question the solidity and financial health of the group"; it said customer assets were unaffected and some transfers were only delayed. ZachXBT initially flagged more than $106 million in withdrawals from exchange accounts on November 1, later added $27 million, published four Ethereum addresses, and said he could state "with a high degree of confidence" the attacker is not the Lazarus Group.

threads.title_zh: 【Riot Platforms 与 Anthropic 租赁协议利息为 12%，Riot 出售部分比特币筹集资金】
threads.title_en: 【Riot Platforms 与 Anthropic 租赁协议利息为 12%，Riot 出售部分比特币筹集资金】
threads.summary_zh: Riot Platforms与Anthropic签署15年约280亿美元AI数据中心协议，提供910 MW容量，年均租金约18亿美元；建设成本约55亿美元，Anthropic可通过租金抵扣回收并获12%年利息；Riot计划债务融资覆盖80-90%成本，自身出资5-11亿美元，融资2027年启动；2026年前九月Riot已售20,264 BTC（约15亿美元），持有2,418 BTC，首批容量预计2027年6月交付。
threads.summary_en: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, ~$28B AI data-center agreement with Anthropic to provide 910 MW of capacity, with average annual rent of ~$1.8B; build costs are ~$5.5B, and Anthropic can recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest; Riot plans to finance 80–90% via debt, contributing $500M–$1.1B itself, with financing starting in 2027; Riot sold 20,264 BTC (~$1.5B) in the first nine months of 2026, holds 2,418 BTC, and first capacity is expected in June 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增了协议总价值约280亿美元、为期15年、年均租金约18亿美元、债务融资占比80-90%、Riot自身出资5-11亿美元、首批容量预计2027年6月交付等细节。
threads.latest_update_en: Added details on the ~$28B total deal value, 15-year term, ~$1.8B average annual rent, debt financing covering 80–90% of costs, Riot's own $500M–$1.1B equity contribution, and first capacity delivery expected in June 2027.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, roughly $28B deal to supply Anthropic with 910 MW of data-center capacity at its Corsicana, Texas site (~$1.8B average annual rent), funded largely by debt against ~$5.5B in build costs, with Anthropic able to recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest — while Riot has already liquidated 20,264 BTC in 2026 and holds just 2,418 BTC.
threads.latest_summary_en: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, roughly $28B deal to supply Anthropic with 910 MW of data-center capacity at its Corsicana, Texas site (~$1.8B average annual rent), funded largely by debt against ~$5.5B in build costs, with Anthropic able to recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest — while Riot has already liquidated 20,264 BTC in 2026 and holds just 2,418 BTC.

threads.title_zh: Strategy公布2026年第三季度财报：净利润195.3亿美元、持有848,517枚比特币，CFO将离任
threads.title_en: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任
threads.summary_zh:
Strategy 在 7 月至 9 月期间通过按市价（ATM）增发普通股融资 54 亿美元，但其中仅 5.88 亿美元用于购买比特币，相当于每融资 1 美元投入比特币不足 11 美分。公司同期还卖出 5,552 枚自有比特币，套现 3.486 亿美元，部分用于支付股息，部分用于回购其 STRC 优先股。

这一披露打破了此前的模式：2024 年几乎每一美元 ATM 融资都变成了比特币，即便在表现异常的 2025 年第三季度，每 1 美元中仍有逾 94 美分用于买入比特币。其意义在于，Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币储备公司，其融资中最终流向现货比特币购买的比例，是一条可直接观察的需求渠道。

Strategy 当季共买入 7,218 枚比特币，扣除卖出部分后，净持仓仅比季初增加 1,666 枚。在 10 月 26 日当周的披露中，新增 1.64 亿美元 MSTR 增发，每 1 美元中仅 40 美分用于购买比特币。
threads.summary_en: Strategy posted record Q3 2026 results with $20.91B operating profit and $19.53B net income on $20.91B of digital asset gains, disclosed 848,517 BTC held (up 26% YTD) alongside $14.33B of YTD Bitcoin purchases and $2.04B of STRC repurchases, and announced that CFO Andrew Kang will step down on November 5 with operations EVP Reza Virasteh taking over on January 1, 2027.
