threads.latest_update_en:
Strategy raised $5.4 billion through at-the-market common stock sales between July and September but spent only $588 million of that on bitcoin — less than 11 cents of every dollar raised. The company also sold 5,552 of its own BTC for $348.6 million, partly to fund dividends and partly to repurchase its STRC preferred stock.

The disclosure breaks a pattern: in 2024 essentially every ATM dollar became bitcoin, and even in the anomalous third quarter of 2025 more than 94 cents of each dollar still bought BTC. The shift matters because Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury, so the share of its fundraising that reaches spot BTC purchases is a directly observable demand channel.

Strategy bought 7,218 BTC during the quarter and, after accounting for its sales, ended with just 1,666 more coins than it started with. In the reporting week of October 26, $164 million of fresh MSTR dilution saw only 40 cents of each dollar go toward BTC.
threads.background_zh: Strategy（原 MicroStrategy）已将自身重新定位为“比特币储备公司”，由于经营性现金流极少，其购币资金主要来自按市价增发股票（ATM）。其 STRC 是一只年股息率 12.00% 的永续优先股，股息率每月调整，以促使其价格在 100 美元面值附近交易；文章指出该股实际连续数月跌至 70 至 80 美元区间，令回购成本高昂。
threads.background_en: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, has repositioned itself as a "bitcoin treasury company" and funds most purchases by selling stock at the market (ATM), since operations generate minimal cash flow. Its STRC is a perpetual preferred stock paying 12.00% annual dividends, with a rate adjusted monthly to encourage trading near its $100 par value; the article notes it actually traded in the $70s and $80s for months, making repurchases costly.

threads.market_impact_zh: MSTR 股票被广泛用作间接持有比特币的替代标的，STRC 则是与同一张资产负债表挂钩的收益型工具。当每新增 1 美元融资中流入现货比特币购买的比例下降、同时又有比特币被卖出以支付优先股股息和回购时，这一储备渠道的边际需求贡献随之减弱，其供给方向则略微转为正向。
threads.market_impact_en: MSTR stock is a widely used proxy for indirect bitcoin exposure, and STRC is a yield instrument tied to the same balance sheet. If a smaller share of each new dollar raised converts into spot BTC purchases while some coins are sold to fund preferred dividends and buybacks, the marginal demand contribution from this treasury channel weakens and the supply side of that channel turns slightly positive.

HSBC unveiled the RedCoin name on 30 September 2026. Other banks are pursuing the same payments ground: in September, 21 lenders including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America announced plans for a joint dollar stablecoin targeting a launch in the first half of 2027.

threads.latest_summary_en: HSBC's HKD stablecoin RedCoin has reached 50,000 users shortly after its October launch, with merchant payments and wallet top-up now live and plans to expand access across HSBC and Hang Seng customers.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次落地将稳定币的分发渠道转向拥有存量用户的银行消费钱包，这一渠道可能在支付领域对非银行的港元稳定币发行方形成压力；但私有账本设计及闭环式的可转移性限制了其与公链场所的互操作性。由于流通量仅约1020万美元，对加密交易市场的即时流动性影响微不足道。
threads.market_impact_en: The rollout shifts stablecoin distribution toward a bank-operated consumer wallet with a captive user base, a channel that could pressure non-bank HKD-denominated issuers on the payments side, though the private-ledger design and closed-loop transferability limit interoperability with public-chain venues. With circulating supply near $10.2 million, the immediate liquidity effect on crypto trading markets is negligible.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic 正在研发一套可证明 AI 模型身份的系统
threads.title_en: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
threads.summary_zh:
据 Anthropic 周二发布的一篇博客文章，该公司正在研发一套名为 FlashProve 的开源系统，可让任何人验证某段 AI 输出究竟由哪个模型生成。Anthropic 用 Llama 4 Maverick（一个 4000 亿参数的混合专家模型）在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上演示了该方案。

该计划针对模型身份伪造与冒名问题，目标是让开发者和平台能够核验某段回复是否确实来自其所声称的模型。

Anthropic 将 FlashProve 描述为一套开源系统，演示中它借助单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 与 Llama 4 Maverick 生成证明。该系统仍处于研发阶段，尚未发布或获得广泛采用的实现。
threads.summary_en:
Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open source system that would let anyone verify which AI model produced a given output, according to a company blog post published Tuesday. The company demonstrated the approach using Llama 4 Maverick, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, running on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.

The effort targets model-identity and impersonation concerns, aiming to give developers and platforms a way to check that a response genuinely came from the model it claims to originate from.

Anthropic describes FlashProve as an open source system, and the demo produced proofs on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with Llama 4 Maverick. The system is still in development, with no shipped or widely adopted implementation yet.
threads.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic 公布了一种名为 FlashProve 的研究方案，用于大型混合专家（MoE）语言模型的可验证推理：模型提供方先对模型权重做出承诺，随后为每个请求生成一份 zkSNARK 证明，使客户端能够核实实际为其提供服务的是哪一套权重。Anthropic 表示已在一个 4000 亿参数模型上演示了该系统。

该方案针对的是托管模型服务中的信任缺口：让客户能够确认提供方服务器上实际运行的权重，而不是仅凭提供方的一面之词。有评论者认为这相较此前的零知识方案是显著改进，同时指出约 90-100 倍的计算开销限制了它在短期内的实用性。

据讨论中引述的报告内容，权重承诺约 6.5 MB，在提供方需要重新承诺之前大约可用于 1600 万次请求，每个请求生成一份证明。验证一份证明在 24 线程上约需 17 秒、单线程约需 21 秒，其中包含对离线阶段的校验。
threads.latest_update_en:
Anthropic published a research approach, called FlashProve, for provable inference of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models: the model provider commits to its weights, then issues one zkSNARK proof per request so a client can verify which weights actually served it. Anthropic said it demonstrated the system on a 400-billion-parameter model.

The scheme targets a trust gap in hosted model serving — letting a customer confirm which weights ran on a provider's servers rather than relying on the provider's word. Commenters described it as a significant improvement over earlier zero-knowledge results, while noting the roughly 90-100x compute overhead limits near-term practicality.

According to discussion of the report, the weight commitment is about 6.5 MB and remains valid for roughly 16 million requests before the provider must commit again, with one proof issued per request. Verifying a proof takes about 17 seconds on 24 threads and 21 seconds on a single thread, including the check from the offline phase.
threads.background_zh: FlashProve 涉及两方：作为证明者的模型提供方和作为验证者的用户。Anthropic 表示这项工作推进了 zkSNARK 的应用，并称这类密码学证明因其隐藏性与效率特性而特别适合可验证推理。
threads.background_en: FlashProve involves two parties: the model provider as prover and the user as verifier. Anthropic said the work advances zkSNARKs, a class of cryptographic proof it describes as uniquely suited to provable inference because of their hiding and efficiency properties.

threads.latest_summary_en:
Anthropic published a research approach, called FlashProve, for provable inference of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models: the model provider commits to its weights, then issues one zkSNARK proof per request so a client can verify which weights actually served it. According to discussion of the report, the weight commitment is about 6.5 MB and remains valid for roughly 16 million requests before the provider must commit again, with one proof issued per request. Verifying a proof takes about 17 seconds on 24 threads and 21 seconds on a single thread, including the check from the offline phase.
threads.discussion_zh: 一位评论者称自己此前做过名为 VerInf 的工作，而该方案正是建立在其之上，并表示包括选用 400B Maverick 模型在内的设计来自那项工作，却几乎没有得到署名。其他人欢迎这一成果，但认为存在更便宜的替代方案：把同一非批处理提示交给四个独立推理提供方以获得概率性证明，或者对于开放权重模型直接确定性地重算一遍。还有评论者指出，该方案也能识别出把请求悄悄路由到其他模型的提供方。
threads.discussion_en: A commenter who said they developed prior work called VerInf, which the approach builds on, said the design including the choice of a 400B Maverick model came from that work with little attribution. Others welcomed the result as a step forward but argued cheaper alternatives exist — running the same non-batched prompt through four independent inference providers for a probabilistic proof, or, for open-weight models, simply redoing the computation deterministically. Several commenters noted the scheme could also catch providers that silently route requests to other models.
threads.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场的传导路径在零知识证明基础设施一侧：FlashProve 依赖 zkSNARK，而这正是 zkML 与可验证计算网络所使用的证明系统，因此大模型推理证明的进展会影响这类项目对可行性与成本的叙事。讨论中提到的 90-100 倍开销表明该技术尚不足以替代现有的服务或验证设计，且该研究本身并未直接涉及任何代币、交易场所或协议。
threads.market_impact_en: The crypto transmission path runs through zero-knowledge proof infrastructure: FlashProve relies on zkSNARKs, the same proof systems used by zkML and verifiable-compute networks, so progress on proving large-model inference bears on how those projects frame feasibility and cost. The 90-100x overhead described in discussion suggests the technique is not yet a practical substitute for existing serving or verification designs, and no token, venue or protocol is directly implicated by the research itself.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic CEO呼吁AI研发减速至更安全节奏
threads.title_en: Anthropic CEO urges slowdown of AI development to a safer pace
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 公开为公司安全记录和“向上竞争”策略辩护，同时承认 AI 可能很快加速下一代 AI 开发，以至于需要对研究速度施加直接限制；此前批评者质疑了 Anthropic 的 AI 安全法案草案及其放宽的内部安全承诺。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.
threads.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic公开警告称，公司正接近“递归自我改进”（RSI）能力，即AI系统已足够擅长训练自身的后继系统、从而推动能力急剧加速的临界点，并将这一时刻界定为关键的安全关口。

Anthropic的这一表述将RSI置于争论的核心：前沿实验室应以多快速度部署能力不断增强的系统，以及监管机构应如何构建对这一过程的监督。

这一表态是对“接近程度”的判断，而非已展示的能力跃升或已披露的安全事件。RSI被描述为AI在自我训练上变得极为高效、从而令能力提升大幅加速的那个节点。
threads.latest_update_en:
Anthropic publicly cautioned that it is approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) — the threshold at which AI systems become good enough at training their own successors to drive a sharp acceleration in capabilities — framing the moment as a critical safety juncture.

Anthropic's framing places RSI at the center of the debate over how quickly frontier labs should deploy increasingly capable systems and how regulators should structure oversight of that process.

The statement is an assessment of proximity rather than a demonstrated capability jump or a disclosed safety incident. RSI is described as the point where AI becomes so effective at training itself that capability gains accelerate dramatically.
threads.background_zh: 递归自我改进指的是AI不仅能提升自身能力，还能改进实现未来改进的过程；与之相关的“种子AI”（seed AI）概念由Eliezer Yudkowsky提出，指从一开始就为递归自我改进而设计的系统。RSI与“智能爆炸”的预测密切相关。Anthropic是与Google、微软和OpenAI共同创立“前沿模型论坛”（Frontier Model Forum）的实验室之一，该行业组织致力于前沿AI模型的安全与负责任开发。
threads.background_en: Recursive self-improvement describes AI systems that can improve not just their own capabilities but the process by which future improvements are made; the related "seed AI" concept, coined by Eliezer Yudkowsky, refers to systems designed from the outset for recursive self-improvement. RSI is closely tied to predictions of an "intelligence explosion." Anthropic is one of the labs that co-founded the Frontier Model Forum with Google, Microsoft and OpenAI, an industry body focused on safe and responsible development of frontier AI models.

Anthropic publicly cautioned that it is approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) — the threshold at which AI systems become good enough at training their own successors to drive a sharp acceleration in capabilities — framing the moment as a critical safety juncture.

Anthropic's framing places RSI at the center of the debate over how quickly frontier labs should deploy increasingly capable systems and how regulators should structure oversight of that process.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 公开为公司安全记录和“向上竞争”策略辩护，同时承认 AI 可能很快加速下一代 AI 开发，以至于需要对研究速度施加直接限制；此前批评者质疑了 Anthropic 的 AI 安全法案草案及其放宽的内部安全承诺。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 已向 METR 研究人员提供员工级内部系统访问权限，用于独立的风险与事件评估，并同意 METR 有权发布其评估结果，Anthropic 无权阻止。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic has granted METR researchers employee-level access to its internal systems for independent risk and incident evaluations, and agreed it cannot block METR from publishing its findings.

timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 于周六发布博客文章，认为AI发展速度过快，可能“超出我们理解和控制系统能力的速度”，并援引了递归自我改进以及7月OpenAI与Hugging Face的智能体事件作为依据。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman对此表示认同，称应放缓AI发展节奏，并表示OpenAI今年不会寻求IPO，以便专注于安全，Elon Musk也在X上发帖称“Dario说得对”。

两家领先前沿实验室的负责人以及一位最具影响力的AI投资者罕见地公开一致，认为有必要有意放缓前沿AI的发展步伐，这可能推动AI治理讨论转向协调一致的安全标准与独立评估。由于Amodei的提议针对前沿实验室、民主国家政府间的协调以及中国获取先进芯片的问题，因此牵涉的出口管制与监管议题远超任何一家公司的范畴。

Amodei 提出了三项提议：给予独立评估者类似实验室内部员工级别的访问权限；民主国家的前沿AI公司就共同安全标准以及限制不受约束的AI进展进行协调；民主国家政府尝试在认真对待合规核查难度的前提下，与威权政府进行协调。他还警告称，未来6到12个月内，像7月事件中那样的失控智能体集群可能具备接管整个互联网的能力，而Anthropic表示其已单方面承诺落实独立评估者这一项。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged a slowdown in AI development to a safer pace, citing recursive self-improvement risks and a recent OpenAI-Hugging Face agent incident, with OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk expressing agreement.

threads.title_zh: 巴西加密交易所赶在央行授权截止日前申请牌照
threads.title_en: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
threads.summary_zh: 巴西央行虚拟资产服务商牌照申请已于10月30日截止，仅约40家机构提交申请，远低于预期；未获授权企业须在30天内退出市场，且自11月6日起银行和支付机构不得与未获授权的虚拟资产服务商交易。
threads.summary_en: Brazil's central bank virtual asset service provider licensing window closed on Oct 30 with only about 40 applicants, far below expectations; unauthorized firms must exit the market within 30 days, and from Nov 6 banks and payment institutions may not transact with unauthorized virtual asset service providers.
threads.latest_update_zh: 10月30日巴西虚拟资产服务商授权申请窗口关闭，实际仅约40家机构提交申请或相关动作，低于市场预期的150至200家；未申请授权企业须在30天内退出巴西市场，且自11月6日起银行和支付机构不得与未获授权的虚拟资产服务商交易。
threads.latest_update_en: The Brazilian virtual asset service provider authorization window closed on Oct 30 with only about 40 institutions submitting applications or related actions versus an expected 150-200; unlicensed firms must exit the Brazilian market within 30 days, and from Nov 6 banks and payment institutions are barred from transacting with unauthorized virtual asset service providers.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Brazil's virtual asset service provider licensing window closed on Oct 30 with only about 40 applicants versus 150-200 expected, meaning unlicensed firms must exit the market within 30 days and, from Nov 6, banks and payment institutions are prohibited from transacting with unauthorized providers.
threads.latest_summary_en: Brazil's virtual asset service provider licensing window closed on Oct 30 with only about 40 applicants versus 150-200 expected, meaning unlicensed firms must exit the market within 30 days and, from Nov 6, banks and payment institutions are prohibited from transacting with unauthorized providers.

timeline.text_zh: 巴西加密货币交易所须在周五前向巴西中央银行申请授权，高昂的资本、合规和审计要求以及尚未明确的监管问题，使在该国 2025 年 11 月虚拟资产框架下获得持牌运营的道路更加复杂。
timeline.text_en: Brazilian crypto exchanges face a Friday deadline to apply for authorization with the Banco Central do Brasil, with steep capital, compliance and audit requirements and open regulatory questions complicating the path to licensed operation under the country's November 2025 virtual-asset framework.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道确认 Itaú Unibanco 于10月27日向巴西央行通报加密交易和托管业务，并称其是巴西首家在新数字资产规则下完成通报的银行，截止日期为10月30日。
timeline.text_en: The report confirms Itaú Unibanco notified Brazil's central bank on October 27 and identifies it as the first Brazilian bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules, ahead of the October 30 deadline.

timeline.text_zh: Itaú Unibanco 已通知巴西央行，将在央行的授权框架下提供包括比特币、以太坊和 USDC 在内的 15 种资产的加密交易和托管服务。
timeline.text_en: Itaú Unibanco has notified Brazil's central bank that it will offer crypto trading and custody for 15 assets, including bitcoin, ether, and USDC, under the central bank's authorization framework.

timeline.text_zh: 币安在 10 月 30 日监管截止日期前向巴西中央银行申请加密服务提供商牌照，同时针对巴西用户限制借贷、保证金交易并下架 22 种资产。
timeline.text_en: Binance applied to the Central Bank of Brazil for a crypto service provider license ahead of the Oct. 30 regulatory deadline while restricting lending, margin trading and delisting 22 assets for Brazilian users.

threads.title_zh: ICE与Trade.xyz合作推出美国监管的永续期货交易场所
threads.title_en: ICE partners with Trade.xyz to launch US-regulated perpetual futures venue
threads.summary_zh: ICE 与 Trade[XYZ] 重新发布经修改的合作公告，重申计划推出基于 Hyperliquid 的美国受监管永续期货市场，但强调该计划及杠杆交易均尚待监管批准，尚无获批或上线。
threads.summary_en: ICE and Trade[XYZ] have reposted an amended partnership announcement reiterating plans for a US-regulated perpetual futures venue built on Hyperliquid, while stressing that the plan and leveraged trading remain subject to regulatory approvals; no approval or launch has occurred.
threads.latest_update_zh: ICE 在删除早前帖子后重新发布与 Trade[XYZ] 的合作公告，并修改措辞，强调把基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约引入美国仅是“计划”，且包括杠杆交易在内的业务仍需获得监管批准。
threads.latest_update_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement after deleting the earlier post, amending the wording to stress that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
threads.background_zh: ICE 是纽约证券交易所的母公司。Trade[XYZ] 在去中心化永续合约交易所 Hyperliquid 上运营市场；有关最初公告的报道称，这些市场在一年多时间里成交量已超过 6500 亿美元，且 ICE 作为合作的一部分入股 Trade.xyz。美国监管机构近年来在加密永续合约长期主要于离岸交易之后，开始为该产品建立明确的监管框架。
threads.background_en: ICE is the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange. Trade[XYZ] operates markets on Hyperliquid, the decentralized perpetual futures exchange; reporting on the original announcement said those markets surpassed $650 billion in volume in just over a year, and that ICE is taking a stake in Trade.xyz as part of the partnership. U.S. regulators have recently begun establishing an affirmative framework for crypto perpetual futures after years in which the product traded mainly offshore.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
threads.latest_summary_en: ICE reposted its Trade[XYZ] partnership announcement with amended wording stressing that bringing Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the U.S. is only planned and remains subject to regulatory approvals, including for leveraged trading.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约能否进入美国市场：一个受监管、符合 KYC 要求的交易场所将把传统交易所运营商的基础设施与链上永续合约流动性连接起来，其中 HYPE 和 Hyperliquid 的订单流对审批进展的情绪最为敏感。有关最初公告的报道提到，随着交易者作出反应，HYPE 一度上涨超过 8%，而此次措辞的软化使监管时间表重新成为未定变量。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through U.S. market access for Hyperliquid-based perpetuals: a regulated, KYC-compliant venue would link a traditional exchange operator's infrastructure to on-chain perpetual liquidity, with HYPE and Hyperliquid's order flow most directly exposed to sentiment around the approvals. Reporting on the initial announcement noted HYPE rose more than 8% as traders reacted, and the softened wording reintroduces regulatory timing as an open variable.

threads.title_zh: TCP释放后使用漏洞：CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
threads.title_en: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
threads.summary_zh: 一个严重的Linux IPv4 TCP释放后使用漏洞CVE-2026-98432，CVSS评分为9.8，披露时Ubuntu和RHEL等主要发行版尚无补丁，不过实际利用受数据包过滤和多核要求限制。
threads.summary_en: A critical Linux IPv4 TCP use-after-free, CVE-2026-98432 with CVSS 9.8, left major distributions such as Ubuntu and RHEL without patches at disclosure, though practical exploitation is constrained by packet filtering and multi-core requirements.
threads.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic 表示，Claude 使用一个尚未发布的内部模型，为 CVE-2026-98432 写出了可用的远程漏洞利用程序。该漏洞是 Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 握手路径中的释放后使用（use-after-free）缺陷，严重性评分 9.8，影响 4.4 及之后的內核版本。该攻击在 10 月 27 日的一篇研究文章中披露，覆盖 Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows 和 Linux 五个目标，定位内存缺陷耗时不到一小时，再花约五分钟即可执行获得 root 权限的命令。

Ubuntu 官方跟踪页面仍将 16.04 至 26.10 的所有版本列为受影响，而红帽已于 11 月 1 日（周日）为 RHEL 8、9、10 发布修复，包括安全公告 RHSA-2026:93412。Go 安全团队警告称，底层缺陷并不局限于 Anthropic 演示所用攻击所依赖的 MPTCP 特性，并建议升级到已修补的内核。

Anthropic 写道，该漏洞属于竞态条件，竞争失败只会导致握手失败而不会使系统崩溃，因此攻击者可以无限次重试。红帽发布了一条临时防火墙规则，称其“可降低暴露于该漏洞的风险，但无法完全阻止”，完整的解决方案仍在开发中；Debian、SUSE、Oracle Linux 和 Amazon Linux 也已为至少部分版本发布修复。
threads.latest_update_en:
Anthropic said Claude, using an unreleased internal model, wrote a working remote exploit for CVE-2026-98432, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake path rated 9.8 for severity that affects kernel versions from 4.4 onward. The attack was described in an Oct. 27 research post covering five targets — Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux — and takes under an hour to locate the memory flaw plus about five minutes to execute a command with root access.

Ubuntu's own tracker still lists every release from 16.04 through 26.10 as affected, while Red Hat shipped fixes for RHEL 8, 9 and 10 on Sunday, Nov. 1, including advisory RHSA-2026:93412. The Go Security Team warned that the underlying bug is not specific to MPTCP, the feature Anthropic's demonstrated exploit requires, and recommended upgrading to a patched kernel.

Anthropic wrote that the bug is a race condition where a lost race only fails the handshake without crashing the system, so an attacker can retry indefinitely. Red Hat published a temporary firewall rule that it says "reduces exposure to this vulnerability but cannot fully prevent it," with a full solution still under development; Debian, SUSE, Oracle Linux and Amazon Linux have also shipped fixes for at least some versions.
threads.background_zh: 据 NVD 记载，该漏洞已于 2026 年 10 月 15 日在上游修复，问题在于 tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() 将 ireq->ireq_opt 的所有权转移给子套接字时未进行拷贝。AWS 指出，该缺陷影响 4.4 及之后的内核版本，远程未认证方可以向受影响的监听端发送携带 IP 选项的特制 IPv4 TCP 报文。Ubuntu 跟踪页面显示 22.04、24.04、26.04 和 26.10 的修复仍在进行中，而 20.04、18.04 和 16.04 仅标注为“受影响”。
threads.background_en: The flaw was fixed upstream on Oct. 15, 2026, according to NVD, which describes the issue as a case where tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket without copying it. AWS noted the bug affects kernel versions 4.4 and later, where a remote unauthenticated party could send crafted IPv4 TCP packets carrying IP options to an affected listener. Ubuntu's tracker shows fixes in progress for 22.04, 24.04, 26.04 and 26.10, while 20.04, 18.04 and 16.04 show only "Vulnerable."
threads.latest_summary_zh:
Anthropic 表示，Claude 使用一个尚未发布的内部模型，为 CVE-2026-98432 写出了可用的远程漏洞利用程序。该漏洞是 Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 握手路径中的释放后使用（use-after-free）缺陷，严重性评分 9.8，影响 4.4 及之后的內核版本。该攻击在 10 月 27 日的一篇研究文章中披露，覆盖 Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows 和 Linux 五个目标，定位内存缺陷耗时不到一小时，再花约五分钟即可执行获得 root 权限的命令。

Ubuntu 官方跟踪页面仍将 16.04 至 26.10 的所有版本列为受影响，而红帽已于 11 月 1 日（周日）为 RHEL 8、9、10 发布修复，包括安全公告 RHSA-2026:93412。Go 安全团队警告称，底层缺陷并不局限于 Anthropic 演示所用攻击所依赖的 MPTCP 特性，并建议升级到已修补的内核。

Anthropic 写道，该漏洞属于竞态条件，竞争失败只会导致握手失败而不会使系统崩溃，因此攻击者可以无限次重试。红帽发布了一条临时防火墙规则，称其“可降低暴露于该漏洞的风险，但无法完全阻止”，完整的解决方案仍在开发中；Debian、SUSE、Oracle Linux 和 Amazon Linux 也已为至少部分版本发布修复。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Anthropic said Claude, using an unreleased internal model, wrote a working remote exploit for CVE-2026-98432, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake path rated 9.8 for severity that affects kernel versions from 4.4 onward. The attack was described in an Oct. 27 research post covering five targets — Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux — and takes under an hour to locate the memory flaw plus about five minutes to execute a command with root access.

Ubuntu's own tracker still lists every release from 16.04 through 26.10 as affected, while Red Hat shipped fixes for RHEL 8, 9 and 10 on Sunday, Nov. 1, including advisory RHSA-2026:93412. The Go Security Team warned that the underlying bug is not specific to MPTCP, the feature Anthropic's demonstrated exploit requires, and recommended upgrading to a patched kernel.

Anthropic wrote that the bug is a race condition where a lost race only fails the handshake without crashing the system, so an attacker can retry indefinitely. Red Hat published a temporary firewall rule that it says "reduces exposure to this vulnerability but cannot fully prevent it," with a full solution still under development; Debian, SUSE, Oracle Linux and Amazon Linux have also shipped fixes for at least some versions.
threads.discussion_zh: 评论者对紧迫性的看法存在分歧：有人指出可以通过 Ubuntu 的 proposed 软件源为最新 LTS 版本获取修复，也有人认为在未观察到实际利用且存在缓解措施的情况下，风险被夸大了。另一些人则追问仍无答案的问题——Ubuntu 为何修补缓慢、运行未打补丁 Linux 内核的消费级路由器该如何看待，以及红帽的部分缓解措施究竟能挡住什么。
threads.discussion_en: Commenters were split on urgency: one pointed to Ubuntu's proposed pocket as a route to fixes for the latest LTS releases, while another argued the risk is overblown given no observed in-the-wild exploit and available mitigations. Others pressed on unanswered questions — why Ubuntu's patch is slow, how consumer routers running unpatched Linux kernels fit in, and what Red Hat's partial mitigation actually blocks.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于运营安全而非代币基本面：加密货币交易所、托管机构和节点/验证者运营方运行着大量 Linux 服务器，未打补丁且暴露 TCP 监听端口的内核构成可用性与密钥托管基础设施风险。该漏洞与启用 MPTCP 的部署相关——Go 安全团队称自 Go 1.24 起该特性默认开启——这扩大了可能需要审计的后端服务范围。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through operational security rather than token fundamentals: crypto exchanges, custodians and node or validator operators run Linux server fleets, and unpatched kernels exposing TCP listeners represent availability and key-custody infrastructure risk. The bug's relevance to MPTCP-enabled deployments, which the Go Security Team says have been default since Go 1.24, widens the set of backend services that may need auditing.

threads.title_zh: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
threads.title_en: 【b14g 遭未经授权提取 9700 万枚 CORE，已暂停合约并冻结部分资金】
threads.summary_zh: b14g 事件涉及约 9705 万枚 CORE；Core 网络硬分叉已追回约 6815 万枚 CORE 并转入指定恢复地址，未回滚交易或改变总供应量。追回资金尚未分发给受影响用户，剩余冻结资产仍在与交易所及执法部门协调追回中。
threads.summary_en: About 97.05M CORE was involved in the b14g incident; a Core network hard fork has recovered roughly 68.15M CORE to a designated recovery address without rolling back transactions or altering total supply. Recovered funds have not yet been distributed to affected users, and remaining frozen assets are still being pursued with exchanges and law enforcement.
threads.latest_update_zh: Core 网络针对该事件完成硬分叉恢复，通过一次性状态调整从三个攻击者控制地址追回 68,146,177.22 枚 CORE（事件总量约 9705 万枚），未回滚交易、未增发代币、未改变总供应量；追回资金尚未分发给受影响用户，团队正与交易所及执法部门协调剩余冻结资产并制定透明分配计划。
threads.latest_update_en: The Core network completed a hard-fork recovery for the incident, reclaiming 68,146,177.22 CORE from three attacker-controlled addresses (of roughly 97.05M CORE involved) via a one-time state adjustment that did not roll back transactions, mint new tokens, or change total supply; recovered funds are not yet distributed to affected users, and the team is coordinating with exchanges and law enforcement on remaining frozen assets and a transparent distribution plan.
threads.background_zh: 据其官方文档，b14g 是一个比特币双质押层，允许比特币持有者在多条链上获取收益。CORE 是 Core 网络的原生代币，Core 是面向比特币的权益证明层，采用结合比特币算力与 CORE 质押的 Satoshi Plus 共识机制。
threads.background_en: b14g is a Bitcoin dual-staking layer that lets Bitcoin holders earn yield across chains, according to its documentation. CORE is the token of Core, a proof-of-stake layer for Bitcoin that uses the Satoshi Plus consensus mechanism combining Bitcoin mining hash power with CORE staking.
threads.latest_summary_zh: b14g announced that the Core network's hard fork recovery has reclaimed 68,146,177.22 CORE from three attacker-controlled addresses following a security incident involving roughly 97.05M CORE, using a one-time state adjustment that did not roll back transactions or alter total supply, with distribution to affected users still pending alongside coordination with exchanges and law enforcement over remaining frozen assets.
threads.latest_summary_en: b14g announced that the Core network's hard fork recovery has reclaimed 68,146,177.22 CORE from three attacker-controlled addresses following a security incident involving roughly 97.05M CORE, using a one-time state adjustment that did not roll back transactions or alter total supply, with distribution to affected users still pending alongside coordination with exchanges and law enforcement over remaining frozen assets.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次事件的风险敞口集中于通过 b14g 质押 CORE 的用户，以及与该质押路径挂钩的凭证或衍生索取权，风险传导渠道是智能合约授权环节。事件同时影响市场对比特币质押与再质押类协议的信心，而目前大部分受影响 CORE 仍在链上，后续仍可能被追踪或冻结。
threads.market_impact_en: The incident concentrates exposure on CORE stakers who used b14g and on any receipt or derivative claims tied to that staking route, where smart-contract authorization is the risk channel. It also feeds into sentiment around Bitcoin staking and restaking layers more broadly, at a time when a large share of the affected CORE sits on-chain and remains subject to further tracing or freezing.

timeline.text_zh: Core DAO 就 b14g 漏洞事件作出回应，称该漏洞不影响 Core 网络安全，Core 共识、验证者及质押合约全程正常运行，直接或通过其他协议质押的 CORE 不受影响；其正与 b14g 及交易所合作追踪并冻结攻击者资金，大部分被盗 CORE 仍留在 Core 链上。
timeline.text_en: Core DAO responded to the b14g vulnerability, saying it does not affect Core network security; Core consensus, validators and staking contracts operated normally, and CORE staked directly or through other protocols was unaffected. It is coordinating with b14g and exchanges to trace and freeze attacker funds, with most stolen CORE still on the Core chain.

timeline.text_zh: 比特币双重质押层b14g报告称，约9700万枚质押的CORE代币被未经授权提取，促使其暂停受影响合约，并与Core、安全合作伙伴及交易所合作冻结和追回资金，目前约900万枚CORE已被冻结，另有6800万枚仍在Core链上。
timeline.text_en: b14g, a Bitcoin dual-staking layer, reported that about 97 million staked CORE tokens were extracted without authorization, prompting it to pause the affected contracts and work with Core, security partners and exchanges to freeze and recover funds, with roughly 9 million CORE frozen and 68 million still on the Core chain.

threads.title_zh: ZachXBT：疑似欧盟实体在加密盗窃中损失超 1.06 亿美元
threads.title_en: ZachXBT: EU entity suspected of losing over $106M in crypto theft
threads.summary_zh: ZachXBT 已进一步披露该欧盟实体被盗超1.06亿美元的资金流向、兑换路径及11个相关地址，事件仍在监测中。
threads.summary_en: ZachXBT has further disclosed the fund-flow route, swap path, and 11 related addresses for the EU entity's suspected loss of over $106 million; the incident remains under monitoring.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增披露被盗时间为11月1日，资金以USDC/USDT提出，经WellWallet、Kyrrex等即时兑换平台换成ETH，并通过Wagyu兑换为XMR，同时公布11个相关被盗地址。
threads.latest_update_en: Added details that the theft occurred on Nov. 1, funds were withdrawn as USDC/USDT, swapped into ETH via instant-exchange services including WellWallet and Kyrrex, converted to XMR through Wagyu, and 11 related addresses were published.
threads.background_zh: 此次疑似盗窃发生在 10 月 29 日币安约 63 亿美元被盗案之后，FBI 将该案归因于被追踪为“TraderTraitor”的朝鲜黑客，这也是有记录以来规模最大的加密货币盗窃案。ZachXBT 是匿名的区块链调查员与 OSINT 研究者，以对加密欺诈和骗局进行独立链上取证调查而知名。门罗币（XMR）是注重隐私的加密货币，常被用于切断被盗资金的追踪链条。
threads.background_en: The suspected theft follows the roughly $6.3 billion Binance hack on Oct. 29, which the FBI attributed to North Korean hackers tracked as "TraderTraitor" and which is the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. ZachXBT is a pseudonymous blockchain investigator and OSINT researcher known for independent on-chain forensic work on crypto fraud and scams. Monero is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency commonly used to break the traceability of stolen funds.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ZachXBT warned that an EU-based entity appears to have had more than $106 million drained from several centralized exchange accounts, with the stolen USDC and USDT being swapped into ETH, routed through instant-exchange services like WellWallet and Kyrrex, converted to XMR via Wagyu, and moved across multiple chains, with 11 associated addresses published.
threads.latest_summary_en: ZachXBT warned that an EU-based entity appears to have had more than $106 million drained from several centralized exchange accounts, with the stolen USDC and USDT being swapped into ETH, routed through instant-exchange services like WellWallet and Kyrrex, converted to XMR via Wagyu, and moved across multiple chains, with 11 associated addresses published.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要体现在流动性与洗钱渠道而非某个协议：一笔九位数的稳定币余额被换成 ETH，再经即时兑换服务转为 XMR，使 WellWallet、Kyrrex、Wagyu 等 KYC 较宽松的兑换平台面临审视，涉事的未具名交易所账户与隐私币流动性也因此受到关注。在币安被盗案之后，该事件还会进一步强化市场对交易所账户安全与稳定币追踪能力的讨论。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through liquidity and laundering venues rather than a protocol: a nine-figure stablecoin balance was converted into ETH and then into XMR via instant-exchange services, exposing KYC-light swap platforms such as WellWallet, Kyrrex and Wagyu to scrutiny, and putting the unnamed exchange accounts and privacy-coin liquidity under the spotlight. The incident also feeds the broader narrative around exchange-account security and stablecoin tracing after the Binance hack.

timeline.text_en: Added details that the theft occurred on Nov. 1, funds were withdrawn as USDC/USDT, swapped into ETH via instant-exchange services including WellWallet and Kyrrex, converted to XMR through Wagyu, and 11 related addresses were published.

timeline.text_zh: 链上调查员 ZachXBT 报告称，一个身份不明的欧盟实体似乎从多个中心化交易所账户中损失了超过 1.06 亿美元，疑似攻击者将稳定币兑换为 ETH，再兑换为隐私币 XMR，并跨链转移资金以掩盖踪迹。
timeline.text_en: On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that an unidentified EU-based entity appears to have lost more than $106 million from multiple centralized exchange accounts, with the suspected attacker converting stablecoins to ETH, swapping into privacy coin XMR, and bridging funds across chains to obscure the trail.

timeline.text_en: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at roughly $115 billion, combining their electrical/optical interconnect and photonics capabilities to build a full-stack connectivity portfolio for AI infrastructure.

threads.title_zh: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
threads.title_en: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
threads.summary_zh: 调查已识别出影响 2.4.1 及更早版本的攻击向量；团队建议升级至 2.4.7，并称最新版本用户尚无热钱包被盗的可信报告。
threads.summary_en: The investigation identified an attack vector affecting versions 2.4.1 and earlier; the team advises upgrading to 2.4.7 and says there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.
threads.latest_update_zh: BTCPay Server 已识别出针对 2.4.1 或更早版本实例的攻击向量，建议用户升级至 2.4.7，并表示尚无运行最新版本的用户热钱包被盗的可信报告。
threads.latest_update_en: BTCPay Server identified an attack vector affecting instances running version 2.4.1 or earlier, advised upgrading to 2.4.7, and said there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.
threads.background_zh: 这一结论是在此前警告之后发布的：当时 BTCPay 在调查热钱包未授权提现报告期间，要求运营方临时关停服务器实例，并提供了关停指引。不到三个月前，BTCPay 曾在一次 8 月攻击后限制远程闪电网络访问，该攻击利用漏洞获取闪电网络守护进程（LND）凭证并盗取资金。目前尚不清楚本次攻击面是否与 8 月的漏洞有关。
threads.background_en: The findings follow an earlier warning in which BTCPay urged operators to shut down server instances while it investigated reports of unauthorized withdrawals from hot wallets, and shared instructions for doing so. Less than three months earlier, BTCPay had restricted remote Lightning access after an August attack that exploited a vulnerability to obtain Lightning Network Daemon (LND) credentials and steal funds. It remains unclear whether the current attack vector is connected to that August vulnerability.
threads.latest_summary_zh: BTPay Server disclosed an attack vector affecting instances on version 2.4.1 or earlier, urged users to upgrade to 2.4.7, and said no credible reports of hot-wallet theft exist for users on the latest release.
threads.latest_summary_en: BTPay Server disclosed an attack vector affecting instances on version 2.4.1 or earlier, urged users to upgrade to 2.4.7, and said no credible reports of hot-wallet theft exist for users on the latest release.
threads.market_impact_zh: 风险敞口位于自托管 BTCPay 实例上由商户自行运营的热钱包，这类钱包存放的是用于接收比特币支付的日常余额，而非交易所或托管机构的储备，因此传导渠道是商户资金的运营安全，而非市场流动性。由于受影响数量和损失规模尚未披露，对整体比特币市场结构的影响有限。
threads.market_impact_en: The exposure sits with merchant-operated hot wallets on self-hosted BTCPay instances, which hold working balances for accepting Bitcoin payments rather than exchange or custodian reserves, so the transmission channel is operational security of merchant funds rather than market liquidity. With affected counts and losses undisclosed, the read-through to broader BTC market structure is limited.

timeline.text_en: BTCPay Server identified an attack vector affecting instances running version 2.4.1 or earlier, advised upgrading to 2.4.7, and said there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.

timeline.text_zh: BTCPay Server 报告称，攻击者正在未经授权地从在线实例的热钱包中转移资金，并敦促所有运营者在调查结束前关闭服务器。
timeline.text_en: BTCPay Server reported that attackers are unauthorizedly moving funds from hot wallets on live instances and urged all operators to shut down their servers until the investigation concludes.

threads.title_zh: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
threads.title_en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
threads.summary_zh: Swell 在暂停存取款以调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动后，已重新开放存取款并将汇率恢复至正确水平，同时承诺下周内补偿按虚高汇率存入的用户；安全调查的最终结论尚未公布。
threads.summary_en: After pausing deposits and withdrawals amid the suspicious swETH/rswETH contract activity, Swell has reopened them, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and pledged to compensate users who deposited at the inflated rate within the following week; final findings of the security investigation have not been published.
threads.latest_update_zh: Swell 已重新开放 swETH 与 rswETH 的存取款，汇率恢复至正确水平，并表示按虚高汇率存入的用户将在下周内获得补偿。
threads.latest_update_en: Swell has reopened swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and said users who deposited at the inflated rate will be compensated within the following week.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Swell reopened swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after pausing them over suspicious contract activity, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and said users who deposited at the inflated rate will be compensated within the following week.
threads.latest_summary_en: Swell reopened swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after pausing them over suspicious contract activity, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and said users who deposited at the inflated rate will be compensated within the following week.

timeline.text_zh: Swell 已重新开放 swETH 与 rswETH 的存取款，汇率恢复至正确水平，并表示按虚高汇率存入的用户将在下周内获得补偿。
timeline.text_en: Swell has reopened swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and said users who deposited at the inflated rate will be compensated within the following week.

timeline.text_zh: Swell 官方表示正与安全合作伙伴调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，并采取预防措施；同时称目前暂无 ETH 从存款或提款合约流出，用户无需采取行动。
timeline.text_en: Swell officially said it is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity with security partners and taking precautionary measures; it stated that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts and users need not take action.

timeline.text_zh: 链上分析师 Spreek 报告称，Swell DAO 的 swETH 和 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，攻击者每小时将净值抬高最多 1%，并部署了四个恶意升级合约，可能危及约 2500 ETH。
timeline.text_en: Chain analyst Spreek reports a suspected leak of Swell DAO's swETH and rswETH admin keys, with attackers inflating NAV by up to 1% per hour and deploying four malicious upgrade contracts that could endanger roughly 2,500 ETH.

threads.title_zh: Chainalysis：以太坊重组触发THORChain紧急暂停，延迟洗钱
threads.title_en: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder
threads.summary_zh: THORChain 金库已因用户退回 10 ETH 恢复偿付能力，但多数受影响链的交易仍处于紧急暂停状态，核心开发团队正在修复，节点运营商将在确认各链安全后决定是否重新启用。
threads.summary_en: THORChain treasury solvency has been restored after a user returned the 10 ETH, but trading remains paused across most affected chains while core developers work on fixes and node operators decide whether to re-enable each chain after safety checks.
threads.latest_update_zh: THORChain 表示，误付的 10 ETH 已由用户主动退回，金库恢复偿付能力；但 AVAX、BASE、RUNE、XRPL 之外的多条链交易仍暂停，包括 ATOM、BCH、BSC、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、SOL、TRON、ZEC，待核心开发团队修复并由节点运营商确认安全后决定是否重启。
threads.latest_update_en: THORChain said the erroneously paid 10 ETH was voluntarily returned by a user and treasury solvency was restored; however, trading remained paused on ten chains—ATOM, BCH, BSC, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, SOL, TRON and ZEC—while AVAX, BASE, RUNE and XRPL stayed active, pending fixes and node-operator safety confirmation before re-enabling.
threads.background_zh: THORChain 是一个运行在多个原生区块链上的跨链流动性协议，由经济激励的节点运营者维护安全，其网络基于 Tendermint 和 Cosmos SDK 构建。链重组（reorg）指节点用另一条有效分支替换现有链历史的一部分，可能因同时出块、程序缺陷或攻击而发生。
threads.background_en: THORChain is a cross-chain liquidity protocol that runs on multiple native blockchains and is secured by economically incentivized node operators, with its network built on Tendermint and the Cosmos SDK. A chain reorganization, or reorg, occurs when nodes replace part of the existing chain history with a different valid branch, which can happen when blocks are produced simultaneously, through a bug, or via an attack.
threads.latest_summary_zh: THORChain resumed treasury solvency after a user returned 10 ETH that was erroneously paid out following an Ethereum block reorganization, while trading remained paused across ten chains pending safety checks and fixes.
threads.latest_summary_en: THORChain resumed treasury solvency after a user returned 10 ETH that was erroneously paid out following an Ethereum block reorganization, while trading remained paused across ten chains pending safety checks and fixes.
threads.market_impact_zh: RUNE 及 THORChain 的跨链兑换路径受影响最直接：包括 BTC、ETH、SOL、BSC 在内的十条链暂停，意味着这些兑换通道失去吞吐能力，协议内的流动性场所收窄，直至节点运营者恢复签名。金库恢复偿付能力消除了即时的资产负债表损失，但预防性暂停范围之广，使 RUNE 相关板块仍面临运营与情绪层面的风险。
threads.market_impact_en: RUNE and THORChain's cross-chain swap routes are the most directly exposed: with ten chains including BTC, ETH, SOL and BSC paused, those swap corridors lose throughput and the protocol's liquidity venues narrow until node operators re-enable signing. The restored treasury removes an immediate balance-sheet loss, but the breadth of the precautionary halt keeps operational and sentiment risk on the RUNE-linked segment.

timeline.text_en: THORChain said the erroneously paid 10 ETH was voluntarily returned by a user and treasury solvency was restored; however, trading remained paused on ten chains—ATOM, BCH, BSC, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, SOL, TRON and ZEC—while AVAX, BASE, RUNE and XRPL stayed active, pending fixes and node-operator safety confirmation before re-enabling.

timeline.text_zh: Chainalysis报告称，10月31日上午的一次以太坊重组导致THORChain对一笔10 ETH存款错误地进行了双重退款，引发紧急暂停，切断了其大多数桥接器上所有用户的跨链兑换，并意外拖延了从币安窃取资金的洗钱活动。
timeline.text_en: Chainalysis reported that an Ethereum reorganization on the morning of October 31 caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund on a 10 ETH deposit, prompting an emergency pause that cut off cross-chain swaps across most of its bridges for all users and inadvertently stalled laundering of funds stolen from Binance.

threads.title_zh: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
threads.title_en: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
threads.summary_zh: 伊朗已同意一项有条件的两天计划，霍尔木兹海峡将在美国第一天采取履约措施后第二天开放；但该计划尚未执行，海峡目前仍处于关闭状态，谈判需待美国履行条件后才能重启。
threads.summary_en: Iran has agreed to a conditional two-day plan under which the Strait of Hormuz would reopen on day two after US compliance measures on day one; the plan has not been implemented and the strait remains closed, with talks contingent on US fulfillment of conditions.
threads.latest_update_zh: 伊朗外长披露一项“两天计划”：第一天美国采取一系列履约措施，第二天霍尔木兹海峡开放并恢复交通；在美国履行包括确定新航线、解冻资金、结束海上封锁、解除新制裁等条件后，伊美谈判才会重启。
threads.latest_update_en: Iran's foreign minister disclosed a 'two-day plan': on day one the US takes a series of compliance measures, and on day two the Strait of Hormuz reopens and traffic returns to normal; talks would resume only after the US fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade, and new sanctions relief.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has agreed to a 'two-day plan' in which the US takes a series of compliance measures on day one and the Strait of Hormuz reopens on day two, with talks resuming only after Washington fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade and new sanctions relief.

timeline.text_en: Iran reiterated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are met, with an IRGC adviser saying Tehran will soon shut down 'illegal' shipping lanes in the strait.

threads.title_zh: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
threads.title_en: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
threads.summary_zh: 英特尔10月30日收跌28.58%至65.76美元，创1970年代以来最差单日表现；美国政府持股价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达持股价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收和EPS指引显著低于预期，CFO预计PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年；以色列晶圆厂爆炸预计造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson下调评级至中性。
threads.summary_en: Intel closed down 28.58% at $65.76 on October 30, its worst single-day performance since the 1970s; the US government's stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day and Nvidia's stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue and EPS guidance came in well below consensus, the CFO expects PC-market weakness through at least H1 2027, and an explosion at its Israeli fab is expected to cost about $600 million in revenue; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel to Neutral.
threads.latest_update_zh: 10月31日报道补充英特尔暴跌后的细节：英特尔收报65.76美元、跌28.58%；美国政府所持约10%股份价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达所持股份价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收指引150亿至160亿美元，低于LSEG预期的171亿美元，调整后EPS指引0.25美元，低于预期的0.43美元；CFO称PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年，内存等零部件成本上涨；以色列晶圆厂爆炸事故预计两个季度造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson将英特尔评级从买入下调至中性。
threads.latest_update_en: The October 31 report adds post-selloff details: Intel closed at $65.76, down 28.58%; the US government's roughly 10% stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day, while Nvidia's Intel stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue guidance was $15–16 billion versus LSEG consensus of $17.1 billion, and adjusted EPS guidance was $0.25 versus $0.43 expected; the CFO said PC-market weakness will persist at least through H1 2027 and memory/component costs are rising; an explosion at Intel's Israeli fab is expected to cause about $600 million in revenue loss over two quarters; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel from Buy to Neutral.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Intel fell 28.58% to $65.76 — its worst single day since the 1970s — after fourth-quarter guidance came in well below consensus, wiping roughly $12B from the US government's stake and $6B from Nvidia's, with the CFO flagging a PC slowdown through at least H1 2027, rising memory costs, and ~$600M in revenue loss from a fatal explosion at its Israeli fab.
threads.latest_summary_en: Intel fell 28.58% to $65.76 — its worst single day since the 1970s — after fourth-quarter guidance came in well below consensus, wiping roughly $12B from the US government's stake and $6B from Nvidia's, with the CFO flagging a PC slowdown through at least H1 2027, rising memory costs, and ~$600M in revenue loss from a fatal explosion at its Israeli fab.

timeline.text_en: The October 31 report adds post-selloff details: Intel closed at $65.76, down 28.58%; the US government's roughly 10% stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day, while Nvidia's Intel stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue guidance was $15–16 billion versus LSEG consensus of $17.1 billion, and adjusted EPS guidance was $0.25 versus $0.43 expected; the CFO said PC-market weakness will persist at least through H1 2027 and memory/component costs are rising; an explosion at Intel's Israeli fab is expected to cause about $600 million in revenue loss over two quarters; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel from Buy to Neutral.

timeline.text_zh: 10月30日美股收盘确认科技股与半导体板块大幅收低：纳指跌2.86%，标普500跌1.82%，费城半导体指数跌7.2%；英特尔收跌28.58%，创至少四十年来最差单日表现，闪迪、高通、AMD、美光、英伟达等芯片股同步下跌。
timeline.text_en: The October 30 US close confirmed a sharp tech and semiconductor selloff: Nasdaq fell 2.86%, S&P 500 fell 1.82%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 7.2%; Intel closed down 28.58%, its worst single-day performance in at least four decades, while SanDisk, Qualcomm, AMD, Micron, and Nvidia also fell.

timeline.text_zh: 盘中抛售扩大至半导体板块：英特尔跌幅扩大至30%，费城半导体指数跌5.7%，AMD跌约10%，Arm跌9.5%，英伟达跌3.3%且市值跌破5万亿美元；英特尔第四季度营收和EPS指引低于预期，并预计PC市场低迷至少持续至2027年上半年。
timeline.text_en: The intraday selloff widened across semiconductors: Intel fell 30%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 5.7%, AMD fell about 10%, Arm fell 9.5%, and Nvidia fell 3.3% with its market cap below $5 trillion; Intel's Q4 revenue and EPS guidance missed expectations and management expects PC weakness to persist at least through H1 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 美国股市大幅低开，纳斯达克指数下跌 2.2%，科技股抛售加深，英特尔因 PC 需求疲软和现金流担忧暴跌 25.7%，亚马逊因第四季度指引疲软下跌 5.3%，而埃克森美孚等能源股则上涨。
timeline.text_en: US equities opened sharply lower with the Nasdaq down 2.2% as the tech selloff deepened, led by Intel's 25.7% plunge on weak PC demand and cash-flow concerns and Amazon's 5.3% drop after soft Q4 guidance, while energy names like Exxon gained.

threads.title_zh: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
threads.title_en: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
threads.summary_zh: tBTC 铸造和赎回仍暂停，但资产仍有足额 BTC 支持，未发现未经授权的铸币、比特币转移或资金损失；节点运营商正在修补或离线，跨链桥将在安全维护完成且节点在已修补系统上恢复运行后重新开放。
threads.summary_en: tBTC minting and redemption remain paused, but tBTC remains fully BTC-backed with no unauthorized minting, Bitcoin transfers, or fund loss found; node operators are patching or offline, and the bridge will reopen after security maintenance is completed and nodes resume on patched systems.
threads.latest_update_zh: Threshold 将 tBTC 暂停归因于 Linux 内核漏洞 CVE-2026-98432，称所有 tBTC 节点运营商已完成服务器修补或暂时离线；另有一名运营商报告其基础设施发生与内核漏洞无关的安全事件，tBTC 节点用于支付交易费的以太坊账户被转走约 0.5 枚 ETH，但未发现签名密钥材料被访问。
threads.latest_update_en: Threshold attributed the tBTC pause to Linux kernel vulnerability CVE-2026-98432, saying all tBTC node operators patched or temporarily took nodes offline; one operator separately reported an unrelated infrastructure incident in which the Ethereum fee account for its tBTC node lost about 0.5 ETH, with no evidence of signing-key material access.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Threshold Network temporarily suspended tBTC minting and redemption over a Linux kernel vulnerability while confirming full BTC backing and no unauthorized minting or fund loss, with node operators patching or going offline.
threads.latest_summary_en: Threshold Network temporarily suspended tBTC minting and redemption over a Linux kernel vulnerability while confirming full BTC backing and no unauthorized minting or fund loss, with node operators patching or going offline.

timeline.text_zh: Threshold 将 tBTC 暂停归因于 Linux 内核漏洞 CVE-2026-98432，称所有 tBTC 节点运营商已完成服务器修补或暂时离线；另有一名运营商报告其基础设施发生与内核漏洞无关的安全事件，tBTC 节点用于支付交易费的以太坊账户被转走约 0.5 枚 ETH，但未发现签名密钥材料被访问。
timeline.text_en: Threshold attributed the tBTC pause to Linux kernel vulnerability CVE-2026-98432, saying all tBTC node operators patched or temporarily took nodes offline; one operator separately reported an unrelated infrastructure incident in which the Ethereum fee account for its tBTC node lost about 0.5 ETH, with no evidence of signing-key material access.

timeline.text_zh: Threshold Network报告称，tBTC仍保持全额抵押，没有未经授权的铸造或损失，但为进行跨链安全维护，新存款、铸造和赎回已暂停，而以太坊和L2上的转账仍在继续。
timeline.text_en: Threshold Network reported that tBTC remains fully collateralized with no unauthorized minting or losses, but new deposits, minting, and redemptions are paused for cross-chain security maintenance while transfers on Ethereum and L2s continue.

threads.title_zh: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
threads.title_en: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
threads.summary_zh: 币安安全事件后的资产补足比例升至90%，十种主要代币已100%覆盖，剩余10%为流动性较低资产；新的储备证明快照已完成，提现仍计划于11月1日恢复。
threads.summary_en: Coverage for assets stolen in Binance's security incident has risen to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered and the remaining 10% in less liquid assets; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot is complete and withdrawals remain scheduled to reopen on Nov 1.
threads.latest_update_zh: 币安称被盗资产补足比例已从约80%升至90%，BTC、ETH、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP、USD1、RLUSD与ZEC已实现100%覆盖；10月31日8:00完成新的储备证明快照，完整零知识证明预计11月3日生成；提现仍计划11月1日恢复，SAFU部分调用预计未来24小时内进行。
threads.latest_update_en: Binance said stolen-asset coverage rose from about 80% to 90%, with BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC fully covered; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot was completed on Oct 31 at 08:00, with the full zero-knowledge proof expected around Nov 3; withdrawals remain planned to reopen Nov 1, and part of the SAFU draw is expected within 24 hours.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Binance said coverage for assets stolen in its security incident has climbed to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered via SAFU, insurance and corporate funds, a fresh proof-of-reserves snapshot completed, and withdrawals still on track to reopen on November 1.
threads.latest_summary_en: Binance said coverage for assets stolen in its security incident has climbed to 90%, with ten major tokens fully covered via SAFU, insurance and corporate funds, a fresh proof-of-reserves snapshot completed, and withdrawals still on track to reopen on November 1.

timeline.text_zh: 币安称被盗资产补足比例已从约80%升至90%，BTC、ETH、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP、USD1、RLUSD与ZEC已实现100%覆盖；10月31日8:00完成新的储备证明快照，完整零知识证明预计11月3日生成；提现仍计划11月1日恢复，SAFU部分调用预计未来24小时内进行。
timeline.text_en: Binance said stolen-asset coverage rose from about 80% to 90%, with BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC fully covered; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot was completed on Oct 31 at 08:00, with the full zero-knowledge proof expected around Nov 3; withdrawals remain planned to reopen Nov 1, and part of the SAFU draw is expected within 24 hours.

timeline.text_zh: 币安表示，其对安全漏洞的调查发现，除一台被入侵的笔记本电脑外，还存在其他入侵点；已与合作伙伴冻结约30亿美元受影响资产；所有损失将由SAFU基金和公司资本承担；提现预计约45小时后恢复，充值不受影响。
timeline.text_en: Binance said its investigation into the security breach uncovered additional intrusion points beyond a compromised laptop, that roughly $3 billion in affected assets has been frozen with partners, that all losses will be covered by the SAFU fund and corporate capital, and that withdrawals should resume in about 45 hours while deposits remain unaffected.

threads.title_zh: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
threads.title_en: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
threads.summary_zh: Alphabet Q3 2026财报后股价下跌逾12%至285美元，市值缩水近5000亿美元；市场聚焦EPS不及预期和AI基础设施投入导致的负自由现金流。尽管云收入同比增长103%，多家机构下调评级或目标价，技术形态受损，分析师预计短期维持区间震荡，但超卖状态和接近52周低点可能限制进一步下跌。
threads.summary_en: After Alphabet's Q3 2026 earnings, shares fell more than 12% to $285, erasing nearly $500B in market value; investors focused on the EPS miss and negative free cash flow from AI infrastructure spending. Although Cloud revenue grew 103% YoY, multiple institutions cut ratings or price targets, technical damage occurred, and analysts expect near-term range-bound trading, though oversold conditions and proximity to the 52-week low may limit further declines.
threads.latest_update_zh: 财报公布后 Alphabet 股价进一步下跌逾12%至285美元，市值缩水近5000亿美元；多家机构下调评级、目标价或盈利预测，分析师预计短期股价区间震荡，RSI降至20出头并接近270.70美元的52周低点。
threads.latest_update_en: After the earnings report, Alphabet shares fell further more than 12% to $285, erasing nearly $500B in market value; multiple institutions cut ratings, price targets, or earnings forecasts, and analysts expect near-term range-bound trading, with RSI in the low 20s and the stock near its $270.70 52-week low.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Alphabet shares fell more than 12% to $285 after third-quarter earnings, erasing nearly $500 billion in market value as investors focused on an EPS miss and negative free cash flow from AI infrastructure investment, with analysts expecting near-term range-bound trading.
threads.latest_summary_en: Alphabet shares fell more than 12% to $285 after third-quarter earnings, erasing nearly $500 billion in market value as investors focused on an EPS miss and negative free cash flow from AI infrastructure investment, with analysts expecting near-term range-bound trading.

timeline.text_zh: 财报公布后 Alphabet 股价进一步下跌逾12%至285美元，市值缩水近5000亿美元；多家机构下调评级、目标价或盈利预测，分析师预计短期股价区间震荡，RSI降至20出头并接近270.70美元的52周低点。
timeline.text_en: After the earnings report, Alphabet shares fell further more than 12% to $285, erasing nearly $500B in market value; multiple institutions cut ratings, price targets, or earnings forecasts, and analysts expect near-term range-bound trading, with RSI in the low 20s and the stock near its $270.70 52-week low.

timeline.text_zh: 后续解读补充了更多财报细节：Alphabet Q3营收约1276亿美元、同比增长25%但低于LSEG预期的1282亿美元；搜索及其他收入增长12%至633.5亿美元，但广告总收入约820亿美元低于834亿美元预期；自由现金流约负90.7亿美元，连续第二个季度为负且缺口较上季约59亿美元扩大；当季还计入52亿美元欧盟罚款付款及TPU库存增加的影响；调整后EPS为2.67美元，低于3.02美元预期；公司维持2026年1950亿至2050亿美元资本开支指引，并预计2027年显著增加。
timeline.text_en: Follow-up analysis added more earnings details: Alphabet Q3 revenue was about $127.6B, up 25% YoY but below the $128.2B LSEG estimate; Search & other revenue rose 12% to $63.35B while total ad revenue of about $82B missed the $83.4B estimate; free cash flow was about -$9.07B, negative for a second consecutive quarter with the gap widening by about $5.9B QoQ; the quarter included a $5.2B EU fine payment and higher TPU inventory; adjusted EPS was $2.67 versus $3.02 expected; the company maintained 2026 capex guidance of $195B-$205B and expects a significant 2027 increase.

timeline.text_zh: Alphabet 2026 年第三季度财报显示，谷歌云收入创纪录增长 103% 至 307 亿美元，主要受企业 AI 基础设施和 TPU 需求推动，但净利润下降约 25%，原因是 87 亿美元的股权投资损失和巨额资本支出使自由现金流转为负值，导致该股盘后交易下跌 9.84%。
timeline.text_en: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results showed record Google Cloud growth of 103% to $30.7B driven by enterprise AI infrastructure and TPU demand, but net profit fell about 25% on $8.7B in equity-investment losses and heavy capex pushed free cash flow negative, sending the stock down 9.84% in after-hours trading.

focus.title_zh: 巴拉圭总统在Ueno数字银行倒闭后辞职
focus.title_en: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
focus.summary_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno Bank倒闭后辞职并被众议院弹劾。该行被发现资本低于监管最低要求的一半，公共存款约8亿美元，导致约三百万客户无法访问账户。
focus.summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned and was impeached by the lower house after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank — found to hold capital below half the regulatory minimum with about $800 million in public deposits — left roughly three million customers unable to access their accounts.
focus.latest_update_zh: 巴拉圭议员以78票通过弹劾程序，央行公布了Ueno银行储户的首批赔付名单。
focus.latest_update_en: Paraguayan lawmakers approved impeachment proceedings with 78 votes, and the central bank outlined an initial payout group for Ueno Bank depositors.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.
focus.latest_summary_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned as lawmakers voted 78 in favor of impeachment proceedings amid the Ueno Bank crisis, while the central bank outlined an initial payout group for depositors.

timeline.text_zh: 巴拉圭议员以78票通过弹劾程序，央行公布了Ueno银行储户的首批赔付名单。
timeline.text_en: Paraguayan lawmakers approved impeachment proceedings with 78 votes, and the central bank outlined an initial payout group for Ueno Bank depositors.

timeline.text_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚在数字贷款机构Ueno银行倒闭后辞职，该事件导致数百万客户无法取回资金，并引发不断加深的政治危机。
timeline.text_en: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned after the collapse of digital lender Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to access their funds and triggered a deepening political crisis.

timeline.text_zh: Ueno关闭后，Bybit在巴拉圭的USDT报价显示13%溢价，央行正准备向储户支付存款担保款项。
timeline.text_en: Bybit USDT quotes in Paraguay showed a 13% premium after Ueno's closure, as the central bank prepared deposit-guarantee payments for savers.

focus.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber 网络安全模型
focus.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber cybersecurity model
focus.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的AI模型，该公司称其在测试中更擅长发现漏洞，越界比例低于1%。
focus.summary_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused AI model that it says is better at finding vulnerabilities while going out of bounds less than 1 percent of the time during testing.
focus.latest_update_zh: OpenAI向一小部分经过审核的客户发布了GPT-6 Cyber，并将其网络安全风险评级从上一代「高」上调至「关键」；同时披露该模型发现81个高严重性Firefox漏洞、协助开发针对948个Linux内核漏洞的可用利用程序，并已向「Daybreak Red」层级特定客户开放。
focus.latest_update_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to a small set of vetted customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating from High to Critical, disclosed findings of 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, and made it available to select customers in the Daybreak Red tier.
focus.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.
focus.latest_summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to vetted security customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating to Critical, and demonstrated the model's ability to uncover high-severity Firefox and Linux kernel vulnerabilities and develop working exploits.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI向一小部分经过审核的客户发布了GPT-6 Cyber，并将其网络安全风险评级从上一代「高」上调至「关键」；同时披露该模型发现81个高严重性Firefox漏洞、协助开发针对948个Linux内核漏洞的可用利用程序，并已向「Daybreak Red」层级特定客户开放。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber to a small set of vetted customers, raised its cybersecurity risk rating from High to Critical, disclosed findings of 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, and made it available to select customers in the Daybreak Red tier.

timeline.text_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，这是一款专注于网络安全的模型，旨在发现可利用漏洞并开发修复方案，同时保持在授权范围内。
timeline.text_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorized scope.

focus.title_zh: 币安遭大规模黑客攻击，公司储备覆盖损失
focus.title_en: Binance hit by large-scale hack, losses covered by company reserves
focus.summary_zh: 据报道，在币安发生 63 亿美元黑客事件后，包括美联储和 OCC 在内的美国监管机构正联系银行，排查中断和异常活动，同时银行也在审查自身网络安全准备情况。
focus.summary_en: US regulators including the Federal Reserve and OCC are reportedly contacting banks to probe for disruptions and unusual activity following a $6.3 billion Binance hack, while banks review their own cybersecurity readiness.
focus.latest_update_zh: 币安向 ArbitrumDAO 治理论坛提交提案，申请将 Arbitrum 安全委员会在币安热钱包被盗后冻结的 8,425.997 枚 ETH 和 74,559,805.2 枚 ARB 返还至币安指定的恢复地址；提案尚处论坛讨论阶段，后续需经过 Snapshot 意向投票和链上治理，预计全程约 49 天，且不申请新增 DAO 金库拨款。
focus.latest_update_en: Binance submitted a proposal to the ArbitrumDAO governance forum seeking the return of 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after the Binance hot-wallet hack to a Binance-designated recovery address; the proposal is still in forum discussion and would require a Snapshot sentiment vote and on-chain governance, with an expected total process of about 49 days, and it does not request new DAO treasury funding.
focus.background_zh: 冷存储将私钥置于离线环境，交易则通过联网设备构建并广播；分片密钥设计将密钥材料拆分，使任何单一主体或系统都不掌握完整密钥。币安联合创始人赵长鹏公开回应了该事件，称“没有100%的安全”。Coinbase长期提供客户币种的冷存储服务，作为自行托管的替代方案。
focus.background_en: Cold storage keeps private keys offline, while transactions are prepared and broadcast from connected devices; split-key designs divide key material so no single party or system holds a complete key. Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao publicly addressed the incident, saying there is "no 100% security." Coinbase has long offered cold storage of customer coins as an alternative to self-custody.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Binance submitted an Arbitrum governance proposal seeking the return of roughly 8,426 ETH and 74.56 million ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after a Binance hot-wallet hack, pledging the recovered assets will offset user losses already covered by SAFU and corporate treasury reserves.
focus.latest_summary_en: Binance submitted an Arbitrum governance proposal seeking the return of roughly 8,426 ETH and 74.56 million ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after a Binance hot-wallet hack, pledging the recovered assets will offset user losses already covered by SAFU and corporate treasury reserves.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于托管与交易对手风险：大额持有者重新权衡资产存放地点，可能改变各平台间的现货流动性、BTC与稳定币流向，并提升对储备证明披露的关注度。与交易所相关的代币及提供托管服务的平台是受影响最直接的板块。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is custody and counterparty risk: large holders re-weighing where balances sit can shift spot liquidity, BTC and stablecoin flows between venues, and attention to proof-of-reserves disclosures. Exchange-linked tokens and custodial venues are the segments most directly in focus.

timeline.text_en: Binance submitted a proposal to the ArbitrumDAO governance forum seeking the return of 8,425.997 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB frozen by Arbitrum's Security Council after the Binance hot-wallet hack to a Binance-designated recovery address; the proposal is still in forum discussion and would require a Snapshot sentiment vote and on-chain governance, with an expected total process of about 49 days, and it does not request new DAO treasury funding.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，在币安发生 63 亿美元黑客事件后，包括美联储和 OCC 在内的美国监管机构正联系银行，排查中断和异常活动，同时银行也在审查自身网络安全准备情况。
timeline.text_en: US regulators including the Federal Reserve and OCC are reportedly contacting banks to probe for disruptions and unusual activity following a $6.3 billion Binance hack, while banks review their own cybersecurity readiness.

timeline.text_zh:
在币安据报遭遇64亿美元黑客攻击后，Coinbase强调其分片密钥（split-key）冷存储架构，并表示99%的客户资产存放于冷存储之中。该表态被置于行业重新审视托管安全与密钥管理的背景下。

这一表态把焦点引向交易所如何设计密钥管理架构，而这一点正是客户与交易对手评估大型平台托管风险的核心。

各方报道对事件规模表述不一，有63亿美元与64亿美元两种说法。币安自身的初步调查称，10月29日事件影响约63.4亿美元数字资产，截至10月31日已有98%的受影响代币得到补充，并可在其储备证明页面核验。
timeline.text_en:
In the wake of a reported $6.4 billion hack at Binance, Coinbase pointed to its split-key cold storage design and stated that 99% of customer assets are held in cold storage. The disclosure was framed as the industry re-examines custody security and key management.

The remarks shift attention to how exchanges architect key management, which is central to how customers and counterparties gauge custodial risk at a major venue.

Reports on the incident differ on magnitude, describing a $6.3 billion or $6.4 billion breach. Binance's own initial findings said about $6.34 billion of digital assets were affected in the Oct. 29 incident and that 98% of the impacted tokens had been replenished as of Oct. 31, verifiable on its proof-of-reserves page.

timeline.text_zh:
区块链分析公司 Elliptic 在周一发布的报告中称，币安 64.3 亿美元被盗案的实施者在不到四天内将资金分散到 11 条区块链上的约 1.2 万个钱包，交易超过 4 万笔——大约每 25 秒就启用一个新钱包。Elliptic 表示，在 Tether 与 Circle 出手冻结被盗稳定币后，约 28.5 亿美元（占 44%）已被冻结或查扣。

据 Elliptic 数据，本次 44% 的冻结或查扣比例远高于 2025 年 2 月朝鲜盗取 Bybit 15 亿美元后约 3% 的水平，该公司将此归因于稳定币发行方在数分钟内采取了行动。

Elliptic 发现，Tether 在被盗 USDT 到达攻击者钱包后 37 分钟即于以太坊上完成冻结，Circle 则在全部 8.23 亿美元被盗 USDC 被兑换前予以冻结；但仍有约 7.86 亿美元稳定币流出。该公司表示，这一洗钱过程明显是自动化的，但没有证据显示由 AI 做决策，理由是时间间隔固定、金额设定统一、盲目重试，以及类似人类工作时间的停顿。
timeline.text_en:
Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic said in an analysis published Monday that in under four days the attacker behind the $6.43 billion Binance theft spread the funds across roughly 12,000 wallets on 11 blockchains in more than 40,000 transactions — about one new wallet every 25 seconds. Elliptic reported that about $2.85 billion, or 44% of the haul, has already been frozen or seized after Tether and Circle moved to lock up stolen stablecoins.

The 44% freeze-or-seizure rate compares with roughly 3% after North Korea's $1.5 billion Bybit hack in February 2025, according to Elliptic, which attributes the difference to stablecoin issuers acting within minutes.

Elliptic found Tether froze stolen USDT on Ethereum 37 minutes after it reached the attacker's wallet, and Circle froze all $823 million in stolen USDC before any could be swapped; about $786 million in stablecoins nonetheless escaped. The firm said the laundering is clearly automated but shows no AI decision-making, citing fixed timing, set amounts, blind retries and pauses resembling human working hours.

timeline.text_zh: Elliptic 追踪显示，币安黑客在不到4天内通过11条链上约1.2万个钱包、超过4万笔交易进行自动化洗钱；被盗64.3亿美元中约28.5亿美元已被冻结或查扣，约32.4亿美元仍留在相关地址，以ETH和BTC为主。自11月1日起ETH、SOL、NEAR和XRP开始移动，2.33亿枚XRP于11月2日转入6个新地址；约28枚BTC（约220万美元）首次进入CoinJoin混币，另有约1600万美元转入同样存有9月Bitget被盗资金的地址。
timeline.text_en: Elliptic tracing shows the Binance hacker automated laundering through roughly 12,000 wallets across 11 chains and over 40,000 transactions in under four days; of the $6.43 billion haul, about $2.85 billion has been frozen or seized and about $3.24 billion remains in related addresses, mainly ETH and BTC. Since November 1, ETH, SOL, NEAR and XRP began moving, with 233 million XRP moved entirely to six new addresses on November 2; about 28 BTC (~$2.2 million) entered CoinJoin mixing for the first time, and about $16 million was sent to addresses that also hold September Bitget stolen funds.

timeline.text_zh: FBI正式将币安约60亿美元黑客攻击归因于朝鲜TraderTraitor组织，并公布数百个关联地址；币安在分阶段恢复提现后重新开放包括美元在内的法币提现；美国特勤局称已与行业伙伴冻结相当一部分被盗资产。
timeline.text_en: The FBI formally attributed the roughly $6 billion Binance hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group and published hundreds of associated addresses; Binance reopened fiat withdrawals including USD after restoring crypto withdrawals in phases; the U.S. Secret Service said it froze a significant portion of stolen assets with industry partners.

timeline.text_zh: QCP 报告称，比特币在跌至 76,141 美元后第四次守住 76,000 至 76,600 美元支撑区间；币安在遭攻击后重新开放 15 条网络的提现，净流出 36.4 亿美元（约占资产的 2.1%）；美国现货比特币 ETF 周五录得 6.432 亿美元流出。
timeline.text_en: QCP reported Bitcoin holding the $76,000–$76,600 support zone for a fourth time after dipping to $76,141, while Binance reopened withdrawals across 15 networks post-exploit with $3.64B in net outflows (~2.1% of assets) and U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $643.2M in Friday outflows.

timeline.text_zh: 币安在6.3亿美元黑客攻击后分阶段恢复提现期间，净流出从约58亿美元扩大至超过70亿美元；币安称已补充约95%受影响资产（高于周六的90%），并发布了新的储备快照，预计周一更新储备证明报告。OKX以4.45亿美元24小时净流入领先交易所。
timeline.text_en: As Binance restored withdrawals in phases after its $6.3 billion hack, net outflows widened from about $5.8 billion to more than $7 billion; Binance said it had replenished approximately 95% of affected assets, up from 90% on Saturday, published a new reserves snapshot and expected an updated proof-of-reserves report Monday. OKX led exchanges with $445 million in 24-hour net inflows.

timeline.text_zh: 一份加密新闻摘要报道称，朝鲜黑客洗白了从币安窃取的 2.42 亿美元，币安联合创始人何一否认了涉及一名工程师和一名朝鲜特工的传闻，包括英伟达在内的 50 家公司反对 OKXICE 将其股份代币化，同时还有一条关于比特币 RSI 的看涨消息。
timeline.text_en: A crypto news digest reported that North Korean hackers laundered $242 million stolen from Binance, Binance's Yi He denied a rumor involving an engineer and a North Korean agent, and 50 companies including Nvidia opposed OKXICE tokenizing their shares, alongside a bullish Bitcoin RSI note.

timeline.text_zh: 链上分析师称，币安攻击发生约两天后，攻击者通过 Tron 相关路径转移约2.42亿美元；在 Tether 冻结约3.787亿 USDT 后，资金经 Relay、THORChain、Chainflip、Symbiosis 等渠道转移，另有约4170万美元流经 Bitget Wallet，Tron 上剩余约750万美元，其他链上超过30亿美元被盗资产基本未动。
timeline.text_en: An on-chain analyst said that about two days after the Binance attack, the attacker moved roughly $242 million through Tron-related paths; after Tether froze about 378.7 million USDT, funds were routed via Relay, THORChain, Chainflip, Symbiosis and other channels, with about $41.7 million flowing through Bitget Wallet, about $7.5 million remaining on Tron, and more than $3 billion in stolen assets on other chains largely unmoved.

focus.title_zh: ZetaChain 持有人批准逐步关停 L1、将 ZETA 迁移至 Solana 的计划
focus.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
focus.summary_zh: ZetaChain 的72小时治理投票正在进行并将于11月7日结束；若通过，Layer 1 主网将在12月9日左右永久停止出块，ZETA 按1:1迁移为 Solana SPL 代币，同时推出隐私AI应用 ZetaLabs，并在2027年分批销毁约5500万枚原验证者奖励ZETA。
focus.summary_en: ZetaChain's 72-hour governance vote is ongoing and concludes on November 7; if passed, Layer 1 block production will permanently halt around December 9, ZETA will migrate 1:1 to a Solana SPL token, ZetaLabs will launch, and about 55 million ZETA originally allocated for validator rewards will be burned in batches throughout 2027.
focus.latest_update_zh: 新披露该治理提案还计划在2027年分批销毁约5500万枚原用于验证者奖励的ZETA，并明确投票于11月7日结束。
focus.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed that the governance proposal also plans to burn approximately 55 million ZETA originally allocated for validator rewards in batches throughout 2027, and specifies voting concludes on November 7.
focus.background_zh: ZetaChain 基于 Cosmos SDK 和 Tendermint 共识构建，并包含一个兼容以太坊虚拟机的执行层 zEVM，定位为支持全链（omnichain）智能合约和跨链消息传递的基础层。Anuma 是同一团队的私密 AI 聊天产品，它会为用户对话建立加密记忆，数据保存在用户设备上并可跨不同 AI 模型使用。Solana 是一条高吞吐量的 Layer 1，SPL 是其原生代币标准，因此 ZETA 迁移意味着在 Solana 上发行该资产并在原链上将其退出。
focus.background_en: ZetaChain was built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint consensus and included an Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible execution layer called zEVM, positioning itself as a base layer for omnichain smart contracts and cross-chain messaging between otherwise separate networks. Anuma is the same team's private AI chat product, which builds an encrypted memory of a user's conversations that stays on the user's device and travels across different AI models. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1, and SPL is its native token standard, so migrating ZETA means issuing the asset on Solana and retiring it on its original chain.
focus.latest_summary_zh: ZetaChain opened an onchain governance vote to permanently stop Layer 1 block production on December 9 and migrate native ZETA 1:1 to Solana as an SPL token, alongside launching a privacy-focused AI app (ZetaLabs) and burning roughly 55 million ZETA earmarked for validator rewards throughout 2027.
focus.latest_summary_en: ZetaChain opened an onchain governance vote to permanently stop Layer 1 block production on December 9 and migrate native ZETA 1:1 to Solana as an SPL token, alongside launching a privacy-focused AI app (ZetaLabs) and burning roughly 55 million ZETA earmarked for validator rewards throughout 2027.
focus.market_impact_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。
focus.market_impact_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.

timeline.text_en: Exchanges must confirm the ZETA-to-Solana swap before a second governance vote sets the snapshot, token claims, and shutdown schedule.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：治理提案第68号以99.4%支持和58%参与率通过，超过40%法定人数；ZETA将以1:1兑换为Solana SPL代币并保留代码和总供应量；投票不会立即触发关停或迁移，核心贡献者将提交第二份提案说明提款窗口、快照区块高度、关停时间表、代币申领流程和交易所转换期。
timeline.text_en: Added details: governance proposal 68 passed with 99.4% support and 58% participation, exceeding the 40% quorum; ZETA will become a Solana SPL token via 1:1 conversion with same ticker and total supply; the vote does not immediately trigger shutdown or migration, and core contributors will submit a second proposal detailing the withdrawal window, snapshot block height, shutdown timetable, token claim process, and exchange conversion period.

timeline.text_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有者投票决定关闭该项目的 Layer 1 网络，并将 ZETA 资产迁移至 Solana，团队将转向其私有 AI 应用 Anuma，但此次迁移还需再进行一次投票。
timeline.text_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.

focus.title_en: 美股光模块龙头Marvell宣布以全股票交易收购光芯片龙头Lumentum，对价约1150亿美元
focus.summary_zh: Marvell 以全股票方式收购 Lumentum（企业价值约 1150 亿美元，换股比例 4.500 股，溢价约 23.9%，股权分配 67/33）已宣布但尚未完成，目标为 2028 年上半年，尚待股东和监管批准；宣布后两家公司的盘前股价均转跌。
focus.summary_en: Marvell's all-stock acquisition of Lumentum (~$115B enterprise value, 4.500-share exchange ratio, ~23.9% premium, 67/33 ownership split) is announced but not closed, targeted for H1 2028 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals; premarket shares of both companies turned lower after the announcement.
focus.latest_update_zh: 交易条款细节披露：Lumentum股东每股换4.500股Marvell普通股，隐含每股约1132美元、企业价值约1150亿美元，较10月28日未受影响收盘价溢价约23.9%；合并后Marvell股东持股约67%、Lumentum股东约33%；预计2028年上半年完成，仍需双方股东及监管批准；Matt Murphy留任CEO，Lumentum获三个董事席位。消息公布后两股盘前由涨约4%转为下跌，MRVL跌约0.7%、LITE跌超1.2%。
focus.latest_update_en: Deal terms disclosed: each Lumentum share converts into 4.500 Marvell shares, implying ~$1,132/share and ~$115B enterprise value, a ~23.9% premium to the unaffected Oct 28 close; post-close Marvell holders own ~67% and Lumentum holders ~33%; closing expected in H1 2028 subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; Matt Murphy remains CEO and Lumentum gains three board seats. Premarket shares of both reversed early ~4% gains, with MRVL down ~0.7% and LITE down over 1.2%.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Marvell Technology agreed to acquire optical communications firm Lumentum in an all-stock deal implying roughly $115B enterprise value (~$1,132/share, 23.9% premium), with Marvell holders owning about 67% of the combined company; premarket shares of both reversed early gains, with MRVL down ~0.7% and LITE down over 1.2%.
focus.latest_summary_en: Marvell Technology agreed to acquire optical communications firm Lumentum in an all-stock deal implying roughly $115B enterprise value (~$1,132/share, 23.9% premium), with Marvell holders owning about 67% of the combined company; premarket shares of both reversed early gains, with MRVL down ~0.7% and LITE down over 1.2%.
