archived.title_zh: OpenAI、Google和Meta在白宫自愿协议下承诺进行独立AI安全审计
archived.title_en: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge independent AI safety audits under voluntary White House deal
archived.latest_update_zh: 白宫公布了该自愿协议的全部细节，正式名称为《前沿责任联合承诺》（Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities），由科技高管签署，属道义约束而非法律强制，并由总统顾问David Sacks在线分享。
archived.latest_update_en: The White House released full details of the voluntary accord, officially titled the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities', signed by tech executives as a morally binding commitment and shared online by presidential adviser David Sacks.

archived.title_zh: SEC工作人员发布加密FAQ，澄清代币回购与流动性质押
archived.title_en: SEC Staff Issues Crypto FAQs Clarifying Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking
archived.latest_update_zh: SEC工作人员在9月28日修订了其代币回购FAQ，新增‘无中心方’条件，缩小了发行人回购公告不被视为管理代币价值承诺的情形。
archived.latest_update_en: SEC staff revised its token buyback FAQ on September 28, adding a 'no central party' condition that narrows the circumstances under which an issuer's buyback announcement is not deemed a commitment to manage token value.

archived.title_zh: SEC提议修订规则，扩大私人市场负责任的零售化
archived.title_en: SEC Proposes Amendments to Expand Responsible Retailization of Private Markets
archived.latest_update_zh: SEC提议允许注册投资顾问收取最高20%的绩效费，并将合格投资者定义扩大至注册会计师和特许金融分析师等专业人士。
archived.latest_update_en: The SEC proposed allowing registered investment advisers to charge up to 20% performance fees and expanding the accredited investor definition to include professionals such as CPAs and CFAs.

archived.title_zh: IBM 将 Digital Asset Haven 连接至 Swift 区块链账本，支持代币化存款交易
archived.title_en: IBM connects Digital Asset Haven to Swift blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit transactions
archived.latest_update_zh: Swift CEO Javier Pérez-Tasso 在 Sibos 2026 上表示，Swift 的区块链账本现已上线，到今年年底至少 19 家银行将使用该账本，覆盖 5 种主要货币，以代币化存款支持 7×24 小时支付。
archived.latest_update_en: Swift CEO Javier Pérez-Tasso said at Sibos 2026 that Swift's blockchain ledger is now live, with at least 19 banks using it across 5 major currencies by year-end to enable 24/7 tokenized-deposit payments.

archived.title_zh: DeepSeek 公开 DSec 弹性计算平台技术细节
archived.title_en: DeepSeek discloses technical details of its DSec elastic compute platform
archived.latest_update_zh: DeepSeek在知乎发布独家技术长文，首次系统性地解释了DSec（DeepSeek Elastic Compute），即支撑V4.1 Agent训练的弹性计算平台。
archived.latest_update_en: DeepSeek published an exclusive technical long-form on Zhihu giving the first systematic explanation of DSec (DeepSeek Elastic Compute), the elastic computing platform underlying V4.1 Agent training.

archived.title_zh: 【美国伊利诺伊州发布 0.2% 数字资产交易税草案细则，稳定币纳入征税】
archived.title_en: 【美国伊利诺伊州发布 0.2% 数字资产交易税草案细则，稳定币纳入征税】
archived.latest_update_zh: 草案明确该数字资产交易税拟于 2027 年 1 月 1 日正式生效。
archived.latest_update_en: The draft rules specify the digital asset transaction tax is proposed to take effect on January 1, 2027.

archived.title_zh: 币安上线Hyperliquid的HYPE代币现货交易
archived.title_en: Binance Lists Hyperliquid's HYPE Token for Spot Trading
archived.latest_update_zh: 币安将 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 代币上线现货交易，CZ 将此举置于行业整体增长与 DEX 竞争加剧的背景下。
archived.latest_update_en: Binance listed Hyperliquid's HYPE token for spot trading, with CZ framing the move within broader industry growth and rising DEX competition.

archived.title_zh: Ondo 推出基于贝莱德策略的代币化投资组合
archived.title_en: Ondo Launches Tokenized Portfolios Built on BlackRock Strategies
archived.latest_update_zh:
贝莱德已将投资组合以数字代币形式搬上区块链，把这家全球最大资产管理公司的代币化真实世界资产（RWA）产品线延伸至主流投资产品。据有关此次上线的报道，组合由贝莱德构建，Ondo Finance 负责代币化，为每个组合发行一枚跟踪其表现的代币，涉及三个投资组合。

此举为代币化真实世界资产带来了来自全球最大资产管理公司的重要主流背书，推动链上组合产品从细分试点走向主流投资品种。

这些代币化产品属于模型投资组合，即预设的投资模板，每个组合发行一枚代币以跟踪其表现。有关此次上线的报道将代币化环节与 Ondo Finance 联系在一起。
archived.latest_update_en: BlackRock has brought investment portfolios onto the blockchain as digital tokens, extending tokenized real-world-asset products from the world's largest asset manager into mainstream investment offerings.

archived.title_zh: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
archived.title_en: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
archived.latest_update_zh: 特朗普与多家科技公司高管签署了一份与人工智能相关、具有「道德约束力」的文件，称其「某种程度上像是一部宪法」；政府正考虑成立约10人的AI监督委员会；特朗普还宣布已正式将「人工智能」改名为「超级智能」（Super Intelligence/SI）。
archived.latest_update_en: Trump signed a 'morally binding' AI-related document with leading tech executives, calling it 'somewhat like a constitution'; the government is considering an approximately 10-person AI oversight committee; Trump also announced he had officially renamed 'Artificial Intelligence' as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).

archived.title_zh: Blockchain.com据悉计划今年进行5亿美元IPO
archived.title_en: Blockchain.com Is Said to Target $500 Million IPO This Year
archived.latest_update_zh: 新增估值区间为40亿至60亿美元，并披露Blockchain.com已于今年早些时候向SEC秘密提交IPO申请。
archived.latest_update_en: Adds a valuation range of $4 billion to $6 billion and discloses that Blockchain.com confidentially filed for an IPO with the SEC earlier this year.

archived.title_zh: Chainlink 发布 CCIP 新版本并集成以太坊快速确认规则
archived.title_en: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
archived.latest_update_zh: Ethlabs已将以太坊快速确认规则集成到Chainlink CCIP 2.0中，启用一条可选的更快速跨链路径，在相关场景下可将以太坊确认时间从约13分钟缩短至12至24秒，且无需硬分叉。
archived.latest_update_en: Ethlabs has integrated Ethereum Fast Confirmation Rules into Chainlink CCIP 2.0, enabling an optional faster cross-chain path that can reduce Ethereum confirmations in relevant scenarios from about 13 minutes to 12–24 seconds without a hard fork.

archived.title_zh: 英伟达称其新AI安全平台可在“毫秒级”内控制失控智能体
archived.title_en: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’
archived.latest_update_zh: Nvidia 正式发布 Open Agent Safety Platform，并披露其由开源 OpenShell 沙箱运行时和基于 BlueField-4 的 Sentry 硬件看门狗组成，后者可在毫秒内隔离行为异常的 AI agent，且已有超过 100 家启动合作伙伴。
archived.latest_update_en: Nvidia launched the Open Agent Safety Platform, disclosing it combines the open-source OpenShell sandbox runtime with a BlueField-4-based Sentry hardware watchdog that can quarantine misbehaving AI agents within milliseconds, backed by more than 100 launch partners.

archived.title_zh: 美联储就《GENIUS法案》下支付稳定币发行人监管框架征求公众意见
archived.title_en: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
archived.latest_update_zh: 美联储的两项提案进入60天公众评论期，并新增披露内容包括稳定币收益/奖励计划治理、资本与储备要求，以及受美联储监管银行发行稳定币的程序。
archived.latest_update_en: The Fed's two proposals were opened for 60-day public comment periods and newly detailed coverage includes governance of stablecoin yield/rewards programs, capital and reserve requirements, and procedures for Fed-supervised banks to issue stablecoins.

archived.title_zh: 美国CFTC指控Cash FX Group S.A.及其首席执行官等四人涉9.5亿美元欺诈计划
archived.title_en: CFTC Charges Cash FX Group S.A., and CEO; Three Others With $950 Million Fraud Scheme
archived.latest_update_zh: CFTC在佛罗里达州联邦法院正式提起诉讼，指控Cash FX及其CEO、The Conversion Pros及其CEO Ronald Pope、Justin Halladay等人运营多层营销庞氏骗局，并称投资者损失至少4.06亿美元。
archived.latest_update_en: The CFTC filed a complaint in Florida federal court against Cash FX, its CEO, The Conversion Pros and its CEO Ronald Pope, and Justin Halladay, alleging a multilevel-marketing Ponzi scheme and at least $406 million in investor losses.

archived.title_zh: 美国SEC最坚定的加密支持者Hester Peirce将于下周离职
archived.title_en: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
archived.latest_update_zh: Hester Peirce已提交正式辞职信，10月2日生效，确认离职；她还曾担任SEC加密工作组主任，任期已于2025年6月到期。
archived.latest_update_en: Hester Peirce submitted a formal resignation letter effective Oct. 2, confirming her departure; she also served as director of the SEC's Crypto Task Force, with her term having expired in June 2025.

archived.title_zh: 纽约证券交易所与Blockchain.com探索代币化美股交易
archived.title_en: NYSE and Blockchain.com Explore Tokenized US Stock Trading
archived.latest_update_zh: NYSE Group 与 Blockchain.com 签署谅解备忘录，拟让 Blockchain.com 用户接入 NYSE 计划中的 24/7 代币化证券交易场所，交易美股和 ETF，并建立覆盖股票与加密资产的双向市场数据合作；仍需监管批准。
archived.latest_update_en: NYSE Group and Blockchain.com signed a memorandum of understanding to explore giving Blockchain.com users access to US-listed stocks and ETFs on NYSE's planned 24/7 tokenized securities venue, alongside a two-way market-data arrangement covering stocks and crypto, subject to regulatory approval.

archived.title_zh: BitMEX 正式关闭交易所运营并进入清盘
archived.title_en: BitMEX officially shuts down exchange operations and enters wind-down
archived.latest_update_zh: BitMEX已重新开放美国、加拿大、香港、百慕大、塞舌尔和缅甸客户的登录、KYC和提现权限——这些地区此前被其封锁——以便他们在平台结束交易业务后取回余额，但制裁限制以及延迟提现可能产生的账户费用仍然适用。
archived.latest_update_en: BitMEX has reopened login, KYC and withdrawal access for customers in the US, Canada, Hong Kong, Bermuda, Seychelles and Myanmar — jurisdictions it had previously blocked — so they can recover balances after the platform ended trading operations, while sanctions restrictions and possible account fees for delayed withdrawals still apply.

archived.title_zh: 联合国安理会将从构建AI的科技巨头处获取AI风险建议
archived.title_en: UN Security Council Will Get Advice on AI Risks From Tech Giants Building It
archived.latest_update_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在联合国安理会发表讲话，就 AI 安全、人类控制和国际合作发表意见。
archived.latest_update_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the United Nations Security Council, delivering remarks on AI safety, human control, and international cooperation.

archived.title_zh: 加拿大六大银行将启动银行间代币化存款计划
archived.title_en: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative
archived.latest_update_zh: 报道披露参与银行为 BMO、CIBC、National Bank of Canada、RBC、Scotiabank 和 TD Bank Group，并称第一阶段将聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，未来可能连接其他数字资产系统；同时提及 OSFI 于 9 月 10 日澄清代币化存款法律性质。
archived.latest_update_en: The report identifies the participating banks as BMO, CIBC, National Bank of Canada, RBC, Scotiabank and TD Bank Group, says the first phase will focus on moving tokenized deposits between Canadian financial institutions before possibly connecting with other digital asset systems, and cites OSFI's Sept. 10 clarification on the legal treatment of tokenized deposits.

archived.title_zh: 币安在五年 USDC 推广协议中斥资 1 亿美元收购 Circle 股份
archived.title_en: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
archived.latest_update_zh: 根据扩大的五年期协议，Circle将按Binance通过Circle的模块化智能合约钱包基础设施持有的USDC数量，每月向Binance支付激励费；Binance还同意开展额外的USDC推广活动。若Binance在特定条件下终止商业协议，两年锁定期可提前结束。
archived.latest_update_en: Under the expanded five-year agreement, Circle will pay Binance a monthly incentive fee based on the amount of USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure, and Binance agreed to undertake additional USDC promotional activities. The two-year lockup can end earlier if Binance terminates the commercial agreement under certain conditions.

archived.title_zh: 币安在 1 亿美元 Circle 交易后下架 19 个 USDC 交易对；XRP 突破 1.55 美元；SHIB 涨势在关键阻力位停滞。 - Pluang
archived.title_en: Binance drops 19 USDC pairs after $100M Circle deal; XRP breaks $1.55; SHIB's rally stalls at key resistance. - Pluang
archived.latest_update_zh: Circle 以每股 80.84 美元向 Binance 出售 1,237,011 股（较 9 月 17 日收盘价折价 5%），并同意继续按 USDC 余额向 Binance 支付月度费用；SEC 文件披露该交易。
archived.latest_update_en: Circle sold Binance 1,237,011 shares at $80.84, a 5% discount to the Sept. 17 close, and agreed to keep paying Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC balances, per an SEC filing.

archived.title_zh: 欧洲央行推出“面向银行的数字欧元”，并准备购买代币化债券
archived.title_en: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
archived.latest_update_zh: 欧洲央行开始准备将一小部分自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，并披露了首批参与机构及 2028 年全面实施目标。
archived.latest_update_en: The ECB began preparations to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, and disclosed initial participants and a full implementation target of 2028.

archived.title_zh: 欧洲央行推出 Pontes，无需稳定币即可结算代币化资产
archived.title_en: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
archived.latest_update_zh: ECB宣布计划动用一小部分自有储备投资欧元计价的代币化证券，并通过新平台Pontes以央行货币结算；具体规模和时机将在准备工作完成后决定，Pontes预计2028年全面实施。
archived.latest_update_en: The ECB announced it plans to invest a small portion of its reserves in euro-denominated tokenized securities, settled in central bank money through the new Pontes platform; size and timing will be decided after preparatory work, with full Pontes implementation expected by 2028.

archived.title_zh: Coinbase 向 CFTC 申请上市美国单只股票永续合约
archived.title_en: Coinbase Files with CFTC to List US Single-Stock Perpetual Futures
archived.latest_update_zh: Coinbase Derivatives 已向 CFTC 提交申请，拟上线苹果、特斯拉、英伟达等个股的现金结算永续合约，将境内永续合约布局从股指扩展至单一证券。产品尚未获批或上线。
archived.latest_update_en: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC for cash-settled perpetual futures on individual stocks including Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia, extending its domestic perpetual futures push from equity indexes to single securities. Products are not yet approved or live.

archived.title_zh: Chainalysis 报告朝鲜和伊朗相关黑客推动链上恶意软件活动激增
archived.title_en: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
archived.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 报告补充了伊朗关联行为者将命令与控制路由信息嵌入发送至中本聪相关比特币地址的交易中，并指出高容量开源权重中国 AI 模型出现后恶意区块链写入从每天 2.06 次升至 11.1 次（增长 440%）。
archived.latest_update_en: Chainalysis report added that suspected Iran-linked actors embed command-and-control routing data inside Bitcoin transactions sent to a Satoshi Nakamoto-associated address, and that malicious blockchain writes rose from 2.06 to 11.1 per day (a 440% increase) after the emergence of high-capacity open-weight Chinese AI models.

archived.title_zh: CFTC 向白宫提交加密资产规则制定，未等国会先行推进
archived.title_en: CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress
archived.latest_update_zh: 该规则制定已明确为 RIN 3038-AF80，并于9月17日提交白宫 OIRA，目前处于 pre-rule（预规则）阶段，而非拟议规则；此事发生在参议院阻止 CLARITY Act 两天后。
archived.latest_update_en: The rulemaking is identified as RIN 3038-AF80 and was filed with White House OIRA on Sept. 17 at the prerule stage, not as a proposed rule, two days after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act.

archived.title_zh: 美国因涉嫌向 IRGC 转移比特币而制裁伊朗加密交易所 BitBank
archived.title_en: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC
archived.latest_update_zh: OFAC还指定了与BitBank相关的另外五名个人和实体，并披露BitBank由Babak Zanjani控制，在6月至7月间转移了数亿美元比特币给IRGC，且Hormuz Safe自6月以来通过BitBank处理通行费支付。
archived.latest_update_en: OFAC also designated five additional individuals and entities tied to BitBank, and disclosed that BitBank is controlled by Babak Zanjani, moved hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC between June and July, and that Hormuz Safe has routed toll payments through BitBank since June.

archived.title_zh: 美国众议院加密税收方案未包含挖矿和质押奖励延期纳税条款
archived.title_en: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
archived.latest_update_zh: 众议院筹款委员会于9月16日以38票对5票批准了H.R. 10357《数字资产税收确定性法案》，并采纳了主席杰森·史密斯的替代案，将该法案推进至众议院全体会议；行业团体继续寻求扩大日常支付豁免并调整质押和挖矿奖励的纳税时点。
archived.latest_update_en: The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5 on Sept. 16, adopting Chairman Jason Smith’s substitute and sending the bill to the full House; industry groups continue to seek broader everyday-payment relief and changes to when staking and mining rewards become taxable.

archived.title_zh: Bybit 上线英伟达与 SpaceX 永续期权
archived.title_en: Industry First: TradFi Perp Options, a new way to trade Stock Perpetuals.
archived.latest_update_zh: Bybit 已于 2026 年 9 月 17 日正式上线 NVIDIA 和 SpaceX 的永续期权，支持 24/7 交易、碎股、统一交易账户组合保证金及完整策略支持。
archived.latest_update_en: Bybit officially launched perpetual options on NVIDIA and SpaceX on September 17, 2026, with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, Unified Trading Account portfolio margin, and full strategy support.

archived.title_zh: 韩国警方以非法赌博罪名起诉26名Polymarket用户：报道
archived.title_en: South Korean police charge 26 Polymarket users for illegal gambling: report
archived.latest_update_zh: 韩国警方已将26名Polymarket用户中的18人移送检方，案件涉及非法赌博调查；这些用户合计下注约1270万美元，单人最高下注约410万美元。
archived.latest_update_en: South Korean police referred 18 of 26 Polymarket users to prosecutors in the illegal gambling probe; the users collectively wagered about $12.7 million, with the largest single user wagering about $4.1 million.

archived.title_zh: 标普全球收购智能合约安全公司OpenZeppelin
archived.title_en: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
archived.latest_update_zh: 收购后 OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 旗下独立业务部门继续运营，联合创始人兼 CEO Demian Brener 留任并直接向 S&P Global Ratings 总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；交易财务条款未披露。
archived.latest_update_en: After the acquisition, OpenZeppelin will continue operating as a separate S&P Global business unit, with co-founder and CEO Demian Brener remaining in charge and reporting to S&P Global Ratings President Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.

archived.title_zh: Revolut 黑客索要 300 万美元门罗币，威胁出售客户数据
archived.title_en: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
archived.latest_update_zh: Revolut 表示未收到该团体任何直接联系或勒索要求，并称受影响客户数量“有限”、资金和系统未受影响；报道补充称数据通过入侵意大利政府邮件系统、以真实域名和有效认证伪装的信息请求在数月内获取，攻击者先用链上分析筛选高净值用户，并已向 FT 展示文件录屏。
archived.latest_update_en: Revolut said it has not received any direct contact or demand from the group, called the number of affected customers 'limited,' and said funds and systems were untouched; the report adds that data was obtained via a compromised Italian government email system using genuine domains and valid authentication over months, with attackers using blockchain analysis to target high-net-worth users and showing the FT a screen recording of files.

archived.title_zh: Circle 推出 Arc 主网，贝莱德、DTCC、Visa 等机构参与验证
archived.title_en: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet with BlackRock, DTCC, Visa Among Validators
archived.latest_update_zh: Circle上线Arc的公开主网，这是一条一层区块链，让单一USDC余额即可同时覆盖支付和网络费用，旨在提升USDC相对Tether的实用性。
archived.latest_update_en: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, a layer-1 blockchain that lets a single USDC balance cover both payments and network fees, aiming to boost USDC utility against Tether.

archived.title_zh: CLARITY法案受挫后，加密行业将目光转向SEC和CFTC
archived.title_en: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback
archived.latest_update_zh: CFTC 工作人员将 Introducing Broker 豁免扩大至被动软件，同时 SEC 的五年期代币化美股豁免明确适用于许可型自动做市商（而非无需许可区块链）。
archived.latest_update_en: CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software, and the SEC's five-year tokenized U.S. stock exemption was specified as applying to permissioned automated market makers (rather than permissionless blockchains).

archived.title_zh: Celsius在交易所关停前11天向BitMEX索赔4.95亿美元
archived.title_en: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown
archived.latest_update_zh: 新报道进一步披露 Celsius 在 BitMEX 上交易的是杠杆衍生品 XBTM20，并指出 Alex Mashinsky 在清算后一天公开声称 Celsius 不做交易，与债务人的指控相矛盾。
archived.latest_update_en: The new report further details that Celsius traded the leveraged derivative XBTM20 on BitMEX and that Alex Mashinsky publicly claimed one day after the liquidation that Celsius did not trade, contradicting the debtors' allegations.

archived.title_zh: Revolut 误信伪造政府请求，泄露护照与比特币交易数据
archived.title_en: Bitcoin activity, passports exposed after Revolut falls for fake government request
archived.latest_update_zh: 攻击者“iamnotavillain”声称对Revolut数据泄露负责，索要300万美元门罗币赎金，威胁若不支付将出售被盗客户数据；谈判尚未开始，Revolut称未收到任何要求；路透社称约680名客户受影响。
archived.latest_update_en: Attackers "iamnotavillain" claimed responsibility for the Revolut data breach and demanded $3 million in Monero ransom, threatening to sell stolen customer data if unpaid; negotiations have not begun, Revolut said it has received no demands; Reuters reported about 680 customers affected.

archived.title_zh: 美国比特币储备周三面临关键的两党考验
archived.title_en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国众议院金融服务委员会以 28-21 的投票结果通过了《2026 年美国储备现代化法案》(H.R. 8957)，该法案将把特朗普的战略比特币储备编入法律，并要求联邦没收的比特币至少持有 20 年。
archived.latest_update_en: The House Financial Services Committee passed the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) by a 28-21 vote, advancing the bill to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and require federally forfeited Bitcoin to be held at least 20 years.

archived.title_zh: 两名Robinhood工程师被控利用Hyperliquid永续合约进行内幕交易
archived.title_en: Two Robinhood engineers charged with insider trading using Hyperliquid perpetuals
archived.latest_update_zh: 检方确认两名被控工程师为 Hefu Chai 和 Huaisong Xiang，并具体指控其电汇欺诈和商品欺诈，称二人在 2025 至 2026 年间各获利超过 5 万美元。
archived.latest_update_en: Prosecutors identified the two charged engineers as Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang, specified wire fraud and commodities fraud charges, and alleged each profited over $50,000 across 2025–2026.

archived.title_zh: Solana 激活 Transaction V1，交易数据容量提升三倍并迈向 250 毫秒插槽
archived.title_en: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
archived.latest_update_zh: Solana 于 9 月 15 日激活 Transaction V1，将单笔交易数据容量扩大三倍以上至 4,096 字节，并准备将 slot 时间缩短至 250ms。
archived.latest_update_en: Solana activated Transaction V1 on Sept. 15, increasing per-transaction data capacity by more than threefold to 4,096 bytes, and is preparing to cut slot times to 250ms.

archived.title_zh: 欧洲央行呼吁商户参与数字欧元试点
archived.title_en: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
archived.latest_update_zh: 新增申请截止日期为10月27日，并披露试点细节：beta数字欧元不具法定货币地位、参与自愿且无偿、商户将参与远程/commerce结账测试。
archived.latest_update_en: Added application deadline of Oct. 27 and disclosed pilot details: beta digital euro will not have legal tender status, participation is voluntary and unpaid, and merchants will test remote/commerce checkout use.

archived.title_zh: 美国提起民事没收诉讼，指控币安被用于伊朗石油网络洗钱
archived.title_en: Binance used to launder illegal oil money, U.S. alleges - Investment Executive
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国检方提起民事没收诉讼，寻求没收10个Tron地址上约6120万USDT，这些地址据称与一个15亿美元的伊朗石油网络有关，Tether已冻结其中几个地址，币安被点名但未被指控有不当行为。
archived.latest_update_en: US prosecutors filed a civil forfeiture complaint to seize roughly 61.2 million USDT across 10 Tron addresses allegedly linked to a $1.5 billion Iranian oil network, with Tether already freezing several addresses and Binance named but not accused of wrongdoing.

archived.title_zh: Robinhood Chain：基于以太坊 Layer-2 的代币化股票与 Meme 币网络
archived.title_en: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins
archived.latest_update_zh: Robinhood Chain 的 TVL 已接近 10 亿美元，日 DEX 交易量达 18.8 亿美元，稳定币市值突破 10 亿美元；分析师将增长归因于品牌、无许可设计、补贴 Gas 费和 Meme 币/代币化股票飞轮效应。
archived.latest_update_en: Robinhood Chain's TVL has climbed to nearly $1 billion, daily DEX volume reached $1.88 billion, and stablecoin market cap surpassed $1 billion; analyst attributes growth to brand, permissionless design, subsidized gas fees, and a memecoin/tokenized-stock flywheel.

archived.title_zh: 印度通过REC启动代币化公司债券试点
archived.title_en: India Launches Pilot for Tokenized Corporate Bonds via REC
archived.latest_update_zh: 披露试点名称为“Demat 2.0”，REC、Larsen & Toubro与IIFL Finance三家发行人合计融资1,025 crore卢比（约1.07亿美元）；REC于9月7日率先发行500 crore卢比。系统通过统一市场接口链接RBI批发数字卢比实现原子结算，后续阶段将引入二级交易和零售参与。
archived.latest_update_en: Disclosed the pilot name "Demat 2.0"; three issuers—REC, Larsen & Toubro and IIFL Finance—raised a combined 1,025 crore rupees (~$107 million), with REC first on Sept. 7 raising 500 crore rupees. The system links to the RBI's wholesale digital rupee via a Unified Market Interface for atomic settlement; later phases will add secondary trading and retail access.

archived.title_zh: 周一提现关闭后，七种资产进入Kraken清算窗口 - CryptoSlate
archived.title_en: Seven assets enter Kraken liquidation window after withdrawals close Monday - CryptoSlate
archived.latest_update_zh: Kraken 针对阿联酋居民客户的七项资产（XMR、ZEC、DASH、USDD、DAI、USDS、USDE）提现于9月14日14:00 UTC关闭，清算窗口为9月15日至25日，且不保证清算所得币种。
archived.latest_update_en: Kraken's withdrawal cutoff for seven assets (XMR, ZEC, DASH, USDD, DAI, USDS, USDE) for UAE-resident clients is Sept. 14 at 14:00 UTC, with liquidation scheduled Sept. 15–25 and no guaranteed proceeds currency.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克向Kraken母公司Payward投资1亿美元
archived.title_en: Nasdaq Invests $100 Million in Kraken Parent Payward
archived.latest_update_zh: 新信息澄清该1亿美元投资为拟议/已同意但未完成交易，未披露交割日期、估值、持股比例或治理权；并新增NET目标于2027年第二季度推出且代币尚未上线。
archived.latest_update_en: New facts clarify the $100 million investment is proposed/agreed but not completed, with no closing date, valuation, ownership percentage or governance rights disclosed; adds NET launch target of Q2 2027 and that tokens are not live.

archived.title_zh: 印度 SEBI 与 RBI 启动代币化债券试点，以数字卢比结算
archived.title_en: India starts tokenizing $620 billion corporate bond market with digital rupee settlement
archived.latest_update_zh: 印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）与印度储备银行正式启动 Demat 2.0 代币化公司债试点；REC、Larsen & Toubro 和 IIFL 合计发行 102.5 亿卢比（约1.07亿美元），通过分布式账本与批发型 CBDC 结算。
archived.latest_update_en: SEBI and RBI formally launched the Demat 2.0 tokenized corporate bond pilot; REC, Larsen & Toubro and IIFL issued a combined 10.25 billion rupees (~$107 million) on distributed ledger infrastructure linked to wholesale CBDC settlement.

archived.title_zh: Nomic 桥漏洞导致 allBTC 部分失去支撑，Osmosis 冻结 22.65 枚 BTC
archived.title_en: Osmosis freezes 22.65 BTC after Nomic forwarding bug compromises Bitcoin reserves
archived.latest_update_zh: 新披露：攻击发生于6月25日，攻击者利用两个漏洞凭空铸造40.650602 BTC的nBTC；74天后才发现；攻击者通过671 ETH至Tornado Cash套现约100万美元；治理提案拟没收冻结的22.65 allBTC、取消USDC.noble流动性重新部署并动用Community Pool填补40 BTC缺口。
archived.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed: exploit occurred June 25; attacker used two bugs to mint 40.650602 BTC of unbacked nBTC; detection took 74 days; attacker cashed out ~$1M via 671 ETH to Tornado Cash; governance proposal would seize frozen 22.65 allBTC, cancel USDC.noble liquidity re-deployment, and pull Community Pool allBTC to fill the 40 BTC shortfall.

archived.title_zh: Trezor 邮件服务商遭入侵，官方警告用户防范钓鱼攻击
archived.title_en: Trezor Warns of Phishing After Email Provider Breach
archived.latest_update_zh: Brevo 发布事后报告，披露攻击者利用其登录系统的缺陷创建账户、启用单点登录并邀请合法用户进入配置，导致授权边界失效，攻击者因此访问了 138 个客户账户。其中 6 个账户被用于发送钓鱼邮件，联系人从 43 个账户被导出。Trezor 确认钓鱼邮件发送给约 347,000 名订阅者，域名在 20 分钟内于 DNS 层被关闭，但约有 2,500 人在关闭前点击了链接；BitBox 与 CoinTracking 的 Brevo 账户也被用于发送类似钓鱼邮件。
archived.latest_update_en: Brevo published a postmortem disclosing the root cause: an attacker created a Brevo account, enabled single sign-on and invited legitimate users into the configuration, causing an authorization boundary failure that granted access to 138 client accounts. Six accounts were used to send phishing emails and contacts were exported from 43 accounts. Trezor confirmed the phishing email went to roughly 347,000 subscribers, that the domain was disabled at the DNS level within 20 minutes, and that about 2,500 people accessed the link before takedown; Brevo accounts belonging to BitBox and CoinTracking were also used for similar phishing emails.

archived.title_zh: OpenAI 纳维-斯托克斯成果据称附带 Lean 4 形式化证明
archived.title_en: OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents solved a $1 million math problem. Now mathematicians are fighting
archived.latest_update_zh: 据报 OpenAI 的纳维-斯托克斯成果附带 Lean 4 形式化证明，可机器检验；验证成本高昂，外部数学家未验证，并存在训练数据质疑。
archived.latest_update_en: OpenAI's reported Navier-Stokes result reportedly includes a Lean 4 formal proof, enabling machine-checking; verification costs are high, external mathematicians have not verified it, and training-data concerns were raised.

archived.title_zh: OpenAI 宣称 AI 模型解决纳维-斯托克斯千禧难题
archived.title_en: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
archived.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充：GPT-6 Astra在Lean中形式化并验证了证明，额外耗时17小时；证明显示初始光滑流体可在有限时间内形成奇点并保持有限能量，对应千禧年问题情形C和D；OpenAI已公开证明及Lean形式化供独立审查。
archived.latest_update_en: New report adds: GPT-6 Astra formalized and verified the proof in Lean, taking an additional 17 hours; the proof shows an initially smooth fluid can develop a singularity in finite time while retaining finite energy, establishing cases C and D of the Millennium Prize formulation; OpenAI released the proof and Lean formalization for independent scrutiny.

archived.title_zh: Uniswap推出“StablePair Hook”，帮助流动性提供者获取更多稳定币交易价值
archived.title_en: Uniswap launches ‘StablePair Hook’ to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value
archived.latest_update_zh: Uniswap 在两个以太坊稳定币交易对资金池（USDC/USDT 和 USDC/USDG）上线动态费用，价格区间外的纠正交易需支付每区块递减的费用。
archived.latest_update_en: Uniswap launched dynamic fees on two Ethereum stable-pair pools pairing USDC with USDT and USDG, where corrective trades outside the price band incur a fee that decreases each block.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克以210亿美元估值向Kraken母公司Payward投资1亿美元
archived.title_en: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
archived.latest_update_zh: Payward 将在其加密、股票、代币化股票、期货和期权交易场所采用 Nasdaq 的监控技术。
archived.latest_update_en: Payward will adopt Nasdaq's surveillance technology across its crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures, and options venues.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克、斯图加特证券交易所等呼吁欧盟取消或提高代币化试点上限
archived.title_en: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
archived.latest_update_zh: 欧洲金融与代币化团体（包括纳斯达克、Boerse Stuttgart等）于9月7日致函欧盟理事会成员及欧洲议会经济与货币事务委员会，要求取消拟议的1000亿欧元代币化证券上限，或至少将其提高至5000亿欧元作为基线；信中提及部分现有欧洲项目规模已达3500亿欧元，并对比美国无上限的代币化结算平台。
archived.latest_update_en: European finance and tokenization groups including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart sent a draft letter dated Sept 7 to EU Council members and the European Parliament's ECON committee, urging removal of the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities or raising it to at least €500 billion as a baseline; the letter cites existing European projects already at €350 billion scale and contrasts the US where a dominant settlement platform tokenizes assets without volume caps.

archived.title_zh: 美国特勤局冻结与Telegram诈骗市场Xinbi相关的5280万美元加密资产
archived.title_en: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
archived.latest_update_zh: 新增：联邦法院于9月7日授权扣押与Xinbi相关的Telegram频道；调查人员扣押两个约1200万美元的钱包并寻求限制47个额外地址；财政部制裁SafeW Technology和Anwen Technology；Xinbi将商户协调转向SafeW并推出XinbiPay。
archived.latest_update_en: New: federal court authorized seizure of Xinbi-linked Telegram channels on Sept. 7; investigators seized two wallets holding about $12 million and sought restraint of 47 additional addresses; Treasury sanctioned SafeW Technology and Anwen Technology; Xinbi shifted merchant coordination to SafeW and introduced XinbiPay.

archived.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash，缓存命中定价极低
archived.title_en: DeepSeek launching v4.1 flash cheaper and more capable than v4 pro
archived.latest_update_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 已在 Hugging Face 发布，参数规模 552B，并提供详细技术报告。
archived.latest_update_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has been released on Hugging Face, with 552B parameters and a detailed technical report.

archived.title_zh: 美国财政部制裁另一个广泛存在的网络诈骗中心Xinbi Guarantee
archived.title_en: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国司法部查封了与 Xinbi Guarantee 相关的两个钱包（约1200万美元），并申请限制另外47个钱包，总计涉及超过5200万美元加密货币；OFAC 将 Xinbi 指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，并制裁了 SafeW Technology 和 Anwen Technology。
archived.latest_update_en: The U.S. Justice Department seized two wallets linked to Xinbi Guarantee containing about $12 million and sought restraints on 47 additional wallets, totaling over $52 million in crypto; OFAC designated Xinbi as a significant transnational criminal organization and sanctioned SafeW Technology and Anwen Technology.

archived.title_zh: 德国财政部提议自2028年起对加密货币征收25%税率：报道
archived.title_en: German finance ministry proposes 25% crypto tax starting 2028: Report
archived.latest_update_zh: 明确该25%加密资产收益税自2027年1月1日起适用于该日期后购买的资产（而非2028年），并规定自2028年起由平台自动预扣，同时适用团结附加税。
archived.latest_update_en: Clarifies that the 25% tax on crypto gains applies from January 1, 2027 (not 2028) to assets bought after that date, with automatic withholding starting in 2028 and the solidarity surcharge applicable.

archived.title_zh: Tether与Fasanara推出4亿美元私募信贷基金StableFund
archived.title_en: Tether and Fasanara Capital Launch $400 Million Private Credit Fund to Expand Stablecoin-Enabled Real-Economy Lending
archived.latest_update_zh: 该基金目标从机构投资者募集高达30亿美元，名为StableFund，采用永久资本结构，由Fasanara负责投资管理，Tether负责提供USDT结算基础设施并挖掘相关融资机会，重点关注中小企业和消费贷款，包括贸易应收款和供应链金融。
archived.latest_update_en: The fund aims to raise up to $3 billion from institutional investors, named StableFund, structured as an evergreen fund, with Fasanara managing investments and Tether providing USDT settlement infrastructure and sourcing financing opportunities, focusing on SME and consumer lending including trade receivables and supply chain finance.

archived.title_zh: 加密行业团体升级对伊利诺伊州的抗争，请求法院阻止争议性加密税
archived.title_en: Crypto industry groups escalate fight against Illinois, asking court to block controversial crypto tax
archived.latest_update_zh: 加密行业团体（CCI和Blockchain Association）提交初步禁令动议，寻求在2027年1月生效日期前阻止伊利诺伊州0.2%的加密交易税。
archived.latest_update_en: Crypto industry groups (CCI and Blockchain Association) filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to block Illinois' 0.2% crypto transaction tax before its January 2027 effective date.

archived.title_zh: Consensys 将拆分为 MetaMask 和机构区块链公司
archived.title_en: Consensys splits MetaMask from institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses
archived.latest_update_zh: 新成立的Consensys公司领导层确定：Mike Kriak担任CEO，David Cunningham担任总裁，Joe Lubin担任执行董事长；同时MetaMask的Joe Lubin担任董事长兼CEO。
archived.latest_update_en: The new Consensys leadership is set: Mike Kriak as CEO, David Cunningham as President, and Joe Lubin as Executive Chairman; additionally, Joe Lubin serves as both Chairman and CEO of MetaMask.

archived.title_zh: Jack Dorsey的Block加入向OCC申请联邦银行牌照的热潮
archived.title_en: Jack Dorsey’s Block joins rush for federal bank charters from OCC
archived.latest_update_zh: Block 已向 OCC 正式提交申请，拟成立名为 Builders Bank & Trust 的全国性信托银行，提供受联邦监管的比特币和稳定币托管服务，且不吸收存款或发放贷款。李·伍利将担任总裁兼首席执行官。
archived.latest_update_en: Block has formally applied to the OCC to create Builders Bank & Trust, an uninsured national trust bank offering federally supervised Bitcoin and stablecoin custody, without accepting deposits or issuing loans. Lee Woolley would serve as President and CEO.

archived.title_zh: Visa将VisaNet数据接入链上借贷以支持稳定币卡业务
archived.title_en: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital
archived.latest_update_zh: Visa宣布其稳定币结算量年化率已超过200亿美元，与Credit Coop的早期融资模式自2023年以来支持了超过25亿美元的累计结算量，且零违约。
archived.latest_update_en: Visa announced that its stablecoin settlement volume has exceeded a $20 billion annualized rate, and an early financing model with Credit Coop has supported more than $2.5 billion in cumulative settlement volume since 2023 with zero defaults.

archived.title_zh: Malone Lam因2.45亿美元比特币盗窃案面临认罪听证
archived.title_en: Malone Lam Faces Plea Hearing Over $245M Bitcoin Theft
archived.latest_update_zh: Malone Lam 认罪，承认主导了一起 2.45 亿美元的加密货币社会工程诈骗案。
archived.latest_update_en: Malone Lam pleaded guilty to leading a $245M cryptocurrency social engineering scheme.

archived.title_zh: 以太坊基金会为 Hegotá 升级指定 2 个“必须交付”的 EIP
archived.title_en: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
archived.latest_update_zh: 以太坊基金会将Hegotá升级范围缩小至FOCIL和Frame Transactions，并推迟发行量变更（放弃逐渐减少的发行量和强制燃烧执行奖励），将其归入更广泛的生态系统流程。
archived.latest_update_en: Ethereum Foundation narrows Hegotá upgrade scope to FOCIL and Frame Transactions, and defers issuance changes (declining tapered issuance burn and mandatory burn of execution rewards) to a broader ecosystem process.

archived.title_zh: Liquid 黑客盗走 3.2 亿美元比特币后归还 2.7 亿
archived.title_en: Bitcoin network used by exchanges hit by $320 million exploit. Hackers claim they're the 'good guys'

other.title_zh: Strategy公布2026年第三季度财报：净利润195.3亿美元、持有848,517枚比特币，CFO将离任
other.title_en: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任
other.latest_update_zh:
Strategy 在 7 月至 9 月期间通过按市价（ATM）增发普通股融资 54 亿美元，但其中仅 5.88 亿美元用于购买比特币，相当于每融资 1 美元投入比特币不足 11 美分。公司同期还卖出 5,552 枚自有比特币，套现 3.486 亿美元，部分用于支付股息，部分用于回购其 STRC 优先股。

这一披露打破了此前的模式：2024 年几乎每一美元 ATM 融资都变成了比特币，即便在表现异常的 2025 年第三季度，每 1 美元中仍有逾 94 美分用于买入比特币。其意义在于，Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币储备公司，其融资中最终流向现货比特币购买的比例，是一条可直接观察的需求渠道。

Strategy 当季共买入 7,218 枚比特币，扣除卖出部分后，净持仓仅比季初增加 1,666 枚。在 10 月 26 日当周的披露中，新增 1.64 亿美元 MSTR 增发，每 1 美元中仅 40 美分用于购买比特币。
other.latest_update_en:
Strategy raised $5.4 billion through at-the-market common stock sales between July and September but spent only $588 million of that on bitcoin — less than 11 cents of every dollar raised. The company also sold 5,552 of its own BTC for $348.6 million, partly to fund dividends and partly to repurchase its STRC preferred stock.

The disclosure breaks a pattern: in 2024 essentially every ATM dollar became bitcoin, and even in the anomalous third quarter of 2025 more than 94 cents of each dollar still bought BTC. The shift matters because Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury, so the share of its fundraising that reaches spot BTC purchases is a directly observable demand channel.

Strategy bought 7,218 BTC during the quarter and, after accounting for its sales, ended with just 1,666 more coins than it started with. In the reporting week of October 26, $164 million of fresh MSTR dilution saw only 40 cents of each dollar go toward BTC.

other.title_zh: Anthropic 正在研发一套可证明 AI 模型身份的系统
other.title_en: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
other.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic 公布了一种名为 FlashProve 的研究方案，用于大型混合专家（MoE）语言模型的可验证推理：模型提供方先对模型权重做出承诺，随后为每个请求生成一份 zkSNARK 证明，使客户端能够核实实际为其提供服务的是哪一套权重。Anthropic 表示已在一个 4000 亿参数模型上演示了该系统。

该方案针对的是托管模型服务中的信任缺口：让客户能够确认提供方服务器上实际运行的权重，而不是仅凭提供方的一面之词。有评论者认为这相较此前的零知识方案是显著改进，同时指出约 90-100 倍的计算开销限制了它在短期内的实用性。

据讨论中引述的报告内容，权重承诺约 6.5 MB，在提供方需要重新承诺之前大约可用于 1600 万次请求，每个请求生成一份证明。验证一份证明在 24 线程上约需 17 秒、单线程约需 21 秒，其中包含对离线阶段的校验。
other.latest_update_en:
Anthropic published a research approach, called FlashProve, for provable inference of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models: the model provider commits to its weights, then issues one zkSNARK proof per request so a client can verify which weights actually served it. Anthropic said it demonstrated the system on a 400-billion-parameter model.

The scheme targets a trust gap in hosted model serving — letting a customer confirm which weights ran on a provider's servers rather than relying on the provider's word. Commenters described it as a significant improvement over earlier zero-knowledge results, while noting the roughly 90-100x compute overhead limits near-term practicality.

According to discussion of the report, the weight commitment is about 6.5 MB and remains valid for roughly 16 million requests before the provider must commit again, with one proof issued per request. Verifying a proof takes about 17 seconds on 24 threads and 21 seconds on a single thread, including the check from the offline phase.

other.title_zh: Anthropic CEO呼吁AI研发减速至更安全节奏
other.title_en: Anthropic CEO urges slowdown of AI development to a safer pace
other.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic公开警告称，公司正接近“递归自我改进”（RSI）能力，即AI系统已足够擅长训练自身的后继系统、从而推动能力急剧加速的临界点，并将这一时刻界定为关键的安全关口。

Anthropic的这一表述将RSI置于争论的核心：前沿实验室应以多快速度部署能力不断增强的系统，以及监管机构应如何构建对这一过程的监督。

这一表态是对“接近程度”的判断，而非已展示的能力跃升或已披露的安全事件。RSI被描述为AI在自我训练上变得极为高效、从而令能力提升大幅加速的那个节点。
other.latest_update_en:
Anthropic publicly cautioned that it is approaching recursive self-improvement (RSI) — the threshold at which AI systems become good enough at training their own successors to drive a sharp acceleration in capabilities — framing the moment as a critical safety juncture.

Anthropic's framing places RSI at the center of the debate over how quickly frontier labs should deploy increasingly capable systems and how regulators should structure oversight of that process.

The statement is an assessment of proximity rather than a demonstrated capability jump or a disclosed safety incident. RSI is described as the point where AI becomes so effective at training itself that capability gains accelerate dramatically.

other.title_zh: TCP释放后使用漏洞：CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
other.title_en: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
other.latest_update_zh:
Anthropic 表示，Claude 使用一个尚未发布的内部模型，为 CVE-2026-98432 写出了可用的远程漏洞利用程序。该漏洞是 Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 握手路径中的释放后使用（use-after-free）缺陷，严重性评分 9.8，影响 4.4 及之后的內核版本。该攻击在 10 月 27 日的一篇研究文章中披露，覆盖 Chrome、Safari、Android、Windows 和 Linux 五个目标，定位内存缺陷耗时不到一小时，再花约五分钟即可执行获得 root 权限的命令。

Ubuntu 官方跟踪页面仍将 16.04 至 26.10 的所有版本列为受影响，而红帽已于 11 月 1 日（周日）为 RHEL 8、9、10 发布修复，包括安全公告 RHSA-2026:93412。Go 安全团队警告称，底层缺陷并不局限于 Anthropic 演示所用攻击所依赖的 MPTCP 特性，并建议升级到已修补的内核。

Anthropic 写道，该漏洞属于竞态条件，竞争失败只会导致握手失败而不会使系统崩溃，因此攻击者可以无限次重试。红帽发布了一条临时防火墙规则，称其“可降低暴露于该漏洞的风险，但无法完全阻止”，完整的解决方案仍在开发中；Debian、SUSE、Oracle Linux 和 Amazon Linux 也已为至少部分版本发布修复。
other.latest_update_en:
Anthropic said Claude, using an unreleased internal model, wrote a working remote exploit for CVE-2026-98432, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake path rated 9.8 for severity that affects kernel versions from 4.4 onward. The attack was described in an Oct. 27 research post covering five targets — Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux — and takes under an hour to locate the memory flaw plus about five minutes to execute a command with root access.

Ubuntu's own tracker still lists every release from 16.04 through 26.10 as affected, while Red Hat shipped fixes for RHEL 8, 9 and 10 on Sunday, Nov. 1, including advisory RHSA-2026:93412. The Go Security Team warned that the underlying bug is not specific to MPTCP, the feature Anthropic's demonstrated exploit requires, and recommended upgrading to a patched kernel.

Anthropic wrote that the bug is a race condition where a lost race only fails the handshake without crashing the system, so an attacker can retry indefinitely. Red Hat published a temporary firewall rule that it says "reduces exposure to this vulnerability but cannot fully prevent it," with a full solution still under development; Debian, SUSE, Oracle Linux and Amazon Linux have also shipped fixes for at least some versions.

other.title_en: BTCPay Server：热钱包遭未经授权攻击，建议用户暂停运行服务
other.latest_update_zh: BTCPay Server 已识别出针对 2.4.1 或更早版本实例的攻击向量，建议用户升级至 2.4.7，并表示尚无运行最新版本的用户热钱包被盗的可信报告。
other.latest_update_en: BTCPay Server identified an attack vector affecting instances running version 2.4.1 or earlier, advised upgrading to 2.4.7, and said there are no credible reports of hot-wallet theft for users on the latest release.

other.title_zh: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
other.title_en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
other.latest_update_zh: Swell 已重新开放 swETH 与 rswETH 的存取款，汇率恢复至正确水平，并表示按虚高汇率存入的用户将在下周内获得补偿。
other.latest_update_en: Swell has reopened swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals, restored the exchange rate to its correct level, and said users who deposited at the inflated rate will be compensated within the following week.

other.title_zh: Chainalysis：以太坊重组触发THORChain紧急暂停，延迟洗钱
other.title_en: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder
other.latest_update_zh: THORChain 表示，误付的 10 ETH 已由用户主动退回，金库恢复偿付能力；但 AVAX、BASE、RUNE、XRPL 之外的多条链交易仍暂停，包括 ATOM、BCH、BSC、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、SOL、TRON、ZEC，待核心开发团队修复并由节点运营商确认安全后决定是否重启。
other.latest_update_en: THORChain said the erroneously paid 10 ETH was voluntarily returned by a user and treasury solvency was restored; however, trading remained paused on ten chains—ATOM, BCH, BSC, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, SOL, TRON and ZEC—while AVAX, BASE, RUNE and XRPL stayed active, pending fixes and node-operator safety confirmation before re-enabling.

other.title_zh: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
other.title_en: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道
other.latest_update_zh: 伊朗外长披露一项“两天计划”：第一天美国采取一系列履约措施，第二天霍尔木兹海峡开放并恢复交通；在美国履行包括确定新航线、解冻资金、结束海上封锁、解除新制裁等条件后，伊美谈判才会重启。
other.latest_update_en: Iran's foreign minister disclosed a 'two-day plan': on day one the US takes a series of compliance measures, and on day two the Strait of Hormuz reopens and traffic returns to normal; talks would resume only after the US fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade, and new sanctions relief.

other.title_zh: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
other.title_en: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
other.latest_update_zh: Threshold 将 tBTC 暂停归因于 Linux 内核漏洞 CVE-2026-98432，称所有 tBTC 节点运营商已完成服务器修补或暂时离线；另有一名运营商报告其基础设施发生与内核漏洞无关的安全事件，tBTC 节点用于支付交易费的以太坊账户被转走约 0.5 枚 ETH，但未发现签名密钥材料被访问。
other.latest_update_en: Threshold attributed the tBTC pause to Linux kernel vulnerability CVE-2026-98432, saying all tBTC node operators patched or temporarily took nodes offline; one operator separately reported an unrelated infrastructure incident in which the Ethereum fee account for its tBTC node lost about 0.5 ETH, with no evidence of signing-key material access.

other.title_zh: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
other.title_en: 【币安：预计 45 小时后恢复提现，后续调查发现更多入侵点】
other.latest_update_zh: 币安称被盗资产补足比例已从约80%升至90%，BTC、ETH、USDT、BNB、SOL、USDC、XRP、USD1、RLUSD与ZEC已实现100%覆盖；10月31日8:00完成新的储备证明快照，完整零知识证明预计11月3日生成；提现仍计划11月1日恢复，SAFU部分调用预计未来24小时内进行。
other.latest_update_en: Binance said stolen-asset coverage rose from about 80% to 90%, with BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC fully covered; a new proof-of-reserves snapshot was completed on Oct 31 at 08:00, with the full zero-knowledge proof expected around Nov 3; withdrawals remain planned to reopen Nov 1, and part of the SAFU draw is expected within 24 hours.

completed.title_zh: Solana基金会确定Alpenglow主网升级日期，随后Alpenglow在主网激活并停用TowerBFT
completed.title_en: Solana Foundation Sets Alpenglow Mainnet Upgrade Date
completed.latest_update_zh: Solana 验证者在槽位 459,653,000 停用 TowerBFT 并激活 Anza 的 Alpenglow 共识，将主网-beta 的交易最终确认时间从约 12.8 秒缩短至约 150 毫秒，同时沿用现有账本。
completed.latest_update_en: Solana validators retired TowerBFT and activated Anza's Alpenglow consensus at slot 459,653,000, reducing transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 150 milliseconds on mainnet-beta while carrying the existing ledger forward.

completed.title_zh: Term Finance 治理攻击与 Meta Vaults 关闭
completed.title_en: Term Finance governance exploit and Meta Vaults shutdown
completed.latest_update_zh: Term Finance 在攻击后永久关闭 Meta Vaults。
completed.latest_update_en: Term Finance permanently shut Meta Vaults after the exploit.

completed.title_zh: Solana 首次约束性通胀递减治理投票
completed.title_en: Solana's first binding disinflation governance vote
completed.latest_update_zh: 验证者通过提案，将通胀递减率提高至 30%。
completed.latest_update_en: Validators passed the proposal, raising the disinflation rate to 30%.

completed.title_zh: Tectonic 遭攻击并触发 Cronos 回滚
completed.title_en: Tectonic exploit triggers Cronos rollback
completed.latest_update_zh: Cronos 官方事后报告确认受影响的借贷活动约 1.204 亿美元，其中约 1.112 亿美元通过回滚恢复，但 919 万美元在验证者暂停网络前已转出。
completed.latest_update_en: Cronos official post-mortem confirms affected borrowing activity about $120.4M, with ~$111.2M reversed via rollback, but $9.19M exited before validators halted the network.

completed.title_zh: Polars 2.0预发布
completed.title_en: Pre-Release of Polars 2.0
completed.latest_update_zh: Polars 2.0 正式版发布，此前为预发布版本。
completed.latest_update_en: Polars 2.0 final release is now available, moving beyond the pre-release stage.

completed.title_zh: Liquid Network 遭约3.2亿美元比特币提取后暂停并恢复出块
completed.title_en: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin
completed.latest_update_zh: Liquid Federation 于 11 月 3 日宣布网络比特币储备已全部恢复，所有流通 LBTC 重新获得 1:1 BTC 支撑；用户可通过参与互换的服务商按 1:1 在比特币与 Liquid 之间转移。
completed.latest_update_en: On November 3, the Liquid Federation announced that the network's bitcoin reserves were fully restored, re-establishing 1:1 BTC backing for all circulating LBTC; users can again move between bitcoin and Liquid at a 1:1 ratio through participating swap providers.

completed.title_zh: Coldcard 第三波被盗资金约45%已转移，比例不代表全部损失
completed.title_en: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
completed.latest_update_zh: 白帽黑客将52.37枚比特币从Coldcard黑客事件中转移至新成立的恢复信托地址；约40%的Wave 2资金被确认为白帽活动；受害者可在cryptorecoverytrust.com查询资金是否被追回；另有3.0134枚比特币无先前追踪记录流入该地址。
completed.latest_update_en: Whitehats moved 52.37 BTC from the Coldcard hack to a newly formed recovery trust; roughly 40% of Wave 2 funds identified as whitehat activity; victims can check cryptorecoverytrust.com to see if funds were recovered; an additional 3.0134 BTC with no prior tracking history flowed to the same address.

completed.title_zh: 美国参议院否决《CLARITY法案》程序性投票，加密市场结构立法受挫
completed.title_en: Coinbase CLARITY Act: Senate Cloture Vote Explained - Cryptonews
completed.latest_update_zh: 《数字资产市场清晰法案》在国会陷入停滞，促使SEC和CFTC等美国机构试图以自己的监管规则取代该立法。
completed.latest_update_en: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act has stalled in Congress, prompting U.S. agencies like the SEC and CFTC to attempt to substitute their own regulations for the legislation.

completed.title_zh: Revolut被骗向黑客交出富裕客户的护照和比特币交易记录
completed.title_en: Revolut tricked into handing hackers the passports and Bitcoin histories of wealthy customers
completed.latest_update_zh: 意大利邮政警察正在调查一起政府电子邮件泄露事件，黑客涉嫌利用该泄露获取Revolut客户数据；意大利CERT-AGID报告自2026年初以来已处理超过650起涉及滥用或非法PEC账户的案件。
completed.latest_update_en: Italian cybercrime police are investigating a government email breach that hackers allegedly used to obtain Revolut customer data; Italy’s CERT-AGID reported over 650 cases of abused or illicit PEC accounts since the start of 2026.

completed.title_zh: Balancer 提出并获批关闭协议，将国库分配给 BAL 持有者
completed.title_en: Balancer Proposes Shutting Down and Returning Its $9 Million Treasury to BAL Holders
completed.latest_update_zh: BAL 持有者已批准有序关停提案 BIP-928，分叉提案 BIP-929 未获通过；现有资金池运行至 10 月 30 日（合作方可申请将特定 V3 池延长至 11 月 30 日），期间可随时提取资金，11 月 30 日 V3 Vault 暂停，自 2027 年 5 月底起持有者可销毁 BAL 按比例获得 DAO 金库资产。
completed.latest_update_en: BAL holders approved the orderly wind-down proposal BIP-928 while the fork proposal BIP-929 was rejected; pools run normally until Oct 30 (partners may apply to extend certain V3 pools to Nov 30), withdrawals remain available throughout, the V3 Vault pauses on Nov 30, and from late May 2027 holders can burn BAL for a pro-rata share of DAO treasury assets.

completed.title_zh: XRP Ledger距离启动下一次重大支付升级仅差一票
completed.title_en: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
completed.latest_update_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 修正案已于10月8日激活上线，账户可将支付、合规审批等限定权限授予独立账户而无需交出主密钥；官方同时警告在相关修复激活前不要委派 PaymentBurn 权限，另有关于验证者投票计数服务器缺陷的补丁仍在审议中。
completed.latest_update_en: The PermissionDelegationV1_1 amendment activated on Oct. 8, letting account owners delegate scoped powers such as payments and compliance approvals to separate accounts without sharing primary keys; users are warned not to delegate PaymentBurn until a related fix activates, and a separate server vote-counting patch remains under review.

completed.title_zh: Zcash NU7治理获批并确定主网激活高度
completed.title_en: Zcash NU7 governance approved and mainnet activation height set
completed.latest_update_zh: 截至11月5日，Sprout隐私池仍有约12,226枚ZEC（约1600万美元）待NU7激活后永久冻结；升级预计于美东周四晚约9:30在区块3,543,405激活，实际时间可能因出块速度推迟。
completed.latest_update_en: As of Nov. 5, about 12,226 ZEC (~$16M) remained in the Sprout shielded pool and would be permanently frozen after NU7 activation; the upgrade was expected to activate around 9:30 p.m. ET Thursday at block 3,543,405, with timing potentially slipping based on block production.

completed.title_zh: 高盛转向，现预测美联储将在 10 月加息
completed.title_en: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation
completed.latest_update_zh: 高盛改变预测，现在预计美联储将在10月再次加息，逆转此前预测。
completed.latest_update_en: Goldman Sachs now expects another Fed rate hike in October, reversing its prior forecast.

completed.title_zh: 评级巨头 S&P Global 收购 OpenZeppelin，推进代币化金融风险布局
completed.title_en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
completed.latest_update_zh: 标普全球已完成对 OpenZeppelin 的收购（此前仅为收购协议）；OpenZeppelin 以独立业务部门运营，创始人 Demian Brener 领导并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报，OpenZeppelin Contracts 库继续保持开源免费维护。
completed.latest_update_en: S&P Global has completed its acquisition of OpenZeppelin (previously only an agreement to acquire); OpenZeppelin operates as a standalone unit led by founder Demian Brener reporting to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec, with the OpenZeppelin Contracts library remaining open source and freely maintained.

completed.title_zh: 微软与Coinbase的调查导致'EvilTokens'背后的骗子被捕，这是一个由AI驱动的DIY钓鱼网络 - fortune.com
completed.title_en: Microsoft and Coinbase probe leads to arrest of crooks behind 'EvilTokens', a DIY phishing network powered by AI - fortune.com
completed.latest_update_zh: 新增事实：Coinbase 追踪到 EvilTokens 约 110 万美元平台收入，流向四个 Tron 地址（2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 6 月）；该钓鱼服务入侵超过 12,000 个邮箱、涉及 10,000 多个组织；执法方查获 50 个网站并关停 150 多个相关域名；英国警方于 9 月 11 日逮捕两名嫌疑人，后获有条件保释。
completed.latest_update_en: New facts: Coinbase traced about $1.1 million in EvilTokens platform revenue across four Tron addresses from October 2025 to June 2026; the phishing service compromised over 12,000 inboxes across more than 10,000 organizations; authorities seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 related domains; UK police arrested two suspects on Sept. 11, later released on conditional bail.

completed.title_zh: CME 期货上市之际，比特币现金上涨 27%，比特币当日回吐涨幅
completed.title_en: CME Group to List Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures Oct. 19
completed.latest_update_zh: CME公告拟上市比特币现金期货后，比特币现金盘中上涨14%，收盘涨27%，成交量超周一两倍；比特币SV上涨20%，Uniswap一度涨11%后回吐涨幅。
completed.latest_update_en: After CME announced it would list Bitcoin Cash futures, Bitcoin Cash rose 14% intraday, closed up 27% on more than twice Monday's volume; Bitcoin SV rose 20%, and Uniswap spiked 11% before giving back gains.

completed.title_zh: Neutron治理攻击致Cosmos Hub暂停并资金被盗
completed.title_en: Neutron governance attack leads to Cosmos Hub halt and fund drain
completed.latest_update_zh: 新增关键事实：在Cosmos Hub重启并扫走1.23百万ATOM后，168,990.9 ATOM因THORChain退款在七个区块后到达攻击者关联地址，未在恢复交易中被拦截，随后被转入Osmosis分批卖出约266,841 USDC并部分换成ETH；此外，攻击初始损失估计约440万美元，Neutron正筹备重启并恢复受影响合约。
completed.latest_update_en: New material facts: after Cosmos Hub restarted and swept 1.23M ATOM, 168,990.9 ATOM arrived at the attacker-linked address seven blocks later via a THORChain refund, escaped the recovery transaction, and was moved to Osmosis and sold in batches for about 266,841 USDC, partly converted to ETH; the initial attack impact was estimated at roughly $4.4M, and Neutron is preparing to restart and restore affected contracts.

completed.title_zh: Bitget 遭朝鲜关联黑客攻击，约3.88亿美元被盗
completed.title_en: Bitget Suffers DPRK-Linked Hack with Roughly $388M Stolen
completed.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，将 20 多小时的手动跨链对账压缩至 10 分钟以内；新报道还补充了 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币等洗钱应对细节。
completed.latest_update_en: Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, compressing 20+ hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes; the report also adds laundering response details: Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked itself, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318,000 in stablecoins.

completed.title_zh: KelpDAO 就 2.92 亿美元 rsETH 跨链漏洞起诉 LayerZero 及其 CEO
completed.title_en: KelpDAO sues LayerZero and CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
completed.latest_update_zh: 新报道披露：原告为KelpDAO母公司Evercrest Technologies，在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省起诉LayerZero Labs及CEO Bryan Pellegrino，指控过失、虚假陈述和诽谤，并称攻击后Kelp用户已提取超6.5亿美元；约145亿美元资产宣布从LayerZero迁移至Chainlink CCIP；LayerZero CEO称诉讼无依据。
completed.latest_update_en: New coverage discloses that plaintiff is Evercrest Technologies, KelpDAO's parent, suing LayerZero Labs and CEO Bryan Pellegrino in British Columbia on claims of negligence, misrepresentation and defamation; Kelp users have withdrawn over $650M since the attack; roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP; and LayerZero's CEO called the suit meritless.

completed.title_zh: Bitwise NEAR 现货 ETF 获美国上市批准并开始交易
completed.title_en: Bitwise NEAR spot ETF wins U.S. listing approval and begins trading
completed.latest_update_zh: Bitwise NEAR ETF（NRR）上线首日资产管理规模达 3600 万美元，净流入 3550 万美元，成交量为 1510 万美元。
completed.latest_update_en: Bitwise NEAR ETF (NRR) debuted with $36 million in first-day assets under management, $35.5 million in net inflows, and $15.1 million in trading volume.

completed.title_zh: Zano 在 Gateway Address 漏洞利用后回滚区块链一个月
completed.title_en: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
completed.latest_update_zh: Zano 发布事后分析，披露攻击者通过 Gateway Address 漏洞在 8 月 29 日和 9 月 25 日分别铸造约 1840 万枚 ZANO，共 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD；攻击者支付 100 ZANO 注册费并先行测试伪造资产，首次铸造近一个月未被发现。恢复将主要通过交易所和支付服务进行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
completed.latest_update_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed the attacker exploited the Gateway Address vulnerability to mint about 18.4M ZANO on Aug. 29 and another 18.4M on Sept. 25, totaling 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD; the attacker paid a 100 ZANO registration fee, tested a fabricated asset first, and the first mint went unnoticed for nearly a month. Recovery will primarily run through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.

completed.title_zh: 假冒GIWA Layer 2跨链桥被掏空766 ETH
completed.title_en: Fake GIWA Layer 2 Bridge Drained of 766 ETH
completed.latest_update_zh: 披露更多细节：DYORSWAP 因假 GIWA 链复用了真实链 ID 9134 而被骗集成，逾 1,335 个地址共桥入 767.65 ETH（约 200 万美元），资金被骗子通过 Tornado Cash 转移；疑似骗子地址由 Binance 和 Gate 出资，DYORSWAP 已向用户分发逾 200 ETH 补偿，并有团队地址在链上要求骗子归还资金。
completed.latest_update_en: More details emerged: DYORSWAP was tricked into integrating the spoofed GIWA chain because it reused the genuine chain ID 9134; 1,335 addresses bridged 767.65 ETH (~$2M), which the scammers drained and funneled through Tornado Cash. Suspected scammer addresses were funded from Binance and Gate, DYORSWAP has distributed over 200 ETH in compensation, and a team-linked address has asked the scammers on-chain to return the funds.

completed.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5.5与Sonnet 5模型
completed.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5 models
completed.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 公布 Sonnet 5.5 防蒸馏措施的初步效果：蒸馏攻击者提取的 Claude 推理 Token 减少约 90%–99%，已封禁数万个相关账号，并自 9 月 24 日起恢复对因安全防护被拦截的蒸馏类请求收费。
completed.latest_update_en: Anthropic disclosed initial results of its Sonnet 5.5 anti-distillation measures: extraction of Claude reasoning tokens by distillation attackers fell roughly 90%–99%, tens of thousands of related accounts were banned, and charging resumed since September 24 for blocked distillation-related requests.

completed.title_zh: AMD 将以超过 80 亿美元收购 AI 公司 World Labs
completed.title_en: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
completed.latest_update_zh: 彭博社估计，交易完成后李飞飞净资产将至少升至16亿美元，较此前增加逾五成；她持有 World Labs 约19%股份，并在今年2月公司融资估值超50亿美元后成为亿万富豪；World Labs的研究团队和模型将获得AMD算力支持。
completed.latest_update_en: Bloomberg estimates that upon completion of the deal, Fei-Fei Li's net worth will rise to at least $1.6 billion, an increase of more than 50%; she holds about 19% of World Labs and became a billionaire after the company's February funding round valued it above $5 billion; World Labs' research team and models will receive AMD compute support.

completed.title_zh: Kalshi 洽谈并以约400亿美元估值完成10亿美元G轮融资
completed.title_en: Kalshi in talks for and closes $1B Series G at ~$40B valuation
completed.latest_update_zh: Kalshi 以 400 亿美元估值完成 10 亿美元 G 轮融资，由 Wellington Management 和 Sequoia Capital 联合领投，并表示其非体育市场年化收入现已超过 10 亿美元，同时正拓展金融市场业务、深化与 NBA 和 S&P Dow Jones Indices 的合作，并应对针对其体育合约的法律挑战。
completed.latest_update_en: Kalshi closed a $1 billion Series G round at a $40 billion valuation, co-led by Wellington Management and Sequoia Capital, and said its non-sports markets now generate more than $1 billion in annualized revenue as it expands into financial markets and deepens NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices partnerships while contesting legal challenges to its sports contracts.

completed.title_zh: Abracadabra 因多次黑客攻击提议清算协议并关闭 MIM
completed.title_en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
completed.latest_update_zh: Abracadabra DAO 在第二次“精炼”投票中通过了关停提案：将法定人数门槛从 30 亿 SPELL 降至 3 亿 SPELL，最终由约 3.96 亿 SPELL 赞成推动通过，其中大部分投票来自标注为“Abracadabra.Money: MIM Treasury”的钱包；尽管 Snapshot 显示为“rejected”，按提案中的法定人数调整披露，该投票被视为已通过。
completed.latest_update_en: Abracadabra DAO passed the wind-down proposal on a second 'refined' vote after lowering quorum from 3 billion to 300 million SPELL; about 396 million SPELL voted in favor, largely from the 'Abracadabra.Money: MIM Treasury' wallet, and despite Snapshot displaying 'rejected,' the vote is treated as passed under the proposal's quorum-adjustment disclosure.

completed.title_zh: Open Standard 稳定币 OUSD 正式上线，由 Stripe 旗下 Bridge 发行
completed.title_en: Open Standard's OUSD stablecoin goes live, issued by Stripe-owned Bridge
completed.latest_update_zh: Open USD 作为 Stripe 默认稳定币上线后，新增了分发细节：Mastercard 的分发路径通过 BVNK，Visa 提供有限测试版访问，Coinbase 计划于 10 月 1 日跟进上线。
completed.latest_update_en: After Open USD launched as Stripe's default stablecoin, new distribution details emerged: Mastercard's route runs through BVNK, Visa offers limited beta access, and Coinbase is scheduled to follow on Oct. 1.

completed.title_zh: NEAR Intents 遭攻击损失超380万美元后暂停服务并追回资金
completed.title_en: NEAR Intents exploited for over $3.8M, halts services, and recovers funds
completed.latest_update_zh: NEAR 联创 Illia Polosukhin 表示，NEAR Intents 被盗资金已在不到 24 小时内锁定责任方、建立沟通，并于 UTC 时间 14:30 全额追回；追回归功于 Intents 上的 AI 安全层 SHIELD 及侦查工作。
completed.latest_update_en: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said the stolen NEAR Intents funds were fully recovered after the responsible party was identified and contacted within 24 hours, with full recovery completed at 14:30 UTC; he credited the AI security layer SHIELD on Intents and investigative work.

completed.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
completed.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
completed.latest_update_zh:
Blast 在 X 平台发推宣布，其 L2 网络已正式关停。仍在 L2 钱包、待处理提现或 Blast Mobile 中持有 ETH 或 USD 的用户，可通过 Blast 官网取回资产；该取回网站将运行 12 个月，最终支持日期为 2027 年 11 月 4 日。

资产取回网站设有明确期限，2027 年 11 月 4 日为最后支持日期。此前的报道称，Blast 的标准提现界面已于 10 月 26 日关闭，此后用户需直接与以太坊桥合约交互才能转移资产。
completed.latest_update_en:
Blast announced on X that its L2 network has formally shut down. Users still holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, in pending withdrawals, or in Blast Mobile can reclaim their assets through the Blast official website, which will remain available for 12 months with a final support date of November 4, 2027.

The asset-recovery site is time-limited, with November 4, 2027 set as the last supported date. Earlier reporting indicated that Blast's standard withdrawal interface closed on October 26, after which users must interact directly with Ethereum bridge contracts to move assets.

completed.title_zh: Mistral AI 发布旗舰模型 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）
completed.title_en: Mistral AI Releases Flagship Model Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
completed.latest_update_zh: 新增开源后评测细节：官方称 Terminal-Bench 4.0 编程成绩从28%升至41%，但 Artificial Analysis 仅测得25%；单题成本降63%至2.06美元，幻觉率从41%降至28%，权重提供 FP8 和 NVFP4 版本。
completed.latest_update_en: Added post-release evaluation details: Mistral reports Terminal-Bench 4.0 coding score rising from 28% to 41%, while Artificial Analysis measured only 25%; per-task cost fell 63% to $2.06, hallucination rate dropped from 41% to 28%, and weights are offered in FP8 and NVFP4 versions.

completed.title_zh: 德国监管机构拒绝 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 交易仍处暂停状态
completed.title_en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
completed.latest_update_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
completed.latest_update_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.

completed.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
completed.title_en: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
completed.latest_update_zh: 受Claude Haiku 5.5发布带来的定价与性能竞争压力影响，港股大模型公司智谱和MiniMax股价盘中分别下跌超过6%和9%。
completed.latest_update_en: Amid competitive pricing and performance pressure from the Claude Haiku 5.5 launch, Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares fell more than 6% and 9% intraday.

completed.title_zh: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
completed.title_en: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
completed.latest_update_zh: Starknet 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票已结束，提案以约 93.52% 的支持率获得通过，参与度创治理历史新高；StarkWare 与 Starknet Foundation 将成立工作组并计划在 11 月发布白皮书草案，但实际迁移仍需另行具有约束力的投票，Starknet 目前仍作为以太坊 L2 运行。
completed.latest_update_en: Starknet's seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote has closed and the proposal passed with about 93.52% support and record governance participation; StarkWare and the Starknet Foundation will form a working group and plan a draft whitepaper in November, but any actual transition still requires a separate binding vote, and Starknet continues operating as an Ethereum L2 for now.

completed.title_zh: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
completed.title_en: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
completed.latest_update_zh: bStocks 用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，日均交易量超过 3 亿美元，上线资产接近 100 种，自上线以来直接持股与 bStocks 的 1:1 转换规模达 60 亿美元。
completed.latest_update_en: bStocks surpassed $1 billion in user AUM, cumulative trading volume above $40 billion, average daily volume over $300 million, nearly 100 listed assets, and about $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between directly held shares and bStocks since launch.

completed.title_zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
completed.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
completed.latest_update_zh: Tether 在数小时后解冻了此前被列入黑名单的四个 THORChain USDT 金库地址，约 145 万 USDT 被冻结后恢复，THORChain 交易随之恢复。
completed.latest_update_en: Tether unfroze the four previously blacklisted THORChain USDT vault addresses hours later, restoring access to about 1.45 million USDT and allowing THORChain trading to resume.

completed.title_zh: Aero 确定 10 月 21 日启动合并并公布代币转换条款
completed.title_en: Aero Sets Oct. 21 Merger Launch and Token Conversion Terms
completed.latest_update_zh: Aero 在两次延期后完成合并上线，并以与收入挂钩的代币经济模型取代 ve(3,3)，取消每周投票与固定排放，同时扩展至七条链。
completed.latest_update_en: Aero completed its twice-delayed merger launch, replaced the ve(3,3) model with revenue-linked tokenomics, ended weekly voting and fixed emissions, and expanded across seven chains.

completed.title_zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
completed.title_en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
completed.latest_update_zh: ENSv2 已正式上线以太坊主网，引入分层注册表和更细粒度权限模型，并推出新版 ENS App 与 ENS Explorer；现有 .eth 域名继续有效且无需重新注册，用户可自愿升级至 ENSv2。
completed.latest_update_en: ENSv2 has officially launched on Ethereum mainnet, introducing hierarchical registries and a finer-grained permissions model, plus a new ENS App and ENS Explorer; existing .eth domains remain valid with no re-registration required, and users can voluntarily upgrade to ENSv2.

completed.title_zh: 美国9月CPI数据超预期
completed.title_en: U.S. September CPI exceeds expectations
completed.latest_update_zh: 9月核心CPI环比上涨0.33%，高于预期，前值为0.29%；「美联储传声筒」Timiraos称这强化了美联储年内再次加息的理由，并引发对加息时机的讨论。
completed.latest_update_en: September core CPI rose 0.33% month-over-month, hotter than expected, versus 0.29% prior; WSJ's Nick Timiraos said this reinforces the case for another Fed rate hike this year and raises timing questions.

completed.title_zh: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
completed.title_en: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
completed.latest_update_zh: HEX代币价格下跌近30%，市值蒸发约1.6亿美元，市场对创始人被捕消息做出反应。
completed.latest_update_en: HEX token price fell nearly 30%, erasing about $160 million in market value, as market reacted to reports of founder's arrest.

completed.title_zh: 【Upbit 将下架 Zilliqa（ZIL）】
completed.title_en: 【Upbit 将下架 Zilliqa（ZIL）】
completed.latest_update_zh: Upbit 下架公告引发市场反应，ZIL 短线暴跌超22%，跌至0.0027美元。
completed.latest_update_en: The Upbit delisting announcement triggered a market reaction: ZIL plunged over 22% intraday to $0.0027.

completed.title_zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
completed.title_en: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
completed.latest_update_zh: MiniMax 于10月23日按计划开源 M3.1 Flash 权重，已上架 Hugging Face 和魔搭；披露模型为4280亿总参数 MoE（每次激活约230亿），采用稀疏注意力、量化训练与 DSpark 推测解码，Agent 任务成本较上代降70%、生成速度近3倍，权重采用 MiniMax Community License（年收入超2000万美元需书面授权）。
completed.latest_update_en: MiniMax released the open weights for M3.1 Flash on October 23 as planned, listed on Hugging Face and ModelScope; disclosed a 428B-total-parameter MoE (~23B active) with sparse attention, quantized training and DSpark speculative decoding, 70% lower agent-task cost and ~3x generation speed, under the MiniMax Community License (written authorization required above $20M annual revenue).

completed.title_zh: KuCoin与MEXC相继停止为俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供服务
completed.title_en: MEXC Announces Discontinuation of Services for Users in Russia and Belarus
completed.latest_update_zh: KuCoin以法律和监管合规为由，暂停向俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供所有产品和服务，并将提供有序的资产提取退出流程。
completed.latest_update_en: KuCoin suspended all products and services for users in Russia and Belarus, citing legal and regulatory compliance, and will provide an orderly exit process for asset withdrawals.

completed.title_zh: 部分Bloom Trading用户集体被盗共计95万美元，官方称已着手调查
completed.title_en: 部分Bloom Trading用户集体被盗共计95万美元，官方称已着手调查
completed.latest_update_zh: 链上分析师 Specter 监测称，Bloom Trading 攻击者正在进行自动化大规模洗钱，使用 2,152 个独特路由与目标地址（Solana 1,326 个、EVM 822 个、Zcash 5 个），并已将 26.099 枚 ZEC 跨链至 Zcash 的 Sapling 屏蔽池。
completed.latest_update_en: On-chain analyst Specter reported that the Bloom Trading attacker is conducting automated large-scale money laundering, using 2,152 distinct routes and destination addresses (1,326 Solana, 822 EVM, 5 Zcash), and has bridged 26.099 ZEC into Zcash's Sapling shielded pool.

completed.title_zh: 巴西加密交易所赶在央行授权截止日前申请牌照
completed.title_en: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
completed.latest_update_zh: 10月30日巴西虚拟资产服务商授权申请窗口关闭，实际仅约40家机构提交申请或相关动作，低于市场预期的150至200家；未申请授权企业须在30天内退出巴西市场，且自11月6日起银行和支付机构不得与未获授权的虚拟资产服务商交易。
completed.latest_update_en: The Brazilian virtual asset service provider authorization window closed on Oct 30 with only about 40 institutions submitting applications or related actions versus an expected 150-200; unlicensed firms must exit the Brazilian market within 30 days, and from Nov 6 banks and payment institutions are barred from transacting with unauthorized virtual asset service providers.

completed.title_zh: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
completed.title_en: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
completed.latest_update_zh: 财报公布后 Alphabet 股价进一步下跌逾12%至285美元，市值缩水近5000亿美元；多家机构下调评级、目标价或盈利预测，分析师预计短期股价区间震荡，RSI降至20出头并接近270.70美元的52周低点。
completed.latest_update_en: After the earnings report, Alphabet shares fell further more than 12% to $285, erasing nearly $500B in market value; multiple institutions cut ratings, price targets, or earnings forecasts, and analysts expect near-term range-bound trading, with RSI in the low 20s and the stock near its $270.70 52-week low.

completed.title_zh: Polymarket 前端疑似遭入侵，用户资金被盗后平台暂停交易并承诺全额赔偿
completed.title_en: Multiple Polymarket Users Report Stolen Funds as Platform Restricts Trading and
completed.latest_update_zh: GoPlus 将 Polymarket 国际站用户资产被盗（约 271 万美元，涉及 710 个 DepositWallet、731 个地址）归因于第三方性能监控服务商 DebugBear 的 RUM 脚本遭供应链污染；Polymarket 表示已修复问题、恢复服务，并承诺全额赔付受影响交易者。
completed.latest_update_en: GoPlus attributed the Polymarket international-site user asset theft (~$2.71M across 710 DepositWallets and 731 addresses) to a supply-chain compromise of third-party performance-monitoring vendor DebugBear's RUM script; Polymarket said it fixed the issue, restored service, and promised full compensation to affected traders.

completed.title_zh: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
completed.title_en: 美股开盘，科技股抛售遭持续，英特尔暴跌25.7%
completed.latest_update_zh: 10月31日报道补充英特尔暴跌后的细节：英特尔收报65.76美元、跌28.58%；美国政府所持约10%股份价值单日缩水约120亿美元，英伟达所持股份价值缩水约60亿美元；第四季度营收指引150亿至160亿美元，低于LSEG预期的171亿美元，调整后EPS指引0.25美元，低于预期的0.43美元；CFO称PC市场放缓至少持续至2027年上半年，内存等零部件成本上涨；以色列晶圆厂爆炸事故预计两个季度造成约6亿美元营收损失；D.A. Davidson将英特尔评级从买入下调至中性。
completed.latest_update_en: The October 31 report adds post-selloff details: Intel closed at $65.76, down 28.58%; the US government's roughly 10% stake lost about $12 billion in value in one day, while Nvidia's Intel stake lost about $6 billion; Q4 revenue guidance was $15–16 billion versus LSEG consensus of $17.1 billion, and adjusted EPS guidance was $0.25 versus $0.43 expected; the CFO said PC-market weakness will persist at least through H1 2027 and memory/component costs are rising; an explosion at Intel's Israeli fab is expected to cause about $600 million in revenue loss over two quarters; D.A. Davidson downgraded Intel from Buy to Neutral.

completed.title_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 确认遭网络攻击，此前 ZachXBT 将其与 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案关联
completed.title_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
completed.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称，攻击者是通过一家服务提供商（而非该行在线银行子公司 Fortuneo）进入系统的，并转走了银行自有资金；该行几乎所有业务已于周三恢复，但仍在评估财务影响。报道还称 Bitquery 追踪到从 Kraken、Crypto.com 和 OKX 账户提走的资金，部分资金已被冻结，后续追回工作正在进行中。
completed.latest_update_en: The new report adds that attackers gained access through a service provider, not the bank's online banking subsidiary Fortuneo, and transferred the bank's own funds; nearly all operations resumed Wednesday while the bank is still assessing the financial impact. It also says Bitquery traced withdrawals from accounts at Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX, some funds were frozen, and further recovery efforts are underway.
